info.description: YD Bio Ltd. is a biotechnology company building an integrated healthcare platform across regulated diagnostics, clinical services, and commercial healthcare markets. It operates DNA methylation-based oncology testing programs under an LDT-first strategy and provides compliant life science distribution and clinical trial supply chain services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners. The company's offerings include cancer detection products, regenerative ophthalmology solutions, and exosome-based technologies. YD Bio was founded on February 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: YD Bio Ltd. 是一家生物技術公司，在受監管的診斷、臨床服務和商業醫療保健市場上建立綜合醫療保健平台。該公司在 LDT 優先策略下經營基於 DNA 甲基化的腫瘤檢測項目，並為製藥和生物技術合作夥伴提供合規的生命科學分銷和臨床試驗供應鏈服務。該公司的產品包括癌症檢測產品、再生眼科解決方案和基於外泌體的技術。勇鼎生物成立於2024年2月6日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: Z Squared, Inc. is a computing and digital infrastructure company, which engages in operating digital asset mining focused on the generation of Dogecoin (DOGE) and Litecoin (LTC) through merged mining using Scrypt-algorithm ASIC hardware, conducted across six mining facilities located in North Carolina, South Carolina, and Iowa. The company was founded in December 2022 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.

Mereo BioPharma Group Plc is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics that aim to improve outcomes for oncology and rare diseases. Its portfolio include Etigilimab (MPH-313), Alvelestat (MPH-966), Setrusumab (BPS-804), Navicixizumab (OMP-305B83), Acumapimod (BCT-197), and Leflutrozole (BGS-649). The company was founded by Denise Vera Scots-Knight, Charles Edward Sermon, Alastair Graham MacKinnon, and John P. Richard in March 10, 2015 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Mereo BioPharma Group Plc 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於治療藥物的開發和商業化，旨在改善腫瘤和罕見疾病的治療結果。其產品組合包括 Etigilimab (MPH-313)、Alvelestat (MPH-966)、Setrusumab (BPS-804)、Navicixizumab (OMP-305B83)、Acumapimod (BCT-197) 和 Leflutrozole (BGS-649)。該公司由 Denise Vera Scots-Knight、Charles Edward Sermon、Alastair Graham MacKinnon 和 John P. Richard 於 2015 年 3 月 10 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing and commercializing products across a range of therapies. Its products include Gvoke, Keveyis, and Recorlev. Gvoke is a ready-to-use liquid glucagon for the treatment of severe hypoglycemia. Keveyis is the therapy approved in the United States to treat hyperkalemic, hypokalemic, and related variants of primary periodic paralysis (PPP). Recorlev is a cortisol synthesis inhibitor approved for the treatment of endogenous hypercortisolemia in adult patients with Cushing's syndrome. The company was founded by Steven Prestrelski in 2005 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Xeris Biopharma Holdings, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化一系列療法的產品。其產品包括 Gvoke、Keveyis 和 Recorlev。 Gvoke 是一種即用型液體胰高血糖素，用於治療嚴重低血糖。 Keveyis 是美國核准用於治療高血鉀、低血鉀和原發性週期性麻痺 (PPP) 相關變異的療法。 Recorlev 是一種皮質醇合成抑制劑，被批准用於治療患有庫欣氏症候群的成人患者的內源性高皮質醇血症。該公司由 Steven Prestrelski 於 2005 年創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. is the first publicly traded company to leverage Canton Coin and support the Canton Network to advance institutional blockchain adoption and the digitization of financial markets. In addition to driving value through activities on the Canton Network, it also operates clinical-stage biotech research and development programs. The company was founded on March 28, 2017 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
Skyline Builders Group Holding Ltd. focuses on the construction industry in Asia. The company was founded on June 25, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

Datadog, Inc. engages in the development of a monitoring and analytics platform for developers, information technology operations teams and business users. Its platform integrates and automates infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring and log management to provide real-time observability of its customers' entire technology stack. The company was founded by Olivier Pomel and Alexis Le-Quoc on June 4, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Sol Strategies, Inc. is an investment company. The firm is focused on the Solana ecosystem, which provides strategic investments and infrastructure solutions to enable decentralized finance. Its portfolio includes NGRAVE, Chia Network Inc., and zkSNACKS Limited. The company was founded on October 1, 2002 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Sol Strategies, Inc. 是一家投資公司。該公司專注於 Solana 生態系統，該生態系統提供策略性投資和基礎設施解決方案以實現去中心化金融。其投資組合包括 NGRAVE、Chia Network Inc. 和 zkSNACKS Limited。該公司成立於2002年10月1日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. develops medicines for the treatment and prevention of infectious diseases. Its product Arakoda helps in the prevention of malaria. The company was founded by Geoffrey Dow on September 9, 2010 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.

CEVA, Inc. engages in the provision of silicon and software intellectual property solutions that enable smart edge products to connect, sense, and infer data. Its products include Ceva-Waves Links, Ceva-Waves Wi-Fi, Ceva-Waves Dragonfly, Ceva-XC23, Ceva-XC21, Ceva-Waves Bluetooth, Ceva-Waves UWB, Ceva-PentaG2, and Ceva-PentaG RAN. The company was founded on November 22, 1999 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.

OraSure Technologies, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of point of care diagnostic tests and molecular collection devices designed to detect or diagnose critical medical conditions. It operates through the OSUR and DNAG segments. The OSUR segment offers oral fluid diagnostic products and specimen collection devices. The DNAG segment produces specimen collection kits that are used to collect, stabilize, transport, and store samples of genetic material for molecular testing in the consumer genetic, clinical genetic, academic research, pharmacogenomics, personalized medicine, microbiome, and animal genetics markets. The company was founded by Michael J. Gausling in 2000 in and is headquartered in Bethlehem, PA.

Sonos, Inc. engages in the provision of multi-room wireless audio products. It supports streaming services and provides access to music, Internet radio, podcasts, and audiobooks, with control from Android smartphones, iPhone or iPad. The company was founded by Mai Trung, John MacFarlane, Craig A. Shelburne, and Thomas S. Cullen in 2002 and is headquartered in Santa Barbara, CA.

Cadence Design Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of design and development of integrated circuits and electronic devices. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Asia, EMEA, and Japan. The company was founded by Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli, Gudmundur A. Hjartarson, K. Bobby Chao, and K. Charles Janac in June 1988 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Cadence Design Systems, Inc. 從事積體電路和電子設備的設計和開發。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、亞洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和日本。該公司由 Alberto Sangiovanni-Vincentelli、Gudmundur A. Hjartarson、K. Bobby Chao 和 K. Charles Janac 於 1988 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Mount Logan Capital, Inc. operates as an investment company. It engages in the facilitation of business mergers. The company was founded on January 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Montclair, NJ.

info.description: Rambus, Inc. is a global semiconductor company providing industry chips and silicon IP for data-intensive computing systems, focusing on data center and artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. Its products include Memory Interface Chips, Interface IP, and Security IP. The company was founded by P. Michael Farmwald and Mark A. Horowitz in March 1990 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

Viatris, Inc. is a global healthcare company, which engages in the provision of healthcare and pharmaceutical products. It provides medicines and treatments in various therapeutic areas such as cardiovascular, oncology, dermatology, eye care, gastroenterology, immunology, and women's healthcare. The firm operates through the following segments: Developed Markets, Greater China, JANZ, and Emerging Markets. The Developed Markets segment consists of operations primarily in North America and Europe. The Greater China segment includes operations in mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong. The JANZ segment covers operations in Japan, Australia, and New Zealand. The Emerging Markets segment encompasses operations in developing markets and emerging economies including in Asia, the Middle East, South and Central America, Africa, and Eastern Europe. The company was founded on February 14, 2019 and is headquartered in Canonsburg, PA.

Arqit Quantum, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services via satellite and terrestrial forms. Its product is QuantumCloud which secures devices with cloud-based quantum encryption. The company was founded by David John Williams and David James Bestwick on April 26, 2021 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arqit Quantum, Inc. 致力於透過衛星和地面形式提供網路安全服務。其產品是 QuantumCloud，它透過基於雲端的量子加密來保護設備。該公司由 David John Williams 和 David James Bestwick 於 2021 年 4 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Allient, Inc. is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that engages in the designing, manufacturing and sale of precision and specialty-controlled motion components and systems used in a broad range of industries, including industrial, vehicle, medical, and aerospace and defense. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Allient, Inc. 是一家全球性工程和製造企業，從事設計、製造和銷售精密和專業控制運動部件和系統，這些部件和系統廣泛應用於工業、車輛、醫療、航空航太和國防等行業。該公司成立於 1962 年，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company that involves clinical development and commercialization of high-value medicines. Its platforms, Captisol and NITRICI, offer technology with broad applicability in drug development to a large network of biopharmaceutical partners, including the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in the world. The company was founded by Ronald M. Evans in 1987 and is headquartered in Jupiter, FL.
info.description_zh: Ligand Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，涉及高價值藥物的臨床開發和商業化。其 Captisol 和 NITRICI 平台為包括世界上最大的製藥製造商在內的大型生物製藥合作夥伴網路提供在藥物開發方面具有廣泛適用性的技術。該公司由 Ronald M. Evans 於 1987 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朱庇特。

info.description: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the retail of closeouts, excess inventory, and salvage merchandise. The firm offers overstocks, discontinued merchandise, package changes, cancelled orders, buybacks from retailers, and major manufacturers. Its products include housewares, bed and bath, food, floor coverings, health and beauty aids, books and stationery, toys and electronics. The company was founded by Mark Butler, Mort Bernstein, Oliver Rosenberg and Harry Coverman on July 29, 1982, and is headquartered in Harrisburg, PA.
info.description_zh: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事清倉、過剩庫存和回收商品的零售業務。該公司提供庫存過剩、停產商品、包裝變更、取消訂單、零售商和主要製造商的回購服務。其產品包括家庭用品、床具和浴室、食品、地板覆蓋、健康和美容用品、書籍和文具、玩具和電子產品。該公司由 Mark Butler、Mort Bernstein、Oliver Rosenberg 和 Harry Coverman 於 1982 年 7 月 29 日創立，總部位於賓州哈里斯堡。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. engages in the operation and development of restaurant and retail outlets. The format of its stores consists of a trademarked rustic old country-store design that offers restaurant menu featuring home-style country food. The company was founded by Dan W. Evins on September 19, 1969 and is headquartered in Lebanon, TN.
info.description_zh: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. 從事餐廳和零售店的營運和開發。其商店的格式包括商標質樸的老式鄉村商店設計，提供以家庭風格鄉村食品為特色的餐廳菜單。該公司由 Dan W. Evins 於 1969 年 9 月 19 日創立，總部位於田納西州黎巴嫩。

info.description: Kimball Electronics, Inc. engages in the provision of contract manufacturing services including engineering and supply chain support for the production of electronic assemblies and other products including medical devices, medical disposables, precision molded plastics, and automation, test, and inspection equipment primarily in automotive, medical, and industrial applications. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, China, Mexico, Poland, Romania, and Thailand. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Jasper, IN.

Direxion Daily TSM Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of TSM. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of TSM and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to TSM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

ADMA Biologics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in manufacturing, marketing, and developing specialty plasma-derived biologics. The firm operates through the following business segments: ADMA BioManufacturing and Plasma Collection Center. The ADMA BioManufacturing segment consists of immune globulin manufacturing and development operations. The Plasma Collection Center consists of source plasma collection facilities. The company was founded by Adam S. Grossman and Jerrold B. Grossman on June 24, 2004 and is headquartered in Ramsey, NJ.
info.description_zh: ADMA Biologics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事製造、行銷和開發特種血漿衍生生物製劑。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：ADMA 生物製造和血漿採集中心。 ADMA 生物製造部門包括免疫球蛋白製造和開發業務。血漿採集中心由源頭血漿採集設施組成。該公司由 Adam S. Grossman 和 Jerrold B. Grossman 於 2004 年 6 月 24 日創立，總部位於新澤西州拉姆齊。

info.description: Astera Labs, Inc. provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. The company offers a range of semiconductor-based connectivity solutions designed to address bandwidth, latency, and reliability challenges in AI and cloud data centers. The company was founded by Jitendra Mohan, Casey Morrison, and Sanjay Gajendra in October 2017 and headquartered in San Jose, CA.

GraniteShares 2x Long TSM Daily ETF seeks daily investment results of2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the ADR of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (NYSE: TSM). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

Fossil Group, Inc. engages in the design, marketing and distribution of consumer fashion accessories. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, and Asia. Its products include men's and women's fashion watches, jewelry, handbags, small leather goods, belts, sunglasses, shoes, soft accessories and clothing which are sold through department stores, specialty retail locations, specialty watch and jewelry stores, owned retail and factory outlet stores, mass market stores, owned, and affiliate internet sites. The company was founded by Tom Kartsotis in 1984 and is headquartered in Richardson, TX.
info.description_zh: Fossil Group, Inc. 從事消費時尚配件的設計、行銷和分銷。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲和亞洲。其產品包括男士和女士時尚手錶、珠寶、手袋、小皮具、皮帶、太陽眼鏡、鞋子、軟配件和服裝，透過百貨公司、專賣零售店、專賣手錶和珠寶店、自營零售店和工廠直銷店、大眾市場商店、自營和附屬網路網站銷售。該公司由 Tom Kartsotis 於 1984 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州理查森。

info.description: Amgen, Inc. is a biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and marketing of human therapeutics. The company was founded by William K. Bowes, Jr., Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr., George B. Rathmann, and Joseph Rubinfeld on April 8, 1980 and is headquartered in Thousand Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: 安進公司是一家生技公司，從事人類治療藥物的發現、開發、製造和行銷。該公司由 William K. Bowes, Jr.、Franklin Pitcher Johnson, Jr.、George B. Rathmann 和 Joseph Rubinfeld 於 1980 年 4 月 8 日創立，總部位於加州千橡市。

info.description: Satellogic, Inc. operates as a vertically integrated geospatial company. It is creating and continuously enhancing the first scalable, fully automated EO platform with the ability to remap the entire planet at both high-frequency and high-resolution, providing accessible and affordable solutions for customers. The company was founded by Emiliano Kargieman and Gerardo Richarte in July 2010 and is headquartered in Davidson, NC.
info.description_zh: Satellogic, Inc. 是一家垂直整合的地理空間公司。它正在創建並不斷增強第一個可擴展、全自動的 EO 平台，能夠以高頻和高解析度重新繪製整個地球，為客戶提供易於使用且價格合理的解決方案。該公司由 Emiliano Kargieman 和 Gerardo Richarte 於 2010 年 7 月創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州戴維森。

info.description: Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc. owns and operates a Major League Baseball (MLB) club. It operates through the Baseball and Mixed-Use Development segments. The Baseball segment includes its operations relating to the Braves baseball franchise and Truist Park and includes revenue generated from ticket sales, concessions, local broadcasting rights, advertising sponsorships, suites, and premium seat fees, retail and licensing revenue, shared MLB revenue streams, including national broadcasting rights and licensing, and other sources. Ticket sales, concessions, broadcasting rights and advertising sponsorship sales are the baseball segment's primary revenue drivers. The Mixed-Use Development segment includes retail, office, hotel and entertainment operations within The Battery Atlanta. The Battery Atlanta derives revenue primarily from office and retail rental income including overage rent and tenant reimbursements and, to a lesser extent, parking and advertising sponsorships. The company was founded on December 7, 2022 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: 亞特蘭大勇士控股公司 (Atlanta Braves Holdings, Inc.) 擁有並經營美國職棒大聯盟 (MLB) 俱樂部。它透過棒球和混合用途開發部門運作。棒球部門包括與勇敢者棒球特許經營權和Truist Park相關的業務，包括門票銷售、特許權、當地廣播權、廣告贊助、套房和高級座位費、零售和許可收入、共享MLB收入流（包括國家廣播權和許可）以及其他來源產生的收入。門票銷售、優惠、轉播權和廣告贊助銷售是棒球業務的主要收入來源。混合用途開發部門包括亞特蘭大砲台內的零售、辦公室、飯店和娛樂業務。亞特蘭大砲台的收入主要來自辦公室和零售租金收入，包括超額租金和租戶報銷，以及較小程度的停車和廣告贊助。該公司成立於2022年12月7日，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Ouster, Inc. engages in the provision of high resolution digital lidar sensors that offer advanced 3D vision to machinery, vehicles, robots, and fixed infrastructure assets. The company was founded by Angus Pacala and Mark Frichtl on June 30, 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Ouster, Inc. 致力於提供高解析度數位光達感測器，為機械、車輛、機器人和固定基礎設施資產提供先進的 3D 視覺。該公司由 Angus Pacala 和 Mark Frichtl 於 2015 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: AMETEK, Inc. engages in the manufacture of electronic instruments and electromechanical devices. It operates through the following segments: Electronic Instruments (EIG), Electromechanical (EMG), and Corporate. The EIG segment focuses on the design and manufacture of analytical, test, and measurement instruments for the process, aerospace, medical, research, power, and industrial markets. The EMG segment is involved in the design and manufacture of medical components and devices, automation solutions, thermal management systems, specialty metals, and electrical interconnects. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Berwyn, PA.

VanEck Biotech ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Biotech 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Biotech Index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the biotechnology industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Biotech ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市生物科技 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。生技指數包括美國交易所上市公司生技產業的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Southwest Airlines Co. engages in the operation and management of a passenger airline. The firm also offers ancillary services such as early bird check-in, upgraded boarding, and transportation of pets and unaccompanied minors. It operates in the United States, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, Mexico, Jamaica, the Bahamas, Aruba, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica, Belize, Cuba, the Cayman Islands, and Turks and Caicos. The company was founded by Rollin W. King and Herbert D. Kelleher on March 9, 1967 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: 西南航空有限公司從事客運航空公司的經營和管理。該公司還提供輔助服務，例如提前辦理登機手續、升級登機以及寵物和無人陪伴的未成年人的運輸。它在美國、波多黎各聯邦、墨西哥、牙買加、巴哈馬、阿魯巴、多明尼加共和國、哥斯達黎加、伯利茲、古巴、開曼群島以及特克斯和凱科斯群島開展業務。該公司由 Rollin W. King 和 Herbert D. Kelleher 於 1967 年 3 月 9 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州達拉斯。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Technology ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive technology companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性技術 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性科技公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AudioCodes Ltd. engages in the provision of communications software, products and productivity solutions for the digital workplace. The firm is involved in the development, manufacture, and market of products for transferring voice and data over the internet. Its products include products for Microsoft 365, session border controllers, multi-service business routers, meeting rooms, internet protocol phones, digital and analog media gateways, management products and solutions, and voice applications. The company was founded by Shabtai Adlersberg in 1992 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
info.description_zh: AudioCodes Ltd. 致力於為數位工作場所提供通訊軟體、產品和生產力解決方案。該公司從事透過網路傳輸語音和數據的產品的開發、製造和銷售。其產品包括Microsoft 365產品、會話邊界控制器、多服務業務路由器、會議室、網際網路協定電話、數位和類比媒體閘道、管理產品和解決方案以及語音應用程式。該公司由 Shabtai Adlersberg 於 1992 年創立，總部位於以色列 Or Yehuda。

info.description: VanEck Healthcare TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide uncapped, pure-play exposure to the U.S. healthcare sector by overcoming traditional diversification limits that often cap the weight of the largest industry leaders. The fund employs a "TruSector" hybrid structural approach, combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to ensure the portfolio's weights accurately reflect the true market-capitalization hierarchy of the healthcare industry, including its most dominant mega-cap constituents.
info.description_zh: VanEck Healthcare TruSector ETF 是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過克服傳統的多元化限制（通常會限制最大產業領導者的權重），為美國醫療保健產業提供無上限的純投資曝險。該基金採用「TruSector」混合結構方法，將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，以確保投資組合的權重準確反映醫療保健產業的真實市值等級，包括其最具主導地位的大股成分股。

info.description: Axcelis Technologies, Inc. engages in the manufacture of capital equipment for the semiconductor chip manufacturing industry. Its ion implantation systems product line includes high and medium current, and energy implanters. It also offers post-sales equipment service and support, such as spare parts, equipment upgrades, used equipment, maintenance services, and customer training. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Beverly, MA.

GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (TSM) ADR. By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤台積電 (TSM) ADR 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 表現的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: Embecta Corp. engages in the provision of medical devices used in the treatment of diabetes. Its products include pen needles, syringes, and safety devices complemented by a digital application. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Parsippany, NJ.

Mango Growth ETF is an actively managed ETF. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in the common stock of companies that the fund manager believes have high growth characteristics. The fund manager considers a company to have high growth characteristics if it demonstrates consistently strong year-over-year growth across multiple fundamental and market-based metrics. These may include, but are not limited to, sustained increases in sales, earnings, and cash flows, as well as positive share price trends over a specified evaluation period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 芒果成長ETF是主動式管理型ETF。該基金透過主要投資於基金經理人認為具有高成長特徵的公司的普通股來尋求長期資本增值。如果一家公司在多個基本面和基於市場的指標上表現出持續強勁的同比增長，基金經理就會認為該公司具有高成長特徵。這些可能包括但不限於銷售額、收益和現金流量的持續成長，以及在特定評估期間內積極的股價趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST HIMS ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Hims & Hers Health, Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded deliverd deliver 3個） of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎槓桿 ETF 作為參考資產的衍生品合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Applied Materials, Inc. engages in provision of materials engineering solutions used to produce semiconductors. The firm also focuses on design, development, production, and servicing of the critical wafer fabrication tools used for customers to manufacture semiconductors. It operates through the following segments: Semiconductor Systems and Applied Global Services (AGS). The Semiconductor Systems segment includes designing, development, manufacturing and sale of equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips referred to as integrated circuits. The AGS segment engages in provision of services, spares, and factory automation software to customer fabrication plants globally. The company was founded on November 10, 1967 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.

Angi, Inc. engages in the provision of a digital marketplace for home services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. and International. The company was founded on April 13, 2017 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

Democratic Large Cap Core ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Democratic Large Cap Core Index. The index is a subset of the S&P 500 Index designed to provide exposure to large capitalization companies that make political contributions to Democratic Party candidates and political action committees above a certain threshold. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of companies included in the index.
info.description_zh: 民主大盤核心 ETF 旨在追蹤民主大盤核心指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數是標準普爾 500 指數的子集，旨在為向民主黨候選人和政治行動委員會提供超過一定門檻的政治捐款的大型資本公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於指數所包含公司的證券。

info.description: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of companies that portfolio management believes will contribute to or benefit from artificial intelligence technologies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Janus Henderson Global Artificial Intelligence ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資組合管理認為將有助於人工智慧技術或受益於人工智慧技術的公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Fabless Semiconductor ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MarketVector US Listed Fabless Semiconductor Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Fabless Index is composed of U.S.-listed common stocks of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from the semiconductor industry and operate as fabless semiconductor companies. The fund is non-diversified.

Invesco PHLX Semiconductor ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the PHLX Semiconductor Sector Index . The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq compiles the underlying index, which is a modified market-capitalization weighted index designed to measure the performance of the 30 largest companies listed in the United States that are engaged in the semiconductor business, as determined by the index Provider. The fund is non-diversified.

iShares Semiconductor ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Semiconductor Index composed of U.S. equities in the semiconductor sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.

Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Semiconductor ESG Screened Index. The fund, using a "passive" or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index, which is comprised of companies that have business operations in the semiconductor industry and that fulfill certain sustainability criteria. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers Semiconductor Select Equity ETF 尋求與 Solactive Semiconductor ESG 篩選指數的表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金採用「被動」或指數投資方法，尋求與相關指數（未計費用和開支）的表現大致相對應的投資結果，該指數由在半導體行業開展業務並滿足某些可持續性標準的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Emmis Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL.
info.description_zh: Emmis Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年3月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州勞德代爾堡。

info.description: Social Commerce Partners Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Social Commerce Partners Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月11日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is an equal-weighted index composed of the securities comprising the NASDAQ-100 Index that are classified as "technology" according to the Industry Classification Benchmark classification system.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100-Technology Sector Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ-100 Technology Sector TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是一個等權重指數，由納斯達克 100 指數中根據行業分類基準分類系統歸類為「科技」的證券組成。

info.description: Emerson Electric Co. is a global technology and software company, which engages in the provision of solutions. It operates through the following segments: Final Control, Measurement and Analytical, Discrete Automation, Safety and Productivity, Intelligent Devices, and Software and Control. The Final Control segment focuses on providing control, isolation, shutoff, pressure relief, pressure safety valves, actuators, and regulators for process and hybrid industries. The Measurement and Analytical segment involves the instrumentation measuring the physical properties of liquids, gases, pressure, temperature, level, flow, acoustics, corrosion, pH, conductivity, water quality, toxic gases, and flame. The Discrete Automation segment includes solenoid, pneumatic, valve position indicators, pneumatic cylinders and actuators, air preparation equipment, pressure and temperature switches, electric linear motion solutions, programmable automation control systems and software, electrical distribution equipment, and materials joining solutions. The Safety and Productivity segment consists of pipe-working tools: pipe wrenches, pipe cutters, pipe threading and roll grooving equipment, battery hydraulic tools for press connections, drain cleaners, tubing tools and diagnostic systems, including sewer inspection cameras and locating equipment. The Software and Control segment processes by collecting and analyzing information from measurement devices in the plant and using that information to adjust valves, pumps, motors, drives, and other control hardware. The company was founded by Charles Meston and Alexander Meston on September 24, 1890, and is headquartered in St. Louis, MO.

Nordson Corp. engages in the engineering, manufacture and market of products and systems used for adhesives, coatings, sealants, biomaterials and other materials. It operates through the following segments: Industrial Precision Solutions, Medical and Fluid Solutions and Advanced Technology Solution. The Industrial Precision Solutions segment enhances the technology synergies between adhesive dispensing systems and industrial coating systems to deliver proprietary dispensing and processing technology to diverse end markets. The Medical and Fluid Solutions segment includes components and device solutions for medical, life science, high-tech industrial and other diverse end markets. The Advanced Technology Solution segment integrates proprietary product technologies found in progressive stages of a customer's production processes, such as surface treatment, precisely controlled dispensing of material and post-dispense test and inspection to ensure quality. The company was founded by Eric T. Nord, Evan W. Nord and Walter G. Nord in 1954 and is headquartered in Westlake, OH.
info.description_zh: Nordson Corp. 從事用於黏合劑、塗料、密封劑、生物材料和其他材料的產品和系統的工程、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：工業精密解決方案、醫療和流體解決方案以及先進技術解決方案。工業精密解決方案部門增強了黏合劑點膠系統和工業塗層系統之間的技術協同作用，為不同的終端市場提供專有的點膠和加工技術。醫療和流體解決方案部門包括用於醫療、生命科學、高科技工業和其他多元化終端市場的組件和設備解決方案。先進技術解決方案部門整合了客戶生產流程各個階段的專有產品技術，例如表面處理、精確控制的材料分配以及分配後測試和檢查，以確保品質。該公司由 Eric T. Nord、Evan W. Nord 和 Walter G. Nord 於 1954 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州韋斯特萊克。

info.description: NetApp, Inc. engages in the provision of software, systems, and services to manage and share data on-premises. The firm also offers private and public clouds worldwide. It operates through the Hybrid Cloud and Public Cloud segments. The Hybrid Cloud segment provides a data storage portfolio for storage management and infrastructure solutions. The Public Cloud segment refers to a portfolio of products delivered primarily as-a-service. The company was founded by David Hitz, James K. Lau, and Michael Malcolm in April 1992 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

Leverage Shares 2X Long ASML Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ASML. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to ASML, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ASML 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ASML 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 ASML 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CapsoVision, Inc. operates as a commercial-stage medical technology company. It engages in the development of imaging and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies that are deployed for endoscopy solutions to identify abnormalities of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract for diagnostic and screening purposes. The firm developed capsule endoscope system, currently comprising the CapsoCam Plus single-use capsule and the CapsoCloud and CapsoView software, to panoramically visualize the small-bowel mucosa to investigate abnormalities such as obscure GI bleeding and Crohn's disease. The company was founded by Kang-Huai Wang on August 1, 2005 and is headquartered in Saratoga, CA.

GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: Lindblad Expeditions Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of expedition cruising and travel services. It operates through the Lindblad and Natural Habitat segments. The Lindblad segment primarily includes sea-based expeditions. The Natural Habitat segment offers land-based, eco-conscious expeditions. The company was founded by Sven-Olof Lindblad on August 9, 2010 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Lindblad Expeditions Holdings, Inc. 从事提供探险巡航和旅行服务。它通过 Lindblad 和 Natural Habitat 部门运营。 Lindblad 部門主要包括海上探險。自然栖息地部分提供陆地、生态意识的探险活动。该公司由 Sven-Olof Lindblad 于 2010 年 8 月 9 日创立，总部位于纽约州纽约市。

info.description: Nyxoah SA is a medical technology company, which engages in the development and commercialization of solutions to treat Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA). Its solution platform is based on the Genio system, a CE-Mark validated, user-centered, bilateral neurostimulation therapy to treat moderate to severe OSA. The company was founded by Robert Taub and Adi Mashiach on July 15, 2009, and is headquartered in Mont-Saint-Guibert, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Nyxoah SA 是一家醫療技術公司，致力於治療阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症 (OSA) 解決方案的開發和商業化。其解決方案平台基於 Genio 系統，這是一種經過 CE 標誌驗證、以用戶為中心的雙側神經刺激療法，用於治療中度至重度 OSA。該公司由 Robert Taub 和 Adi Mashiach 於 2009 年 7 月 15 日創立，總部位於比利時 Mont-Saint-Guibert。

info.description: Orthofix Medical, Inc. develops and markets medical devices and biologic solutions for spine and orthopedic applications. The company operates through two reportable segments: Global Spine and Global Limb Reconstruction. The Global Spine segment offers two primary product categories: Bone Growth Therapies and Spinal Implants, Biologics, and Enabling Technologies. Bone Growth Therapies includes noninvasive stimulation devices used in spinal fusion and fracture-healing applications. Spinal Implants, Biologics, and Enabling Technologies includes a broad portfolio of spine fixation and motion-preservation products, biologic solutions, and image-guided surgical technologies used in spine procedures. The Global Limb Reconstruction segment provides products and solutions for limb reconstruction, deformity correction, fracture management, and other orthopedic conditions unrelated to the spine. The company was founded on October 19, 1987 and is headquartered in Lewisville, TX.

Seer, Inc. engages in the development of proprietary engineered nanoparticles to provide access across the proteome. Its Proteograph product suite consists of automation instruments and software, which provide a workflow to make proteomic profiling. The company was founded by Philip Ma, Robert S. Langer Jr. and Omid C. Farokhzad on March 16, 2017 and is headquartered in Redwood City, CA.
info.description_zh: Seer, Inc. 致力於開發專有的工程奈米粒子，以提供跨蛋白質組的存取。其 Proteograph 產品套件由自動化儀器和軟體組成，提供了進行蛋白質體分析的工作流程。該公司由 Philip Ma、Robert S. Langer Jr. 和 Omid C. Farokhzad 於 2017 年 3 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州雷德伍德市。

info.description: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of novel therapies for cancer. It also offers cancer treatments with surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy. The company was founded by Anatoly Dritschilo, Mira Jung, and Milton Brown on December 18, 2012 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於開發癌症新療法。它還提供手術、放射治療、化療和免疫治療等癌症治療方法。該公司由 Anatoly Dritschilo、Mira Jung 和 Milton Brown 於 2012 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州蓋瑟斯堡。

info.description: Stratasys Ltd. engages in the development of industrial grade additive solutions. It offers three-dimensional printers and parts, materials, and software. The company was founded on March 3, 1998 and is headquartered in Minnetonka, MN.
info.description_zh: Stratasys Ltd. 從事工業級添加劑解決方案的開發。它提供 3D 列印機以及零件、材料和軟體。該公司成立於1998年3月3日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼通卡。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long TER Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of TER. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of TER, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 TER 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 TER 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 TER 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Thayer Ventures Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Mark E. Farrell and Christopher Hemmeter on April 23, 2024 and is headquartered in Valencia, CA.
