info.description: Worth Charting Options Income ETF is an actively managed strategy that seeks to generate premium income through a short-term "strangle" options strategy executed on U.S. exchange-listed equities. The fund simultaneously sells uncovered call and put options to capture volatility risk premium while maintaining a collateral base of short-term U.S. Treasury securities and cash equivalents to support the derivative obligations and enhance total yield.

ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index (the "index"). The index, which is constructed and maintained by Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright), consists of 21 securities from the Nasdaq-100 Index with the highest price momentum. The fund will invest principally in the Equities and Depositary Receipts which principally include ADRs. It will concentrate or focus its investments in a particular industry or group of industries, country or region to approximately the same extent the index is so concentrated or focused. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 Dorsey Wright Momentum Index（「指數」）表現的投資結果。該指數由 Dorsey, Wright & Associates, LLC (Dorsey Wright) 建構和維護，由 Nasdaq-100 指數中價格動量最高的 21 種證券組成。該基金將主要投資於股票和存託憑證，其中主要包括美國存託憑證。它將把投資集中或集中在特定產業或產業組、國家或地區，其程度與指數的集中程度大致相同。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TCW Compounders ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks to invest in the companies that the Adviser believes will benefit from transformation as a result of technological innovations, market dynamics, and/or changes in client preferences. It aims to actively capture returns from companies that show long-term growth, quality, and durability characteristics as a result of such economic transformation or play a central role of enabling other companies to do the same. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TCW Compounders ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在投資顧問認為將因技術創新、市場動態和/或客戶偏好變化而從轉型中受益的公司。它的目標是積極獲取那些因經濟轉型而表現出長期成長、品質和持久特徵的公司的回報，或是在使其他公司也能做到這一點方面發揮核心作用的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Thornburg International Growth ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund adviser expects to invest primarily in equity securities or depositary receipts of non-U.S. developed market issuers selected for their growth potential. Thornburg, the fund's investment adviser, intends to invest in companies that it believes have growth characteristics, such as growing revenues and earnings or the prospect for such growth in revenues or earnings. The fund can invest in companies of any size, from larger, well-established companies to smaller, emerging growth companies. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Thornburg International Growth ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金顧問預計將主要投資於根據成長潛力而選擇的非美國已開發市場發行人的股本證券或存託憑證。該基金的投資顧問桑伯格打算投資於它認為具有成長特徵的公司，例如收入和收益不斷增長或收入或收益有成長前景的公司。該基金可以投資任何規模的公司，從大型、成熟的公司到小型、新興的成長型公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to track the performance of the index. The index is composed of the common stock of large capitalization U.S. companies. The index is constructed by evaluating the components of the index, using the Russell IdealRatings system, to identify companies that comply with Shariah principles. These ratings were developed based on the AAOFI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Manzil Russell Halal USA Broad Market ETF 旨在追蹤 Russell IdealRatings Manzil Halal USA Broad Market Custom Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」的方式來追蹤指數的表現。該指數由大型美國公司的普通股組成。該指數是透過使用 Russell IdealRatings 系統評估該指數的組成部分來建構的，以識別符合伊斯蘭教法原則的公司。這些評級是根據 AAOFI 制定的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: State Street My2027 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a target maturity strategy, primarily investing in high-yield corporate bonds scheduled to mature in 2027. The fund utilizes a bottom-up security selection process to overweight attractive sectors and issuers while seeking to maximize current income and preserve capital as it approaches its planned liquidation date on or about December 15, 2027.

JPMorgan Equity And Options Total Return ETF seeks to provide total return. To implement its investment objective, the fund manager uses a multi-pronged approach to total return, sourced from dividends, options premium and capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and call options on S&P 500 ETFs or on the index.

Nomura Transformational Technologies ETF is an actively managed fund targeting capital growth by investing in global technology companies at the forefront of secular shifts and disruptive innovations. The strategy emphasizes a bottom-up stock selection process to identify businesses across any market capitalization that demonstrate high barriers to entry and the potential for rapid earnings growth relative to the broader economy.
info.description_zh: 野村轉型技術 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資處於長期變革和顛覆性創新前沿的全球科技公司來實現資本成長。該策略強調自下而上的選股流程，以識別任何市值的企業，這些企業表現出較高的進入障礙以及相對於更廣泛的經濟而言具有快速盈利增長潛力的企業。

info.description: STF Tactical Growth ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its investments among a combination of (i) U.S. equity securities or ETFs that, in the aggregate, seek to replicate the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "Index Allocation"), (ii) directly in, or in ETFs that hold, long-duration U.S. Treasury securities (the "Fixed Income Allocation"), and (iii) short-term U.S. Treasury bills, money market funds, and cash and/or cash equivalents (the "Cash Equivalents"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STF Tactical Growth ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一款主動管理型 ETF，旨在透過將其投資分配到以下組合中來實現其投資目標：(i) 總體而言旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數的美國股本證券或 ETF（「指數配置」），(ii) 直接投資或持有長期美國國債的 ETF（「固定收益配置」），以及 (iii) 短期貨幣基金等價物、現金、現金、現金、現金、現金等價物或現金（現金或現金基金等現金、現金或現金基金等現金（它是非多元化的。

info.description: Cabana Target Leading Sector Moderate ETF seeks to provide long-term growth. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily by allocating its assets among ETFs that invest in securities of companies in the various sectors of the U.S. market: communication services, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, health care, industrials, information technology, materials, real estate, and utilities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target 領先產業溫和 ETF 尋求提供長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過將其資產分配給投資於美國市場各行業公司證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標：通訊服務、非必需消費品、必需消費品、能源、金融、醫療保健、工業、資訊科技、材料、房地產和公用事業。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Momentum Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The Adviser expects that, over time, if it has sufficient assets, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index, before fees and expenses, will be 95% or better. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Momentum Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Momentum Index 的總回報表現大致相對應的投資結果。一般情況下，基金總資產至少80%會投資於指數成分證券。顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，如果擁有足夠的資產，在扣除費用和開支之前，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Yield ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified strategy designed to deliver consistent monthly income and total return by combining a long equity portfolio of Nasdaq-listed stocks with a proprietary options overlay. The fund utilizes a data science-driven investment approach to construct its equity holdings while selling call option spreads to generate premiums, aiming to provide a significant portion of the Nasdaq 100 Index's returns with lower overall volatility.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收益 ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化策略，旨在透過將納斯達克上市股票的長期股票投資組合與專有選擇權疊加相結合，提供穩定的每月收入和總回報。該基金利用數據科學驅動的投資方法來建立其股票持有量，同時出售看漲期權價差以產生溢價，旨在以較低的整體波動性提供納斯達克100指數回報的很大一部分。

info.description: Vaneck Robotics ETF seeks to track as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the BlueStar Robotics Index (the "index"). The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in Robotics Companies. The index is comprised of equity securities, which may include depositary receipts of global exchange-listed companies in the robotics industry. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vaneck Robotics ETF 力求在費用和支出之前盡可能密切地追蹤 BlueStar Robotics Index（「指數」）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於機器人公司。該指數由股本證券組成，其中可能包括機器人產業全球交易所上市公司的存託憑證。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Single Stock Universe ETF seeks current income and pay weekly distributions. The Fund is a "fund of funds," meaning that it primarily invests its assets in the shares of other ETFs, rather than in securities of individual companies. The Fund's portfolio will be primarily composed of "YieldBOOST ETFs," which are all affiliated ETFs advised by GraniteShares Advisors LLC (the "Adviser") (each, an "Underlying YieldBOOST ETF"). Each of the Underlying YieldBOOST ETFs in which the Fund may invest has for objective to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on an "Underlying Stock" by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock (the "Underlying ETF"). The Underlying YieldBoost ETF's secondary investment objective is to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. Each Underlying YieldBoost ETF may implement a downside protection which could affect the net income level.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Single Stock Universe ETF 尋求當前收入並支付每週分配。該基金是“基金中的基金”，這意味著它主要將其資產投資於其他 ETF 的股票，而不是個別公司的證券。該基金的投資組合將主要由「YieldBOOST ETF」組成，這些都是由 GraniteShares Advisors LLC（「顧問」）提供諮詢服務的附屬 ETF（每個都是「基礎 YieldBOOST ETF」）。本基金可能投資的每隻標的 YieldBOOST ETF 的目標是透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現出售「標的股票」選擇權所產生的收入的 2 倍 (200%)，該基金旨在實現標的股票（「標的 ETF」）每日表現的 2 倍（200%）。標的 YieldBoost ETF 的次要投資目標是獲得標的 ETF 表現的投資機會，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。每個基礎 YieldBoost ETF 可能會實施下行保護，這可能會影響淨收入水準。

info.description: Amana Growth ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital growth by investing at least 80% of its total net assets in growth-oriented common stocks of domestic and foreign companies selected in accordance with Islamic principles. The fund targets financially sustainable companies characterized by low debt, strong balance sheets, and robust management strength, applying past earnings and revenue growth rates alongside future expansion expectations to construct a non-diversified, large-cap focused portfolio.
info.description_zh: Amana Growth ETF是一檔主動式管理基金，透過將至少80%的總淨資產投資於根據伊斯蘭原則挑選的國內外公司的成長型普通股來尋求長期資本成長。該基金針對以低債務、穩健的資產負債表和強大的管理實力為特徵的財務可持續公司，利用過去的盈利和收入增長率以及未來的擴張預期來構建非多元化、以大盤股為重點的投資組合。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST RGTI ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Rigetti Computing, Inc.'s common stock (NYSE: RGTI) (the "Underlying Stock"); to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains is a secondary consideration. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pay weekly distributions by selling put options on the Underlying Leveraged ETF, which provides exposure to 2 times the daily performance of the Underlying Stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST RGTI ETF 尋求實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收入是出售 Rigetti Computer, Inc. 普通股（NYSE：RGTI）（「基礎股票」）選擇權所產生的收入；獲得潛在投資收益上限的基礎槓桿ETF的表現是次要考慮因素。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過出售基礎槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權來支付每週分配，該 ETF 提供的曝險是基礎股票每日表現的 2 倍。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Actively managed ETF seeking long-term capital growth by investing in US large-cap growth stocks selected through JPMorgan's fundamental data science investment process.

SGI Dynamic Tactical ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF and invests in securities of affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs and open-end mutual funds. The fund may allocate among major equity asset classes and sectors, within the underlying funds, of the U.S., foreign and emerging markets equity of any capitalization.
info.description_zh: SGI 動態戰術 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，投資於附屬和非附屬 ETF 以及開放式共同基金的證券。該基金可以在基礎基金內的美國、外國和新興市場任何資本的股票的主要股票資產類別和部門之間進行配置。

info.description: Defiance Nasdaq 100 Income Target ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cboe QDIV ATM BuyWrite Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the constituent securities of the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of a theoretical portfolio that employs a covered call strategy, as determined by Cboe Global Indices, LLC. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Nasdaq 100 Income Target ETF 尋求提供與 Cboe QDIV ATM BuyWrite 指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於基礎指數的成分證券。基礎指數衡量採用有擔保買權策略的理論投資組合的表現，由 Cboe Global Indices, LLC 決定。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SGI Enhanced Nasdaq-100 ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. Under normal market circumstances, seeks to achieve its objective by (1) investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity investments of companies that, at the time of investment, are included in the NASDAQ-100 Index and/or options, ETFs or options on ETFs that seek to replicate the returns of the Index, and (2) investing in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SGI 增強型納斯達克 100 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場情況下，尋求透過以下方式實現其目標：(1) 將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於在投資時納入 NASDAQ-100 指數和/或尋求複製指數回報的期權、ETF 或 ETF 期權的公司的股權投資，以及 (2) 投資於尋求產生當前收入的期權策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Quantum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Quantum Computing and Machine Learning Index (the "index"). The fund uses a "passive management" (or indexing) approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a modified equal-weighted portfolio of the stock of companies that derive at least 50% of their annual revenue or operating activity from the development of quantum computing and machine learning technology.
info.description_zh: Defiance Quantum ETF 旨在追蹤藍星量子計算和機器學習指數（「指數」）扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」（或指數化）方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由經過修改的等權重公司股票投資組合組成，這些公司的年收入或營運活動至少有 50% 來自量子計算和機器學習技術的發展。

info.description: Rectitude Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of safety equipment. The firm offers personal protective clothing, hand gloves, safety footwear, personal fall arrest systems, portable fire extinguishers, and traffic products such as rubber speed humps, wheel stops, and wheel chocks. It also provides industrial hardware tools and electrical hardware for construction sites. The company was founded on June 1, 2023, and is headquartered in Singapore.

Goldman Sachs Enhanced U.S. Equity ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities issued by small-, mid- and large-cap U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: 高盛增強型美國股票 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於美國小型、中型和大型公司發行的股本證券。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio will be technology companies or companies that rely heavily on technological advances. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大型核心 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券將是科技公司或嚴重依賴技術進步的公司。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF seeks to provide current income with consideration for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by employing a targeted outcome strategy that is intended to optimize, in the opinion of Fund management, premium income generation and the potential for capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market. Investments in derivatives are counted toward the fund's 80% policy to the extent that they provide investment exposure to the securities included within that policy or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF 旨在提供當前收入，同時考慮資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用有針對性的結果策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在根據基金管理層的意見優化保費收入的產生和資本增值的潛力。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於納斯達克股票市場上市的股票證券。衍生性商品投資計入基金的 80% 保單，只要它們提供對該保單中包含的證券或與此類證券相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的投資曝險。

info.description: Eaton Corp. Plc is a power management company, which provides energy-efficient solutions for electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical power. It operates through the following segments: Electrical Americas and Electrical Global; Aerospace, Vehicle, and eMobility. The Electrical Americas and Electrical Global segments engage in sales contracts for electrical components, industrial components, power distribution and assemblies, residential products, single and three phase power quality, wiring devices, circuit protection, utility power distribution, power reliability equipment, and service. The Aerospace segment supplies aerospace fuel, hydraulics, and pneumatic systems for commercial and military use. The Vehicle segment deals with the design, manufacture, marketing, and supply of drivetrain and powertrain systems and critical components that reduce emissions and improve fuel economy, stability, performance and safety of cars, light trucks and commercial vehicles. The eMobility segment designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies electrical and electronic components and systems that improve the power management and performance of both on-road and off-road vehicles. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 伊頓公司是一家電力管理公司，為電力、液壓和機械動力提供節能解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global；航空航太、車輛和電動車。 Electrical Americas 和 Electrical Global 部門從事電氣元件、工業元件、配電和組件、住宅產品、單相和三相電能品質、接線設備、電路保護、公用配電、電力可靠性設備和服務的銷售合約。航空航太部門提供商業和軍事用途的航空燃料、液壓和氣動系統。車輛部門從事傳動系統和動力系統以及關鍵部件的設計、製造、行銷和供應，以減少排放並提高轎車、輕型卡車和商用車的燃油經濟性、穩定性、性能和安全性。電動交通部門設計、製造、行銷和供應電氣和電子元件及系統，以改善公路和越野車輛的電源管理和性能。該公司成立於1911年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 100 securities from an eligible universe of approximately 1,000 securities of the largest constituents by market capitalization within the NASDAQ US Benchmark Index.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technical Leaders Index 的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由約 100 檔證券組成，這些證券來自納斯達克美國基準指數中市值最大的成分股的約 1,000 只合格證券。

info.description: Jpmorgan Equity Focus ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities. "Assets" means net assets, plus the amount of borrowings for investment purposes. In implementing its main strategies, the fund invests primarily in common stocks and real estate investment trusts (REITs), but it may also invest up to 20% of its total assets in common stocks of foreign companies, including depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通股票焦點 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。一般情況下，基金至少80%的資產投資於股本證券。 「資產」指淨資產加上用於投資目的的借款金額。在實施其主要策略時，該基金主要投資於普通股和房地產投資信託基金（REIT），但也可能將其總資產的最多20%投資於外國公司的普通股，包括存託憑證。

info.description: Goldman Sachs MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker Index (Net, USD, Unhedged). The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in securities included in its underlying index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The index seeks to approximate the returns of private equity investments by replicating region, sector and style exposures through publicly listed equities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤 ETF 力求提供在費用和開支之前與 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤指數（淨值、美元、未對沖）表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於其標的指數中包含的證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該指數旨在透過公開上市股票複製地區、行業和風格的風險敞口來估算私募股權投資的回報率。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of issuers outside the U.S. that the fund's sub-adviser, Astoria Portfolio Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") believes has the potential for growth.
info.description_zh: Astoria US Quality Growth Kings ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國境外發行人的股本證券（包括存託憑證）來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問 Astoria Portfolio, LLC（「顧問」具有成長潛力）。

info.description: IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of its underlying index, the IQ Global Equity R&D Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index seeks to provide exposure to innovative companies by investing in the equities of companies that have high research and development ("R&D") spending around the world. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the investments included in its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IQ 全球股票研發領袖 ETF 尋求與其標的指數 IQ 全球股票研發領袖指數（「標的指數」）的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）相對應的結果。該指數旨在透過投資全球研發（「R＆D」）支出較高的公司的股票來提供對創新公司的投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於其基礎指數中包含的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform 500 ETF seeks investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of Morningstar US Large Cap Select Index composed of large-capitalization U.S. equities. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index or in depositary receipts representing component securities in the underlying index. The underlying index targets the largest 500 U.S. stocks by market capitalization and weights them by float-adjusted market capitalization.
info.description_zh: Engine No. 1 Transform 500 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前與由大盤美國股票組成的晨星美國大盤精選指數表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於相關指數的組成證券或代表相關指數組成證券的存託憑證。基礎指數以市值最大的 500 隻美國股票為目標，並以流通市值對其進行加權。

info.description: Delta Air Lines, Inc. engages in the provision of scheduled air transportation for passengers and cargo. It operates through the Airline and Refinery segments. The Airline segment provides scheduled air transportation for passengers and cargo. The Refinery segment provides jet fuel to the airline segment. The company was founded by Collett Everman Woolman in 1928 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.

iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The underlying index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of U.S. companies that have favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics (as determined by the index provider), while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI USA Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。標的指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵（由指數提供者確定）的美國公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 美國指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: BlackRock Large Cap Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in large cap equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, large cap equity securities are equity securities that at the time of purchase have a market capitalization within the range of companies included in the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德大盤成長 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少80%的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於大盤股證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。就基金的 80% 政策而言，大盤股證券是指購買時市值處於 Russell 1000 Growth Index 所包含公司範圍內的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Automation ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive automation companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性自動化 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性自動化公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Growth Opportunities ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity securities. Although it invests primarily in publicly traded U.S. securities, it may invest up to 20% of its Net Assets in foreign securities, including securities of issuers in countries with emerging markets or economies ("emerging countries") and securities quoted in foreign currencies. The fund may invest in companies of any market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛成長機會 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於股本證券。儘管其主要投資於公開交易的美國證券，但最多可將其淨資產的 20% 投資於外國證券，包括新興市場或經濟體國家（「新興國家」）發行人的證券以及以外幣報價的證券。該基金可以投資於任何市值的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree U.S. Adaptive Moving Average Fund utilizes a systematic trend-following overlay to dynamically allocate between U.S. large-cap equities and U.S. Treasury bills based on prevailing market momentum. The strategy is designed to provide full equity participation during uptrends while proactively reducing net exposure and shifting to cash equivalents during periods of high volatility or downward price trends to mitigate significant drawdowns.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree美國自適應移動平均基金利用系統性趨勢追蹤疊加，根據當前市場勢頭在美國大盤股和美國國債之間進行動態配置。該策略旨在在上漲趨勢期間提供全面的股權參與，同時在高波動或價格下跌趨勢期間主動減少淨敞口並轉向現金等價物，以減輕大幅回撤。

info.description: Sapient Quality Select ETF is an actively managed fund that targets U.S. equities by identifying companies exhibiting a convergence of high-quality financial characteristics and robust growth potential. The investment process utilizes a proprietary framework to screen for businesses with above-average profitability, strong management profiles, and attractive valuations, specifically focusing on entities positioned to benefit from long-term economic catalysts or transformative market themes.
info.description_zh: Sapient Quality Select ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過識別具有高品質財務特徵和強勁成長潛力的公司來瞄準美國股票。投資流程利用專有框架來篩選獲利能力高於平均水平、管理能力強且估值有吸引力的企業，特別關注那些能夠從長期經濟催化劑或變革性市場主題中受益的實體。

info.description: Veeco Instruments, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and support of semiconductor process equipment. Its technologies consist of metal organic chemical vapor deposition, advanced packaging lithography, wet etch and clean, laser annealing, ion beam, molecular beam epitaxy, wafer inspection, and atomic layer deposition systems. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Plainview, NY.

abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its objective by investing primarily in equity securities of small non-U.S. companies. Equity securities include, but are not limited to, common stock, preferred stock and depositary receipts. As a non-fundamental policy, under normal market conditions, it will invest at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of non-U.S. small companies.
info.description_zh: abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金尋求透過主要投資於小型非美國公司的股本證券來實現其目標。股本證券包括但不限於普通股、優先股及存託憑證。作為一項非基本面政策，在正常市場條件下，它將把至少80%的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款，投資於非美國小公司的股本證券。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity 4 ETF is an actively managed ETF that seeks broad-based exposure to the U.S. equity market through direct investments in U.S. companies with market capitalizations of $1 billion or greater, as well as investments in other ETFs offering similar exposure. The fund employs a systematic dividend-timing strategy designed to evaluate and potentially replace holdings prior to their ex-dividend dates to capture short-term supply/demand price imbalances while minimizing taxable income distributions.

First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: First Trust RiverFront Dynamic Emerging Markets ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in a portfolio of equity securities of emerging market companies, including through investments in common stock, depositary receipts, and common and preferred shares of real estate investment trusts, and forward foreign currency exchange contracts and currency spot transactions used to hedge the fund's exposure to the currencies in which the equity securities of such emerging market companies are denominated. The fund may invest in small, mid and large capitalization companies.

Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index ("Broad Markets Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index（「Broad Markets Index」或「Index」）的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is an exchange traded fund launched by Opal Capital LLC. It is managed by Vident Asset Management. It invests in public equity markets of United States. It invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. The fund employs quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity Etf is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 是 Opal Capital LLC 推出的交易所交易基金。它由 Vident 資產管理公司管理。它投資於美國公共股票市場。它投資於多元化行業的公司股票。它投資於多元化市值公司的成長型股票和價值型股票。該基金採用定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Disciplined Us Equity ETF 註冊地為美國。

info.description: HCM Large Cap Growth ETF is an actively managed fund constructed utilizing a proprietary quantitative multi-factor modeling process to identify high-conviction large-cap stocks and sectors within the Russell 1000 Index universe based on fundamental and technical ranking metrics. The investment strategy overweights highly ranked broad market sectors and focuses allocations on individual equities falling within the top quartile of its systemic scores, supplemented by subjective macroeconomic and risk management analysis from the adviser's investment committee.
info.description_zh: HCM 大盤成長 ETF 是一款主動管理基金，利用專有的定量多因素建模流程構建，根據基本面和技術排名指標識別羅素 1000 指數範圍內高可信度的大盤股和板塊。此投資策略超重排名靠前的廣泛市場板塊，並將配置重點放在系統得分前四分之一的個股上，並輔以顧問投資委員會的主觀宏觀經濟和風險管理分析。

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF seeks calendar month investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar month performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund will enter into one or more swaps with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Monthly ETF 尋求不計費用和開支的日曆月投資結果，相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆月業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆月表現提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金將與全球主要金融機構進行一項或多項掉期，其中該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在 Invesco QQQ Trust 上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Shares seeks investment results before fees and expenses that track the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its assets in the securities that comprise the index or investments with economic characteristics similar to the securities included in the index. The index is the equal weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes approximately 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the NASDAQ Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion NASDAQ-100 等權重指數股票尋求追蹤 NASDAQ-100 等權重指數的未計費用和開支的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於指數所包含的證券或與指數所包含的證券具有相似經濟特徵的投資。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克股票市場上市的約 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Technology ETF seeks to provide long-term capital growth. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investments purposes) in securities of companies that the Advisor expects to generate a majority of their revenue from technology or enablement through technology. The fund's managers consider technology enabled companies as those whose competitive edge and/or market share are largely based on their technology capabilities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Technology ETF 尋求提供長期資本成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於顧問預計大部分收入來自技術或透過技術實現的公司的證券。該基金的經理人認為，技術驅動型公司的競爭優勢和/或市佔率很大程度上取決於其技術能力。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Baron Technology ETF invests in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of U.S. and non-U.S. technology companies of any market capitalization, selected for their durable growth potential from the development, advancement and use of technology, however, investments in non-U.S. securities are limited to 35% of the Fund's total assets at the time of purchase. Technology companies may be located anywhere in the world, including developing countries. A developing country is a country included in the MSCI Emerging Markets (EM) Index and other countries determined by the Adviser to be developing countries based on classifications made by the International Monetary Fund or on country characteristics similar to those of the countries in the EM Index. BAMCO seeks to invest in businesses it believes have significant opportunities for growth, sustainable competitive advantages, exceptional management, and an attractive valuation.
info.description_zh: Baron Technology ETF 投資於任何市值的美國和非美國科技公司的股本證券（包括存託憑證），因其在技術開發、進步和使用方面的持久增長潛力而被選擇，但對非美國證券的投資僅限於購買時基金總資產的 35%。科技公司可能位於世界任何地方，包括發展中國家。發展中國家是指納入 MSCI 新興市場 (EM) 指數的國家以及顧問根據國際貨幣基金組織的分類或根據與新興市場指數國家類似的國家特徵確定為發展中國家的其他國家。 BAMCO 尋求投資於它認為具有重大成長機會、可持續競爭優勢、卓越管理和有吸引力估值的企業。

info.description: Infrastructure Capital Nasdaq Option Income ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that combines a long equity portfolio with dynamic options overlays to generate high monthly distribution returns while preserving capital appreciation potential. The fund utilizes a top-down macroeconomic framework to selectively buy and write short-duration put and call options alongside an actively managed, value-tilted stock portfolio that mirrors the economic risk profile of the Nasdaq Composite Index.
info.description_zh: 基礎設施資本納斯達克選擇權收益 ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，將長期股票投資組合與動態選擇權疊加相結合，產生高月度分配回報，同時保留資本增值潛力。該基金利用自上而下的宏觀經濟框架，選擇性地購買和賣出短期看跌期權和看漲期權，以及反映納斯達克綜合指數經濟風險狀況的積極管理、價值傾斜的股票投資組合。

info.description: Synopsys, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design automation (EDA) software that engineers use to design and test integrated circuits (ICs). It also offers semiconductor intellectual property (IP) products. It operates through the Design Automation and Design IP segments. The Design Automation segment includes silicon design, verification of products and services, and Ansys products, and system integration of products and services. The Design IP segment refers to interface, foundation, security, and embedded processor IP, IP subsystems, and IP implementation services that serve companies primarily in the semiconductor and electronics industries. The company was founded by Aart J. de Geus, Bill Krieger, Dave Gregory, and Rick Rudell in December 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Synopsys, Inc. 致力於提供工程師用來設計和測試積體電路 (IC) 的電子設計自動化 (EDA) 軟體。它還提供半導體知識產權（IP）產品。它透過設計自動化和設計 IP 部門運作。設計自動化部門包括晶片設計、產品和服務驗證、Ansys 產品以及產品和服務的系統整合。設計IP部分涉及介面、基礎、安全和嵌入式處理器IP、IP子系統和IP實施服務，主要為半導體和電子行業的公司提供服務。該公司由 Aart J. de Geus、Bill Krieger、Dave Gregory 和 Rick Rudell 於 1986 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Cabana Target Drawdown 7 ETF seeks to provide long-term growth within a targeted risk parameter. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective with limited volatility and reduced correlation to the overall performance of the equity markets by allocating its assets among the following five major asset classes - equities, fixed income securities, real estate, currencies, and commodities. The Sub-Adviser's target drawdown for the fund is 7%; however, there can be no assurance, and the fund, the Adviser, and the Sub-Adviser do not represent or guarantee, that this target will be maintained.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target Drawdown 7 ETF 尋求在目標風險參數範圍內提供長期成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過將資產配置在以下五個主要資產類別（股票、固定收益證券、房地產、貨幣和大宗商品）之間，以有限的波動性並降低與股票市場整體表現的相關性來實現其投資目標。副顧問對該基金的目標提款是 7%；然而，不能保證，並且基金、顧問和副顧問也不聲明或保證這一目標將會得到維持。

info.description: National Security Emerging Markets Index ETF seeks to track the results, before fees and expenses, of the Alerian National Security Emerging Markets Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index. The index consists of stocks listed on globally recognized stock exchanges that excludes companies benefiting end-users that, in the view of the sponsor of the fund, National Security Index, LLC (the "Sponsor") pose a threat to the national security interests of the United States.
info.description_zh: 國家安全新興市場指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 Alerian 國家安全新興市場指數（未計費用和開支）的結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的組成證券。該指數由在全球公認的證券交易所上市的股票組成，不包括使最終用戶受益的公司，該基金的發起人 National Security Index, LLC（「發起人」）認為這些公司對美國的國家安全利益構成威脅。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Future Vehicles & Technology ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Electric & Future Vehicle Ecosystem Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. To be eligible for inclusion in the index, a company must be listed on a major recognized stock exchange and engaged in one of the following sectors: electric and autonomous vehicle manufacturing; enabling technologies or enabling materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 未來車輛和技術 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 S-Network 電動和未來車輛生態系統指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。為了有資格納入該指數，公司必須在主要認可的證券交易所上市，並從事以下行業之一：電動和自動駕駛汽車製造；使能技術或使能材料。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TaoWeave, Inc. operates as a digital asset treasury company dedicated to Bittensor. It provides investors with a regulated, publicly traded vehicle to gain exposure to the decentralized AI economy. The company operates through the following business segments: Digital Assets, Managed Services, and Collaboration Products. The Digital Assets segment represents the business surrounding its treasury activity with Bittensor. The Managed Services segment represents the business surrounding managed services for video collaboration and network solutions. The Collaboration Products segment represents the business surrounding its Mezzanine product offerings. TaoWeave was founded in May 2000 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

KraneShares Artificial Intelligence and Technology ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, track the performance of the Solactive Etna Artificial General Intelligence Index. The underlying index is a modified, free float adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to measure the equity performance of companies in developed markets with exposure to AI businesses. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests principally in instruments in the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: KraneShares 人工智慧和技術 ETF 尋求提供在費用和支出之前追蹤 Solactive Etna 人工智慧指數表現的投資結果。基礎指數是經過修改的、自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場中從事人工智慧業務的公司的股票表現。在正常情況下，該基金主要投資於相關指數的工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Rocket Lab Corp. engages in the development of rocket launch and control systems for the space and defense industries. It operates through the Launch Services and Space Systems segments. The Launch Services segment provides launch services to customers on a dedicated mission or ride-share basis. The Space Systems segment consists of spacecraft engineering and design services, spacecraft components, spacecraft manufacturing, and on-orbit mission operations. The company was founded by Peter Beck in 2006 and is headquartered in Long Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: Rocket Lab Corp. 致力於為航太和國防工業開發火箭發射和控制系統。它透過發射服務和太空系統部門運作。發射服務部門為客戶提供專門任務或共乘服務的發射服務。太空系統部門包括太空船工程和設計服務、太空船零件、太空船製造和在軌任務運作。該公司由 Peter Beck 於 2006 年創立，總部位於加州長灘。

info.description: Dominari Holdings, Inc. engages in wealth management, investment banking, sales and trading, and asset management through its subsidiaries. It operates through the Dominari Financial and Legacy AIkido business segments. The Dominari Financial segment represents the company's broker-dealer business, which is composed of mostly underwriting and transactional service activities. The Legacy AIkido segment includes Aikido Labs, which manages the investments holdings of the legacy entity. The company was founded by Gilbert V. Levin and M. Karen Levin in 1967 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Dominari Holdings, Inc.透過其子公司從事財富管理、投資銀行、銷售和交易以及資產管理業務。它透過 Dominari Financial 和 Legacy AIkido 業務部門運作。 Dominari Financial 部門代表該公司的經紀自營商業務，主要由承銷和交易服務活動組成。傳統合氣道部門包括合氣道實驗室，該實驗室管理傳統實體的投資控股。該公司由 Gilbert V. Levin 和 M. Karen Levin 於 1967 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. designs, develops, and markets integrated power semiconductor solutions and power delivery architectures for computing and storage, automotive, industrial, communications, and consumer applications markets. The firm's products include portable electronic devices, wireless LAN access points, computers and notebooks, monitors, infotainment applications, and medical equipment. It operates through the following geographical segments: China, US, Taiwan, and Other. The company was founded by Michael R. Hsing, and James C. Moyer on August 22, 1997, and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. 為運算和儲存、汽車、工業、通訊和消費應用市場設計、開發和銷售整合式功率半導體解決方案和電力傳輸架構。該公司的產品包括便攜式電子設備、無線區域網路存取點、電腦和筆記型電腦、顯示器、資訊娛樂應用和醫療設備。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：中國、美國、台灣和其他地區。該公司由 Michael R. Hsing 和 James C. Moyer 於 1997 年 8 月 22 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: KraneShares Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the MerQube Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in instruments in its underlying index or in instruments that have economic characteristics similar to those in the index. The index is an equal weighted index designed to measure the performance of companies involved in the advancement of humanoid and embodied intelligence technology or acting as a supply chain solution for a humanoid and embodied intelligence company. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: KraneShares 全球類人生物和具體智慧指數 ETF 力求提供在未計費用和支出之前與 MerQube 全球類人生物和具體智慧指數大致對應的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於其標的指數中的工具或與指數中具有相似經濟特徵的工具。該指數是一個等權重指數，旨在衡量參與人形和實體智慧技術進步或為人形和實體智慧公司提供供應鏈解決方案的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 20%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index 的表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 的表現，並根據 20% 的目標年度波動率調整基礎 ETF 的投資曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer ActiveAlpha India Quality ETF is a concentrated equity strategy providing targeted exposure to Indian companies, specifically designed to capture the structural growth of the Indian economy through a rigorous, rules-based selection process. The fund employs a proprietary factor-based methodology that identifies and holds a limited portfolio of approximately 20 to 30 companies deemed to be of high quality, while simultaneously applying screens for value and momentum to optimize the risk-return profile.

Horizon Digital Frontier ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in equity securities of U.S. and foreign (non-U.S.) companies that offer exposure to emerging technologies that are in various phases of development. The fund's investments may include common stocks, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and securities of other ETFs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Digital Frontier ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過主要投資於美國和外國（非美國）公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，這些公司提供處於不同發展階段的新興技術的投資。該基金的投資可能包括普通股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和其他 ETF 的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Choice ESG Screened 5% Issuer Capped Index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization emerging market companies with favorable ESG ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EM ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場選擇 ESG 篩選 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 評級的大中型新興市場公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於指數成分證券以及與指數成分證券具有基本相同經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in equity securities economically tied to emerging markets countries. The fund principally invests in equity securities, including common stock and preferred stock, of emerging markets companies, and in depositary receipts representing shares in such companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv Emerging Markets Equity Active ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將其淨資產價值的至少80%加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與新興市場國家經濟相關的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場公司的股本證券，包括普通股和優先股，以及代表此類公司股份的存託憑證。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of companies that have favorable ESG characteristics, while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI Emerging Markets Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI EM ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场扩展 ESG 焦点指数的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好 ESG 特徵的公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 新興市場指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: Shopify, Inc. is a global commerce company that provides essential internet infrastructure for commerce, offering trusted tools to start, scale, market, and run a retail business of any size. The Company's software enables merchants to run their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts and marketplaces. The Shopify platform provides merchants with a single view of their business across all of their sales channels and enables them to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics and reporting and access financing, all from one integrated back office. The company was founded on September 28, 2004 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
info.description_zh: Shopify, Inc. 是一家全球商業公司，為商業提供必要的網路基礎設施，並提供值得信賴的工具來啟動、擴展、行銷和經營任何規模的零售業務。該公司的軟體使商家能夠在所有銷售管道上開展業務，包括網路和行動店面、實體零售店、社交媒體店面和市場。 Shopify 平台為商家提供了跨所有銷售管道的單一業務視圖，使他們能夠管理產品和庫存、處理訂單和付款、履行和發貨訂單、建立客戶關係、採購產品、利用分析和報告以及獲取融資，所有這些都透過一個整合後台進行。該公司成立於2004年9月28日，總部位於加拿大渥太華。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets Asia ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Asia Custom Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure equity market performance in the emerging market countries of Asia. The underlying index includes large- and mid-capitalization companies and may change over time.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新興市場亞洲 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 新興市場亞洲客製化上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。相關指數旨在衡量亞洲新興市場國家的股票市場表現。基礎指數包括大中型公司，並可能隨著時間的推移而變化。

info.description: iShares MSCI All Country Asia ex Japan ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI AC Asia ex Japan Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure equity market performance of securities from the following 10 developed and emerging market countries or regions: China, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI All Country Asia（日本除外）ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI AC Asia（日本除外）指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量以下 10 個已開發和新興市場國家或地區證券的股票市場表現：中國、香港、印度、印尼、馬來西亞、菲律賓、新加坡、韓國、台灣和泰國。

info.description: 8x8, Inc. engages in the provision of enterprise communication solutions. It offers solutions to the business services, education, financial services, government, healthcare, and manufacturing industries. The company was founded in February 1987 and is headquartered in Campbell, CA.
info.description_zh: 8x8, Inc. 從事提供企業通訊解決方案。它為商業服務、教育、金融服務、政府、醫療保健和製造業提供解決方案。該公司成立於 1987 年 2 月，總部位於加州坎貝爾。

info.description: iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that captures large- and mid-capitalization stocks across 23 of the 24 Emerging Markets countries, excluding China.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）ETF 旨在追踪 MSCI 新兴市场（中国除外）指数（“基础指数”）的投资结果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，涵蓋 24 個新興市場國家中 23 個國家（不包括中國）的大中型股票。

info.description: MarketWise, Inc. develops and operates a multi-brand digital subscription services platform. It is a subscription services platform that provides independent financial research, analytical tools, and software primarily to retail investors across digital channels. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Baltimore, MD.

BriaCell Therapeutics Corp. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development of novel immunotherapies to transform cancer care. It currently advancing its Bria-IMT targeted immunotherapy in combination with an immune check point inhibitor in a pivotal 1 Phase 3 study in metastatic breast cancer. The company was founded by Charles L. Wiseman and Isaac Benjamin Maresky on July 26, 2006 and is headquartered in West Vancouver, Canada.

Spear Alpha ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest primarily in equity securities, including common stock or American depositary receipts ("ADRs") of companies that Spear Advisors LLC (the "Adviser") believes are poised to benefit from breakthrough innovation in industrial technology. The Adviser defines "innovation in industrial technology" as those technological developments that are transforming or have the potential to transform the industrial sector. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Spear Alpha ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於股票證券，包括 Spear Advisors LLC（「顧問」）認為有望從工業技術突破性創新中受益的公司的普通股或美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。顧問將「工業技術創新」定義為那些正在改變或有潛力改變工業部門的技術發展。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews Emerging Markets Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。该基金是一只主动管理的交易所交易基金（“ETF”），旨在通过利用人工智能增强的投资策略来实现其投资目标。在正常情况下，该基金将至少80%的净资产（加上任何用于投资目的的借款金额）投资于美国上市大型资本公司的证券。

info.description: Nasdaq, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in trading, clearing, exchange technology, regulatory, securities listing, information, and public and private company services. It operates through the following segments: Capital Access Platforms, Financial Technology, and Market Services. The Capital Access Platforms segment delivers liquidity, transparency, and integrity to the corporate issuer and investment community by empowering clients to effectively navigate the capital markets, achieve their sustainability goals, and drive governance excellence. The Financial Technology segment offers platforms that improve the liquidity, transparency, and integrity of the global economy by architecting and operating the markets. The Market Services segment includes equity derivative trading and clearing, cash equity trading, fixed income, currency, and commodities trading. The company was founded by Gordon S. Macklin in 1971 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Growth Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets of growth companies.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前與 Victory International Growth 自由現金流指數的表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場成長型公司股票證券的投資。

info.description: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the IPOX  -100 Europe Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index seeks to measure the performance of the equity securities of the 100 largest and typically most liquid initial public offerings ("IPOs") (including spin-offs and equity carve-outs) of companies that are economically tied to Europe. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust IPOX Europe Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求與稱為 IPOX -100 Europe Index（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在衡量與歐洲經濟相關的 100 家規模最大且通常流動性最強的首次公開發行（「IPO」）（包括分拆和股權分拆）公司的股票表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ClearPoint Neuro, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of platforms for performing minimally invasive surgical procedures in the brain and heart. The firm conducts its procedures under direct, intra-procedural magnetic resonance imaging guidance. Its product platform consists of the ClearPoint system and ClearTrace system. The company was founded by Paul A. Bottomley on March 12, 1998 and is headquartered in Solana Beach, CA.
