info.description_zh: ClearPoint Neuro, Inc. 從事大腦和心臟微創外科手術平台的開發和商業化。該公司在直接的術中磁振造影指導下進行手術。其產品平台由ClearPoint系統及ClearTrace系統所組成。該公司由 Paul A. Bottomley 於 1998 年 3 月 12 日創立，總部位於加州索拉納海灘。

info.description: VegaShares SpaceX & Beyond Earth ETF seeks capital appreciation through active, non-diversified investments across the commercial space ecosystem, including exploration, launch infrastructure, satellite connectivity, and orbital AI networking. The fund holds global equity securities involved in building and utilizing the orbital infrastructure stack without tracking a specific benchmark.

The Vita Coco Co., Inc. produces, supplies and distributes coconut water. The firm offers coconut water, sparkling water, coconut milk, and oil products. It carries out its operations through its Americas and International segments. The Americas segment consists of the marketing and distribution of coconut and non-coconut water products in the US and Canada. The International segment includes the company's procurement arm and derives its revenues from the marketing and distribution of coconut water and non-coconut water products in Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. Its brands include Vita Coco, Runa, and Ever & Ever. The company was founded by Michael Kirban and Ira Liran in 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Alphabet, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in software, health care, transportation, and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets. The Google Services segment includes products and services, such as ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Google Maps, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. The Google Cloud segment refers to infrastructure and platform services, collaboration tools, and other services for enterprise customers. The Other Bets segment relates to the sale of healthcare-related services and internet services. The company was founded by Lawrence E. Page and Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin on October 2, 2015 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Alphabet, Inc. 是一家控股公司，業務涉及軟體、醫療保健、運輸和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：Google服務、Google雲端和其他賭注。 Google 服務部分包括廣告、Android、Chrome、裝置、Google 地圖、Google Play、搜尋和 YouTube 等產品和服務。 Google Cloud 部門是指為企業客戶提供基礎設施和平台服務、協作工具以及其他服務。其他投注部門涉及醫療保健相關服務和網路服務的銷售。該公司由 Lawrence E. Page 和 Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin 於 2015 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Alphabet, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in software, health care, transportation, and other technologies. It operates through the following segments: Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets. The Google Services segment includes products and services, such as ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Google Maps, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. The Google Cloud segment refers to infrastructure and platform services, collaboration tools, and other services for enterprise customers. The Other Bets segment relates to the sale of healthcare-related services and internet services. The company was founded by Lawrence E. Page and Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin on October 2, 2015 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Alphabet, Inc. 是一家控股公司，業務涉及軟體、醫療保健、運輸和其他技術。它透過以下部門運作：Google服務、Google雲端和其他賭注。 Google 服務部分包括廣告、Android、Chrome、裝置、Google 地圖、Google Play、搜尋和 YouTube 等產品和服務。 Google Cloud 部門是指為企業客戶提供基礎設施和平台服務、協作工具以及其他服務。其他投注部門涉及醫療保健相關服務和網路服務的銷售。該公司由 Lawrence E. Page 和 Sergey Mikhaylovich Brin 於 2015 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the IPOX  International Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is a market-cap weighted portfolio measuring the performance of the top 50 companies domiciled outside the United States ranked quarterly by market capitalization in the IPOX  Global Composite Index and represents, on average, 25% of the total market capitalization of the base index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust International Equity Opportunities ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 IPOX International Index 的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數是一個市值加權投資組合，衡量美國境外註冊的前 50 名公司的業績，按季度在 IPOX 全球綜合指數中的市值排名，平均佔基礎指數總市值的 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of innovative memory and storage solutions. It operates through the following segments: Cloud Memory Business Unit (CMBU), Core Data Center Business Unit (CDBU), Mobile and Client Business Unit (MCBU), and Automotive and Embedded Business Unit (AEBU). The CMBU segment focuses on memory solutions for large hyperscale cloud customers and High-Bandwidth Memory for all data center customers. The CDBU segment is involved in memory solutions for mid-tier cloud, enterprise, and OEM data center customers and storage solutions for all data center customers. The MCBU segment focuses on memory and storage solutions for the mobile and client segments. The AEBU segment is involved in memory and storage solutions for the automotive, industrial, and consumer segments. The company was founded by Ward D. Parkinson, Joseph Leon Parkinson, Dennis Wilson, and Doug Pitman on October 5, 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, ID.

AAON, Inc. engages in the engineering, manufacturing, marketing and sale of air conditioning and heating equipment. It operates through the following segments: Units, Parts-External, Parts-Internal, and Other. Its products include air handling units, self contained units, packaged rooftop units, geothermal heat units, controls, and coils. The company was founded by Norman H. Asbjornson on August 18, 1987 and is headquartered in Tulsa, OK.

EDAP TMS SA is a holding company, which, through its subsidiary, engages in the development, production, and marketing of minimally invasive medical devices for urological diseases. It operates through the High Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) and Urology Devices and Services (UDS) segments. The HIFU segment develops, manufactures, and markets devices for the minimally invasive ablation of certain types of localized tumors using HIFU technology. The UDS segment focuses on the development, marketing, manufacturing, and servicing of medical devices for the minimally invasive diagnosis or treatment of urological disorders, mainly urinary stones, and other clinical indications. The company was founded on December 3, 1979 and is headquartered in Vaulx-en-Velin, France.

Logitech International SA is a holding company, which engages in the design of software-enabled hardware solutions. Its portfolio includes gaming, keyboards and combos, pointing devices, video collaboration, webcams, tablet accessories, and headsets. Its cloud based services includes video conferencing platforms, esports or video games, music streaming platforms, content streaming platforms, and and creativity and productivity platforms. It enhances through software, including machine learning and artificial intelligence. The company was founded by Daniel Borel, Pierluigi Zappacosta, and Giacamo Marini on October 2, 1981 and is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.

GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the common stock of Palantir Technologies Inc. (NYSE: PLTR). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. It will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long PLTR Daily ETF 寻求每日投资收益（扣除费用和开支）为 Palantir Technologies Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PLTR）普通股的 2 倍（200%）。该基金是一种主动管理的交易所交易基金，试图通过签订标的股票掉期协议来复制标的股票每日百分比变化的两倍（200%）。它将与主要金融机构签订一份或多份互换协议，期限从一天到一年以上不等，根据该协议，基金和金融机构将同意交换标的股票赚取或实现的回报。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PLTR. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PLTR and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PLTR Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PLTR 每日表現的 200% 的每日投資表現（未計費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PLTR 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和期權，這些證券結合起來為 PLTR 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Viant Technology, Inc. is an advertising technology company, which develops and manages an enterprise software platform. The firm also offers Adelphic, an omnichannel demand-side platform which enables marketers to execute programmatic advertising campaigns. Its solutions include ViantAI, Demand Side Platform, Connected TV Advertising, Omnichannel marketing, and Data Platform. The company was founded by Timothy C. Vanderhook, Christopher John Vanderhook, and Russell T. Vanderhook in 1999 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Viant Technology, Inc. 是一家廣告科技公司，開發和管理企業軟體平台。該公司還提供 Adelphic，這是一個全通路需求方平台，使行銷人員能夠執行程式化廣告活動。其解決方案包括ViantAI、需求方平台、連網電視廣告、全通路行銷和數據平台。該公司由 Timothy C. Vanderhook、Christopher John Vanderhook 和 Russell T. Vanderhook 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long MRVL Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Marvell Technology, Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：MRVL）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過進入掉期和選擇權標的股票等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PLTR. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PLTR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支），為 PLTR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PLTR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long RKLB ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Rocket Lab USA, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long RKLB ETF 在尋求扣除費用和開支之前，Rocket Lab USA, Inc. 股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (“ETF”)，試圖透過採用衍生性商品，即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約，實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fangdd Network Group Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of real estate information services through its online platform. It also offers integrated marketing services for individual customers, real estate developers, and agents. The company was founded by Yi Duan, Xi Zeng, and Jian Cheng Li in October 2011 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 房多多網路集團有限公司是一家投資控股公司，透過其線上平台提供房地產資訊服務。它還為個人客戶、房地產開發商和代理商提供整合行銷服務。該公司由段毅、曾熙和李建成於2011年10月創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a bio-pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of branded and generic prescription pharmaceuticals. It operates through the Generics, Established Brands, and Other, and Rare Disease segments. The Generics, Established Brands, and Other segment consists of contract manufactured products, development services, royalties, and other. The Rare Disease segment involves the operations related to Cortrophin Gel. The company was founded on August 29, 1996 and is headquartered in Baudette, MN.

Maze Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in harnessing the power of human genetics to develop novel, small molecule precision medicines for patients living with renal, cardiovascular, and related metabolic, or CVRM diseases. Its pipeline includes the Compass platform, which allows it to identify and characterize genetic variants in disease and then link those variants to the biological pathways that drive disease in specific patient groups through a process to refer a variant functionalization. The company was founded by Mark Daly, Aaron D. Gitler, Stephen Elledge, Sekar Kathiresan, and Jonathan S. Weissman on August 29, 2017 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

Global-e Online Ltd. engages in the provision of cross-border e-commerce solutions. It offers Global-e Pro and Global-e enterprise. The firm enables merchants to increase the conversion of international traffic into sales by providing online shoppers across global destinations with a seamless, localized shopping experience. Global-e Online was founded by Shahar Tamari, Amir Schlachet, and Nir Debbi on February 21, 2013 and is headquartered in Petach Tikva, Israel.
info.description_zh: Global-e Online Ltd.從事提供跨境電子商務解決方案。它提供 Global-e Pro 和 Global-e enterprise。該公司為全球目的地的線上購物者提供無縫、在地化的購物體驗，幫助商家提高國際流量轉換為銷售額的能力。 Global-e Online 由 Shahar Tamari、Amir Schlachet 和 Nir ​​Debbi 於 2013 年 2 月 21 日創立，總部位於以色列佩塔提克瓦。

info.description: iShares MSCI China Multisector Tech ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI China Technology Sub-Industries Select Capped Index composed of Chinese equities in technology and technology-related industries. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 中國多板塊科技 ETF 旨在追蹤由中國科技及科技相關產業股票組成的 MSCI 中國科技次產業精選上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily SHOP Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of SHOP. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of SHOP and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to SHOP, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily SHOP Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 SHOP 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 SHOP 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 SHOP 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ACM Research, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of single-wafer wet cleaning equipment. It supplies process solutions that semiconductor manufacturers can use in numerous manufacturing steps to remove particles, contaminants and other random defects, and thereby improve product yield. The company tools can be used in fabricating foundry, logic and memory chips including dynamic random-access memory, or DRAM, and 3D NAND-flash memory chips. The company was founded by David H. Wang and Hui Wang in January 1998 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.

Cumberland Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company, which focuses on the acquisition, development, and commercialization of branded prescription pharmaceutical products. Its products include Acetadote, Caldolor, Kristalose, Omeclamox, Vaprisol, Vibativ, Sancuso, Boxaban, Vasculan. Dyscorban, and RediTrex. The company was founded by A. J. Kazimi on January 7, 1999 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.

EchoStar Corp. engages in the design, development, and distribution of digital set-top boxes and products for direct-to-home satellite service providers. It operates through the following business segments: Pay-TV, Wireless, Broadband and Satellite Services, and Other. The Pay-TV segment business strategy is to be the best provider of video services in the United States by providing products with the best technology, outstanding customer service, and great value. The Wireless segment offers Retail Wireless services as well as a competitive portfolio of wireless devices. The Broadband and Satellite Services segment business strategy is to maintain and improve leadership position and competitive advantage through development of technologies and services marketed to selected sectors within the consumer, enterprise and government markets globally. The Other segment consists of legacy 5G Network and 5G Network deployment operations that will not be utilized in the Wireless segment's Hybrid MNO business. The company was founded by Charlie William Ergen, Candy Ergen, and James DeFranco in 1980 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.

Canary XRP ETF seeks to provide exposure to the value of XRP held by the Trust, less the expenses of the Trust's operations and other liabilities and establish its net asset value ("NAV") by reference to the CoinDesk XRP CCIXber 60m New York Rate. The Trust intends to provide direct exposure to the value of XRP held by the Trust with Gemini Trust Company, LLC (the "Gemini Custodian") and BitGo Trust Company, Inc. The Gemini Custodian is a New York limited purpose trust company regulated by the New York Department of Financial Services that provides custody services for digital assets.
info.description_zh: Canary XRP ETF 旨在提供信託持有的 XRP 價值的曝險，減去信託營運費用和其他負債，並參考 CoinDesk XRP CCIXber 60m 紐約匯率確定其資產淨值（「NAV」）。該信託計劃與 Gemini Trust Company, LLC（「Gemini Custodian」）和 BitGo Trust Company, Inc. 直接接觸該信託持有的 XRP 價值。 Gemini Custodian 是一家受紐約金融服務部監管的紐約有限目的信託公司，為數位資產提供託管服務。

info.description: Veracyte, Inc. engages in the research, development and commercialization of diagnostic products. The firm's portfolio includes Afirma, Percepta, and Envisia. It intends to treat thyroid cancer, improve lung cancer screening, and clarify the diagnosis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Bonnie H. Anderson and Y. Douglas Dolginow on August 15, 2006 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Veracyte, Inc. 從事診斷產品的研究、開發和商業化。該公司的投資組合包括 Afirma、Percepta 和 Envisia。它旨在治療甲狀腺癌，改善肺癌篩檢，並明確特發性肺纖維化的診斷。該公司由 Bonnie H. Anderson 和 Y. Douglas Dolginow 於 2006 年 8 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: XRP ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily though managed exposure to XRP futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("XRP Futures Contracts"), and cash, cash-like instruments or high quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in XRP Futures Contracts ("Collateral Investments"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: XRP ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過管理 XRP 期貨合約（僅在商品期貨交易委員會註冊的交易所交易）（「XRP 期貨合約」）以及作為基金 XRP 期貨合約投資抵押品的現金、類現金工具或高品質證券（「抵押投資」）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long GOOGL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Alphabet Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: GOOGL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the Underlying Stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the Underlying Stock as well as directly purchasing the Underlying Stock. At the end of each trading day, the notional exposure against the Underlying Stock obtained through the combination of these instruments will be approximately 200% of the fund's net asset value.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long GOOGL Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Alphabet Inc. A 類普通股（納斯達克股票代碼：GOOGL）每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過基礎股票的掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買基礎股票來複製基礎股票每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。在每個交易日結束時，透過這些工具組合獲得的標的股票的名義曝險將約為基金資產淨值的200%。

info.description: Direxion Daily GOOGL Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of GOOGL. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned on an investment by the fund in GOOGL that is equal, on a daily basis, to 150% of the value of the fund's net assets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 GOOGL 牛市 1.5 倍股票尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 GOOGL 每日業績的 150%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，根據該協議，該基金和全球金融機構將同意交換該基金在 GOOGL 的投資所賺取的每日回報，該回報相當於該基金淨資產價值的 150%。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GSI Technology, Inc. engages in the design, development and marketing of memory products primarily for the networking, and telecommunications markets. Its product includes Static Random Access Memory, or SRAM, which incorporated in networking and telecommunications equipment, such as routers, switches, wide area network infrastructure equipment, wireless base stations and network access equipment. It also offers services to the ongoing needs of the military, industrial, test and measurement equipment, automotive and medical markets for SRAMs .The company was founded by Lee-Lean Shu and Robert Yau in March 1995 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.

Innoviz Technologies Ltd. engages in providing automotive-grade LiDAR sensor platforms. It offers its solutions to the aerospace, defense, and homeland security markets. The firm's products include InnovizOne, InnovizTwo Long-Range, InnovisTwo Short-to Mid-Range, InnovizThree, InnovizSMART, and InnovizTwo Ultra Long-Range (ULR). The company was founded by Omer David Keilaf, Oren Buskila, and Oren Rosenzweig on January 18, 2016 and is headquartered in Rosh HaAyin, Israel.

GDS Holdings Ltd. engages in developing and operating data centers in China. It builds, operates, and transfers data centers at other locations. Its data centers are carrier and cloud-neutral, which enable customers to connect to major telecommunications carriers, and to access a number of cloud service providers. The firm also offers colocation and managed services, which include direct private connection to major public cloud platforms. The company was founded by William Wei Huang in 2001 and is headquartered in Pudong, China.
info.description_zh: 萬國資料控股有限公司在中國從事資料中心的開發和營運。它在其他地點建立、運作和轉移資料中心。其資料中心與營運商和雲端無關，使客戶能夠連接到主要電信營運商，並存取許多雲端服務供應商。該公司還提供託管和託管服務，其中包括與主要公有雲平台的直接私人連接。該公司由William Wei Huang於2001年創立，總部位於中國浦東。

info.description: Omeros Corp. operates as a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, discovery, development, and commercialization of small-molecule and protein therapeutics targeting immunologic diseases. It also offers orphan indications targeting inflammation, coagulopathies, and disorders of the central nervous system. The company was founded by Gregory A. Demopulos and Pamela Pierce Palmer on June 16, 1994 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.

GraniteShares 2x Long MU Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ: MU). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

AXT, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture and distribution of compound and single element semiconductor substrates. It also sells specialty material substrates and raw materials used to make substrates and other related products. The company was founded by Morris S. Young and Davis Zhang in 1986 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: AXT, Inc. 從事化合物和單元素半導體基板的設計、開發、製造和分銷。它還銷售特殊材料基材以及用於製造基材和其他相關產品的原材料。該公司由 Morris S. Young 和 Davis Zhang 於 1986 年創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: ImmunityBio, Inc. is a clinical stage immunotherapy company. It develops next generation therapies that drive immunogenic mechanisms for defeating cancers and infectious diseases. The company's immunotherapy platform activates both the innate and adaptive immune systems to create long term immunological memory. ImmunityBio was founded by Patrick Soon-Shiong in 2014 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: ImmunityBio, Inc.是一家臨床階段免疫療法公司。它開發下一代療法，驅動免疫原性機制來戰勝癌症和傳染病。該公司的免疫治療平台可激活先天性和適應性免疫系統，以創建長期免疫記憶。 ImmunityBio 由 Patrick Soon-Shiong 於 2014 年創立，總部位於加州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. is engaged in the development and marketing of software and hardware solutions for information technology security. Its products include Quantum, CloudGuard, Harmony, and Infinity-Vision. The company was founded by Gil Shwed, Marius Nacht, and Shlomo Kramer in July 1993 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.

STKD Bitcoin & Gold ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing via U.S.-listed futures contracts as well as pooled investment vehicles, such as exchange-traded products, in two complementary asset classes, a modern digital asset class and a traditional asset class. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STKD 比特幣和黃金 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在美國上市的期貨合約以及交易所交易產品等集合投資工具投資於兩種互補的資產類別（現代數位資產類別和傳統資產類別）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MindWalk Holdings Corp. is an AI-driven biotherapeutic research, technology, and scientifically robust life science company that discovers and develops customized and novel antibodies by generating proprietary and patented processes, procedures, and innovative approaches to antibody discovery, development, and production. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States of America, Europe, Canada, Australia, and Other. The company was founded by Robert Beecroft on November 22, 1983 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: MindWalk Holdings Corp. 是一家由人工智慧驅動的生物治療研究、技術和科學穩健的生命科學公司，透過產生抗體發現、開發和生產的專有和專利流程、程序和創新方法來發現和開發定制的新型抗體。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、歐洲、加拿大、澳洲和其他地區。該公司由 Robert Beecroft 於 1983 年 11 月 22 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Shoals Technologies Group, Inc. is a design-engineering company and manufacturer of advanced electrical infrastructure solutions for mission-critical applications across solar photovoltaic (PV), BESS, and data center power systems. Its products include Solar Big Lead Assembly Solutions, Homeruns, Interconnection & Extension Solutions, Combiners and Re-Combiners, Load Break Disconnects and Transition Solutions, Solar OEM Components, Cable Management Solutions, Battery Energy Storage Solutions and Data Center Solutions. The company was founded by Dean Solon in November 1996 and is headquartered in Portland, TN.

Fastly, Inc. provides real-time content delivery network services. It offers edge compute, edge delivery, edge security, edge applications like load balancing and image optimization, video on demand, and managed edge delivery. The company was founded by Artur Bergman, Tyler McMullen, Simon Wistow, and Gil Penchina in March 2011 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

Valkyrie Bitcoin Miners ETF seeks to provide investors with total return. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue or profits from bitcoin mining operations and/or from providing specialized chips, hardware and software or other services to companies engaged in bitcoin mining. It will not directly invest in bitcoin, or indirectly through the use of derivatives or through investments in funds or trusts that hold bitcoin. The fund is non-diversified.

Canaan, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in developing and selling Bitcoin mining machines and related services. It focuses on the development of green mining. The company was founded by Jia Xuan Li, Xiang Fu Liu and Nan Geng Zhang on January 19, 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Canaan, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事開發和銷售比特幣礦機及相關服務。重點發展綠色礦業。該公司由李嘉軒、劉向福和張南庚於2013年1月19日創立，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Roadzen, Inc. operates as an insurance technology company. It offers auto insurance services through artificial intelligence technology. The company was founded by Rohan Malhotra on May 7, 2015 and is headquartered in Burlingame, CA.
info.description_zh: Roadzen, Inc. 是一家保險科技公司。它透過人工智慧技術提供汽車保險服務。該公司由 Rohan Malhotra 於 2015 年 5 月 7 日創立，總部位於加州伯林格姆。

info.description: Streamex Corp. operates as a Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization. It engages in the provision of blockchain technology to tokenize physical commodities such as gold and create related financial products. The company was founded by Kenneth L. Londoner, Karl Henry McPhie, and Morgan Lekstrom on February 24, 2009 and is headquartered in Winter Park, FL.
info.description_zh: Streamex Corp. 作為現實世界資產 (RWA) 代幣化運作。它致力於提供區塊鏈技術來對黃金等實體商品進行代幣化並創建相關的金融產品。該公司由 Kenneth L. Londoner、Karl Henry McPhie 和 Morgan Lekstrom 於 2009 年 2 月 24 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州溫特帕克。

info.description: Perpetuals.com Ltd. engages in providing blockchain-based technology solutions. It operates its proprietary private blockchain technology, Grid Ledger System (GLS), a hybrid blockchain that combines the technical advantages of blockchain technology and database technology, to leverage blockchain technology in various applications in a range of industries. It offers software and system development services and consulting and solution services. The company was founded by Satoshi Kobayashi and Hiroki Yamamoto on May 1, 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

2x XRP ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of XRP. The fund is an exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through managed exposure to XRP futures contracts that trade only on an exchange registered with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("XRP Futures Contracts"), and cash, cash-like instruments or high-quality securities that serve as collateral to the fund's investments in XRP Futures Contracts ("Collateral Investments"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 2x XRP ETF 尋求扣除費用和開支之前的每日投資結果，相當於 XRP 每日表現的兩倍 (2x)。該基金是一檔交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過管理 XRP 期貨合約（僅在商品期貨交易委員會註冊的交易所交易）（「XRP 期貨合約」）以及作為基金 XRP 期貨合約投資抵押品的現金、類現金工具或高品質證券（「抵押投資」）來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VNET Group, Inc. operates as a carrier- and cloud-neutral internet data center services provider in China. It provides hosting and related services, including IDC services, cloud services, and business VPN services, to improve the reliability, security, and speed of its customers' internet infrastructure. The firm serves numerous industries, ranging from internet companies to government entities, blue-chip enterprises to small- and mid-sized enterprises. VNET Group was founded by Sheng Chen and Jun Zhang in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: VNET Group, Inc. 在中國作為營運商和雲端中立的互聯網資料中心服務供應商運營。它提供託管和相關服務，包括IDC服務、雲端服務和企業VPN服務，以提高客戶互聯網基礎設施的可靠性、安全性和速度。該公司服務於眾多產業，從網路公司到政府實體、藍籌企業到中小企業。互聯星空集團由陳勝和張軍於1999年創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Greenland Energy Co. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 23, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

AVAX One Technology Ltd. is a digital infrastructure company accelerating the transition to an onchain financial economy. The firm builds power first, modular data centers in energy advantaged regions leveraging behind the meter generation and microgrid design to deliver reliable, cost efficient compute capacity for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads. It continues to mine Bitcoin in Alberta and Ohio, operating at a hashrate of approximately 300 PH/s. The company maintains a strategic Avalanche digital asset treasury, accumulating AVAX and generating onchain yield through native staking and ecosystem participation. Together, these three pillars give public market investors unique exposure to both the digital infrastructure layer and the onchain economy. The company was founded on December 22, 2017 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
Single-stock leveraged ETF that seeks daily investment results of 2x (200%) the daily price performance of Everpure, Inc (P; formerly Pure Storage) common stock, before fees and expenses.

Greenland Mines Ltd. engages in the exploration and development of critical minerals. Its portfolio includes the Skaergaard Project. The firm operates through the Biotech and Mining segments. The Biotech segment consists of biotechnology operations focused on research and development activities. The Mining segment covers mineral resource development and exploration. The company was founded by Joseph Sinkule on August 2, 2004 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.

info.description: Onconetix, Inc. is a commercial stage biotechnology company, which engages in the research, development and commercialization of proprietary therapeutics, diagnostics and services for clinicians and patients for oncology. The company was founded in October 2018 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: Onconetix, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物技術公司，致力於為臨床醫生和患者提供腫瘤學專有治療、診斷和服務的研究、開發和商業化。該公司成立於 2018 年 10 月，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's assets in, or provide exposure equal to, financial instruments that the Adviser and Sub-Adviser believe, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective of seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of SUI. The fund does not invest directly in SUI. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x Long Sui ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 SUI 每日價格表現的兩倍 (2x)。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於顧問和副顧問認為組合起來應產生與基金的投資目標一致的每日回報（不包括費用和開支）的金融工具，或提供相當於 SUI 每日價格表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金不直接投資於 SUI。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. is dedicated to building an ecosystem that integrates AI and blockchain while bridging Web2 and Web3. Its core products include the BesTrade DeAI Agent and the AIxC ecosystem products. The company was founded on March 29, 2004 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc.致力於建立一個融合人工智慧和區塊鏈、連接Web2和Web3的生態系統。其核心產品包括BesTrade DeAI Agent和AIxC生態產品。該公司成立於2004年3月29日，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: Lantronix, Inc. engages in the provision of software as a service (SaaS), engineering services, hardware for edge computing, the Internet of things (IoT), and remote environment management (REM). Its services include embedded IoT solutions, IoT systems solutions, and software and engineering services. The company was founded by Bernhard Bruscha in June 1989 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.

Reborn Coffee, Inc. engages in the franchise of retail locations and kiosks of coffee, water, and other beverages. The company was founded by Jay Kim on July 31, 2015 and is headquartered in Brea, CA.
info.description_zh: Reborn Coffee, Inc. 從事咖啡、水和其他飲料零售店和售貨亭的特許經營業務。該公司由 Jay Kim 於 2015 年 7 月 31 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州布雷亞。

info.description: Everpure, Inc. engages in the business of delivering innovative and disruptive data storage, products, and services that enable customers to maximize the value of data. The firm is also involved in the provision of data storage and management with a mission to redefine the storage experience by simplifying how people consume and interact with data. The company was founded by John M. Hayes and John Colgrove in October 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Everpure, Inc. 致力於提供創新和顛覆性的資料儲存、產品和服務，使客戶能夠最大限度地發揮資料價值。該公司還提供資料儲存和管理，其使命是透過簡化人們使用資料和與資料互動的方式來重新定義儲存體驗。該公司由 John M. Hayes 和 John Colgrove 於 2009 年 10 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: BullFrog AI Holdings, Inc. is a digital biopharmaceutical company, which engages in artificial intelligence and machine learning driven analysis of complex data sets in medicine and healthcare. The company was founded by Vininder Singh in August 2017 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.

DNA X, Inc. engages in the provision of crypto trading services to the public. The company was founded by Ram Chandran, Isaac Eteminan, Anush Gopalan, Jai Kumar, Sudu Srinivasan and Joakim Wiklund on August 5, 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.

DiaMedica Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of novel recombinant proteins. It develops the DM199 product candidate, which focuses on acute ischemic stroke (AIS) and chronic kidney disease (CKD). The company was founded by Wayne Lautt on January 21, 2000 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.

Netcapital, Inc. is a fintech company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. The firm's platform allows private companies to raise capital online and provides private equity investment opportunities to investors. The company was founded by Sean F. Lee on April 25, 1984 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.

info.description: Brera Holdings Plc is a Solana-based crypto infrastructure company with a strategic focus on Abu Dhabi. The firm creates value by working with its partners to build infrastructure and real hardware for the crypto revolution. Its cutting-edge Solana staking infrastructure will help drive the adoption of the network in the Middle East. The company was founded on June 30, 2022 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
Uxin Ltd. engages in the operation of an online used car transaction services platform. The company was founded by Dai Kun on August 11, 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
Single-stock leveraged ETF that seeks daily investment results of 2x (200%) the daily price performance of BlackBerry Limited (BB) common stock, before fees and expenses.

Koss Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of stereo headphones and accessories. Its products include wireless, ear clip, over ear, and on ear earphones, bluetooth speaker and cushions, cases, cables, and apparel accessories. The company was founded by John C. Koss Sr. in 1958 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, WI.

MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a clinical development stage biopharmaceutical company. It engages in developing its product candidates, Ketamir-2 and MIRA-55, designed to address unmet medical needs in pain management, depression, PTSD, and cognitive function. The company was founded by Adam Kaplin on September 3, 2020 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家临床开发阶段的生物制药公司。該公司致力於開發候選產品 Ketamir-2 和 MIRA-55，旨在解決疼痛管理、憂鬱症、創傷後壓力症候群 (PTSD) 和認知功能方面未滿足的醫療需求。该公司由 Adam Kaplin 于 2020 年 9 月 3 日创立，总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密。

info.description: INLIF Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the development of injection molding machine-dedicated manipulator arms. Its products include: Three-axis robot, Five-axis robot, and bull head type manipulator. The company was founded on January 4, 2023 and is headquartered in Quanzhou, China.

Everspin Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of magnetoresistive random access memory (MRAM) solutions. Its products include Toggle MRAM, Spin-transfer Torque MRAM, TMR Sensors, and Embedded MRAM. The company was founded by Saied Tehrani on May 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: Everspin Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供磁阻隨機存取記憶體 (MRAM) 解決方案。其產品包括切換 MRAM、自旋轉移扭矩 MRAM、TMR 感測器和嵌入式 MRAM。該公司由 Saied Tehrani 於 2008 年 5 月 16 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: Village Super Market, Inc. engages in the retail sale of food and nonfood products. The company was founded by Perry Sumas in 1937 and is headquartered in Springfield, NJ.

Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation and franchise of hotel, residential, and timeshare properties. It operates through the following geography segments: United States and Canada, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia Pacific excluding China. Its brands include Marriott Bonvoy, The Ritz-Carlton, Edition, W Hotels Worldwide, The Luxury Collection, and Stregis Hotels and Resorts etc. The company was founded by John Willard Marriott and Alice Sheets Marriott in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: 萬豪國際集團從事酒店、住宅和分時度假物業的營運和特許經營。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國和加拿大、歐洲、中東和非洲以及除中國外的亞太地區。旗下品牌包括萬豪旅享家、麗茲卡爾頓酒店、艾迪遜酒店、W 酒店全球、豪華精選、斯特吉斯酒店及度假村等。該公司由 John Willard Marriott 和 Alice Sheets Marriott 於 1927 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Digi International, Inc. engages in providing Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity products, services, and solutions. It operates through the IoT Products and Services, and IoT Solutions segments. The IoT Products and Services segment includes embedded and wireless modules, console servers, enterprise, and industrial routers. The IoT Solutions segment involves SmartSense and the Managed Network-as-a-Service (MNaaS) business. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Hopkins, MN.
info.description_zh: Digi International, Inc. 致力於提供物聯網 (IoT) 連接產品、服務和解決方案。它透過物聯網產品和服務以及物聯網解決方案部門運作。物聯網產品和服務部分包括嵌入式和無線模組、控制台伺服器、企業和工業路由器。物聯網解決方案部門涉及 SmartSense 和託管網路即服務 (MNaaS) 業務。該公司成立於 1985 年，總部位於明尼蘇達州霍普金斯。

info.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design and test solutions that are used in the design, development, manufacture, installation, deployment, validation, optimization, and secure operation of electronics systems to communications, networking, and electronics industries. It operates through the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG) segments. The CSG segment serves customers spanning the global commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The EISG segment offers test and measurement solutions across electronic industrial end markets, focusing on applications in the automotive, and energy industry and measurement solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing, consumer electronics, education, and general electronics manufacturing. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard in 1937 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: 是德科技公司致力於提供電子設計和測試解決方案，這些解決方案用於通訊、網路和電子行業電子系統的設計、開發、製造、安裝、部署、驗證、最佳化和安全操作。它透過通訊解決方案集團（CSG）和電子工業解決方案集團（EISG）部門運作。 CSG 部門為全球商業通訊、航空航太、國防和政府終端市場的客戶提供服務。 EISG 部門提供跨電子工業終端市場的測試和測量解決方案，重點關注汽車和能源產業的應用以及半導體設計和製造、消費性電子、教育和通用電子製造的測量解決方案。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1937 年創立，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: Silvaco Group, Inc. provides technology computer aided design software, electronic data automation software and semiconductor intellectual property. The TCAD, EDA and SIP solutions enable semiconductor and photonics companies to increase productivity, accelerate their product's time to market and reduce their development and manufacturing costs. Its services include SPICE Modeling Services, TCAD Modeling Services, Library Design Services and Library Characterization Services. The company was founded on November 18, 2009 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Silvaco Group, Inc. 提供技術電腦輔助設計軟體、電子資料自動化軟體和半導體智慧財產權。 TCAD、EDA 和 SIP 解決方案使半導體和光子學公司能夠提高生產力、加快產品上市時間並降低開發和製造成本。其服務包括 SPICE 建模服務、TCAD 建模服務、庫設計服務和庫表徵服務。該公司成立於2009年11月18日，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Analog Devices, Inc. is a semiconductor company, which engages in the combination of analog, digital, and software technologies into engineering solutions. Its products include analog and mixed signals, power management and reference, amplifiers radio frequency and reference, sensors and actuators, digital signal processing and system, Interface; and Software, Digital Platforms and Artificial Intelligence. The company was founded by Raymond P. Stata and Matthew Lorber in 1965 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.

Kulicke & Soffa Industries, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor and electronics assembly solutions. The firm operates through the Ball Bonding Equipment, Wedge Bonding Equipment, Advanced Solutions, and Aftermarket Products and Services (APS) segments. The Ball Bonding Equipment segment involves the design, development, manufacture and sale of wafer level bonding equipment. The APS segment includes the variety of tools, spares and services for the equipment. The company was founded by Frederick W. Kulicke and Albert Soffa in 1951 and is headquartered in Fort Washington, PA.

First Trust Nasdaq Semiconductor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Semiconductor IndexTM. The fund invests at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the semiconductor sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.

VanEck Semiconductor ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the semiconductor industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. The fund is non-diversified.

Teradyne, Inc. engages in the development and sale of automatic test systems. It operates through the following business segments: Semiconductor Test, Robotics, and All Other. The Semiconductor Test segment designs, manufactures, and markets semiconductor test products and services. The Robotics segment includes operations related to the design, manufacturing, and marketing of collaborative robotic arms, autonomous mobile robots, and advanced robotic control software. The company was founded by Alexander V. d'Arbeloff and Nicholas DeWolf in 1960 and is headquartered in North Reading, MA.
info.description_zh: Teradyne, Inc. 從事自動測試系統的開發和銷售。它透過以下業務部門運作：半導體測試、機器人和所有其他業務。半導體測試部門設計、製造和銷售半導體測試產品和服務。機器人部門包括與協作機器人手臂、自主移動機器人和先進機器人控制軟體的設計、製造和行銷相關的業務。該公司由 Alexander V. d'Arbeloff 和 Nicholas DeWolf 於 1960 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州北雷丁。

info.description: Viavi Solutions, Inc. engages in the provision of network test, monitoring, and assurance solutions for communications service providers, enterprises, network equipment manufacturers, government and avionics. It operates through the following segments: Network and Service Enablement, and Optical Security and Performance. The Network and Service Enablement segment provides an integrated portfolio of testing, monitoring, assurance and security solutions to help build, maintain and optimize telecom and datacom networks. The Optical Security and Performance segment leverages its core optical coating technologies and volume manufacturing capability to design, manufacture and sell technologies for the anti-counterfeiting, 3D sensing, government and aerospace, automotive and industrial markets. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Chandler, AZ.
info.description_zh: Viavi Solutions, Inc. 致力於為通訊服務供應商、企業、網路設備製造商、政府和航空電子設備提供網路測試、監控和保障解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：網路和服務支援以及光安全和效能。網路和服務支援部門提供測試、監控、保證和安全解決方案的整合產品組合，以協助建置、維護和最佳化電信和資料通訊網路。光學安全和性能部門利用其核心光學鍍膜技術和批量製造能力，為防偽、3D 感測、政府和航空航天、汽車和工業市場設計、製造和銷售技術。該公司成立於 1979 年，總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。

info.description: Daily surprises, near and far. Your source for travel inspiration and more. Travel moves you!

SIGA Technologies, Inc. is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of solutions for medical needs and biothreats. The firm develops therapeutic solutions for lethal pathogens including smallpox, Ebola, dengue, Lassa fever, and other viruses. It offers an orally administered antiviral drug that targets orthopoxviruses under the TPOXX brand. The company was founded by Steven Oliveira on December 28, 1995 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Global X Internet of Things ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global Internet of Things Thematic Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies in developed markets that facilitate the Internet of Things industry, including companies involved in wearable technology, home automation, connected automotive technology, sensors, networking infrastructure/software, smart metering and energy control devices. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 物聯網 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 全球物聯網主題指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該指數旨在為已開發市場的交易所上市公司提供投資機會，促進物聯網產業的發展，包括涉及穿戴式技術、家庭自動化、連網汽車技術、感測器、網路基礎設施/軟體、智慧計量和能源控制設備的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity and equity-related securities (namely, common and preferred stock, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts, warrants, rights and participatory notes) of or related to Next Gen Technologies Companies located throughout the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Next Gen Technologies ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，投資組合將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於位於世界各地的下一代技術公司或與其相關的股票和股票相關證券（即普通股和優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證、認股權證、權利和參與票據）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond to the price and yield of an index called the Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 80% of its net assets in the ETFs that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs that the index determines offer the greatest potential to outperform the other First Trust sector and industry-based ETFs and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus 5 ETF 尋求與名為 Dorsey Wright Dynamic Focus Five TM 指數的指數的價格和收益率相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的 ETF。該指數旨在提供對 5 個 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的有針對性的投資，該指數認為這些 ETF 具有超越其他 First Trust 部門和行業 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Schmid Group NV provides industrial equipment and services. It operates through following Technical equipment and processes; and Spare parts and services segments. The Technical equipment and processes segment includes mainly the sale of machines including installation and extended warranties. The Spare parts and services segment includes the sale of spare parts as well as services including repairs, modifications of machines and inspections. The company was founded in 1864 and is headquartered in Freudenstadt, Germany.
info.description_zh: Schmid Group NV 提供工業設備和服務。它透過以下技術設備和流程運作；備件和服務部門。技術設備和工藝部門主要包括機器銷售，包括安裝和延長保固。備件和服務部門包括備件銷售以及維修、機器改裝和檢查等服務。該公司成立於1864年，總部位於德國弗羅伊登施塔特。

info.description: Texas Instruments Incorporated engages in the design and manufacture of semiconductors. It operates through the following segments: Analog, Embedded Processing, and Other. The Analog segment semiconductors change real-world signals, such as sound, temperature, pressure or images, by conditioning them, amplifying them and often converting them to a stream of digital data that can be processed by other semiconductors, such as embedded processors. The Embedded Processing segment involves handling specific tasks and can be optimized for various combinations of performance, power, and cost, depending on the application. The Other segment includes DLP products, calculators, and custom application-specific integrated circuits products. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.

Stellar V Capital Corp. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on July 12, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Stellar V Capital Corp.是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年7月12日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: ASML Holding NV engages in the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. It includes lithography, metrology and inspection systems. The company was founded on April 1, 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: ASML Holding NV 從事先進半導體設備系統的開發、生產、行銷、銷售、升級和服務。它包括光刻、計量和檢測系統。該公司成立於1984年4月1日，總部位於荷蘭費爾德霍芬。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AMAT ETF is an actively managed derivative-based fund seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times the daily percentage change of the common stock of Applied Materials, Inc. The strategy employs swap agreements and other financial instruments to achieve its leveraged exposure, with the objective reset on a daily basis.

Accuray, Inc. is a radiation therapy company, which engages in manufacturing medical equipment. It develops, manufactures, sells, and supports medical solutions. The company was founded by John R. Adler in 1990 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.description_zh: Accuray, Inc.是一家放射治療公司，從事醫療設備製造。它開發、製造、銷售和支援醫療解決方案。該公司由 John R. Adler 於 1990 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: Direxion Daily ASML Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of the common stock of ASML Holding N.V. The fund employs financial derivative instruments to provide concentrated, leveraged exposure to a global leader in photolithography systems for the semiconductor industry, intended for sophisticated investors to manage short-term risk or execute tactical views.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily ASML Bull 2X ETF 尋求 ASML Holding N.V. 普通股每日表現 200% 的每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金採用金融衍生工具，為半導體產業光刻系統的全球領導者提供集中的槓桿投資，旨在幫助經驗豐富的投資者管理短期風險或執行戰術觀點。

info.description: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on November 1, 2024 and is headquartered Mountainside, NJ.
info.description_zh: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. III 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立是為了實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 11 月 1 日，總部位於新澤西州芒廷賽德。

info.description: BeyondSpring, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of immuno-oncology cancer therapies. It operates through the Plinabulin Pipeline and TPD Platform segments. The Plinabulin Pipeline segment focuses on the development of cancer therapies. The TPD Platform segment engages in the development of therapeutic agents and discover chemical entities. The company was founded by Lan Huang and Lin Qing Jia in 2010 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.

Baozun, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of brand electronic commerce (e-commerce) services and solutions. Its services include apparel and accessories, appliances, electronics, home and furnishings, food and health products, beauty and cosmetics, fast moving consumer goods, and mother and baby products, and insurance and automobiles. The firm operates through the E-Commerce and Brand Management segments. The company was founded by Wen Bin Qiu, Jun Hua Wu, and Qing Yu Zhang in August 2007 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

Fifth Era Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Matthew C. Le Merle, Alison Davis, and Mitchell Mechigian on May 22, 2024 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Medicine ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive medicine companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性醫藥 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性醫藥公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GCL Global Holdings Ltd. engages in the development, publishing, marketing, and distribution of games. It operates through the following segments: Console Game, Hardware, and Accessories, Game Publishing, Advertising Service, and Other. The company was founded on October 12, 2023 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: 協鑫環球控股有限公司從事遊戲開發、發行、行銷和發行。它透過以下部門運作：主機遊戲、硬體和配件、遊戲出版、廣告服務和其他。該公司成立於2023年10月12日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: Globa Terra Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 18, 2024 and is headquartered in Mexico City.

info.description: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF seeks maximum total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in securities and financial instruments linked to the S&P 500 Index. The fund manager takes both long and short positions by investing in e-mini futures contracts. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in large cap equities or investments with similar characteristics, or cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: TradersAI Large Cap Equity & Cash ETF 尋求最大的總回報。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金 (ETF)，旨在透過投資與標準普爾 500 指數掛鉤的證券和金融工具來實現其投資目標。基金經理人透過投資電子迷你期貨合約來持有多頭和空頭部位。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於大盤股或具有類似特徵的投資，或現金及現金等價物。

info.description: Kestra Medical Technologies Ltd. is a commercial-stage, wearable medical device and digital healthcare company. It focused on transforming patient outcomes in cardiovascular disease using monitoring and therapeutic intervention technologies that are intuitive, intelligent, and connected. The company was founded by Brian Webster and Traci S. Umberger in 2014 and is headquartered in Kirkland, WA.
info.description_zh: Kestra Medical Technologies Ltd. 是一家商業階段的可穿戴醫療設備和數位醫療保健公司。它專注於利用直觀、智慧和互聯的監測和治療幹預技術來改變心血管疾病患者的治療結果。該公司由 Brian Webster 和 Traci S. Umberger 於 2014 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州柯克蘭。

info.description: Kandi Technologies Group, Inc. engages in designing, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing electric vehicle (EV) products and its parts. The firm offers off-road vehicles including all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), pure electric utility vehicles (UTVs), go-karts, electric scooters, electric self-balancing scooters, and lithium-ion cells. The company was founded by Xiao Ming Hu in 2002 and is headquartered in Jinhua, China.
info.description_zh: Kandi Technologies Group, Inc. 从事电动汽车 (EV) 产品及其零部件的设计、开发、制造和商业化。該公司提供越野車，包括全地形車（ATV）、純電動多功能車（UTV）、卡丁車、電動滑板車、電動自平衡滑板車和鋰離子電池。该公司由胡晓明于2002年创立，总部位于中国金华。

info.description: Kodiak Sciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, development, and commercialization of therapeutics for retinal diseases. Its product pipeline includes KSI-301 for wet AMD, KSI-301 for diabetic eye disease, KSI-501 for DME and uveitis, KSI-201 for resistant wet AMD, and KSI-401 for dry AMD. The company was founded by Stephen A. Charles and Victor Perlroth in 2009 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.

Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. engages in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals products and services. It focuses on selling products utilizing hyaluronan, a naturally occurring polysaccharide that is widely distributed in the extracellular matrix of connective tissues in both animals and humans, and non-HA products for medical use primarily in the Ophthalmic, Orthopedic and other markets. The company was founded by Otto Sartorius in 1965 and is headquartered in Chaska, MN.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Lifecore Biomedical, Inc. 從事醫藥產品和服務的開發和製造。該公司專注於銷售利用透明質酸的產品，透明質酸是一種天然存在的多醣，廣泛分佈於動物和人類結締組織的細胞外基質中，以及主要用於眼科、骨科和其他市場的非透明質酸產品。該公司由 Otto Sartorius 於 1965 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州查斯卡。

info.description: Titan Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 11, 2024 and is headquartered in Brooklyn, NY.

Viomi Technology Co., Ltd. is a technology company which involves in AI for Better water utilizing AI technology to provide better drinking water solutions for households worldwide. The firm involves in home water systems, Viomi has developed a distinctive Equipment and Consumables business model. It operates a Water Purifier Gigafactory with an integrated industrial chain that boasts optimal efficiency and facilitates continuous breakthroughs in water purification. The company was founded by Xiao Ping Chen in May 2014 and is headquartered in Foshan, China.

Vendome Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 28, 2025 and is headquartered in Park City, UT.
