info.description: Engine No. 1 Transform Supply Chain ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that invests in U.S.-listed equity, ADR securities, and non-U.S. developed and emerging market-listed securities, which over time may vary as market and investment opportunities change. The fund may also enter into currency-related spot transactions when it transacts in equities denominated in foreign currencies or invest in certain derivative instruments, such as currency futures or forwards that will help the adviser manage risk associated with foreign currency exposure, if any, or futures contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 一號引擎變革供應鏈ETF尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），投資於美國上市股票、ADR 證券以及非美國已開發和新興市場上市證券，隨著時間的推移，這些證券可能會隨著市場和投資機會的變化而變化。當基金進行以外幣計價的股票交易或投資某些衍生性商品（例如貨幣期貨或遠期合約）時，也可能會進行與貨幣相關的現貨交易，這將有助於顧問管理與外幣風險（如有）或期貨合約相關的風險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Matthew Kiernan and Andrew McLean on April 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Camas, WA.
info.description_zh: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Matthew Kiernan 和 Andrew McLean 於 2025 年 4 月 7 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州卡馬斯。

info.description: Intelligent Livermore ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund uses Intelligent Alpha, LLC's proprietary artificial intelligence-powered stock selection strategy to create an intelligent equal weight portfolio of global large cap stocks with over $1 billion in market capitalization. The securities selected will be based on the major trading trends inspired by the greatest traders in the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智能利弗莫爾 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用Intelligent Alpha, LLC專有的人工智慧選股策略，創造出市值超過10億美元的全球大盤股的智慧等權重投資組合。所選的證券將基於受世界上最偉大的交易者啟發的主要交易趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on October 17, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Averin Capital Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立是為了與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年10月17日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which engages in the effecting of a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 22, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.

Entegris, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and supply of specialty materials for the microelectronics industry. It operates through the Materials Solutions (MS) and Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) segments. The Materials Solutions segment provides materials-based solutions, such as chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition materials, chemical mechanical planarization ("CMP") slurries and pads, ion implantation specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, and other specialty materials that enable customers to achieve better device performance and faster time to yield, while providing for lower total cost of ownership. The Advanced Purity Solutions segment offers filtration, purification and contamination-control solutions that improve customers' yield, device reliability and cost by ensuring the purity of critical liquid chemistries and gases and the cleanliness of wafers and other substrates used throughout semiconductor manufacturing processes, the semiconductor ecosystem and other high-technology industries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Entegris, Inc. 從事微電子行業特殊材料的開發、製造和供應。它透過材料解決方案（MS）和高級純度解決方案（APS）部門運作。材料解決方案部門提供基於材料的解決方案，例如化學氣相和原子層沉積材料、化學機械平坦化（“CMP”）漿料和墊、離子注入特種氣體、配方蝕刻和清潔材料以及其他特種材料，使客戶能夠實現更好的裝置性能和更快的產量，同時降低總擁有成本。高階純度解決方案部門提供過濾、純化和污染控制解決方案，透過確保關鍵液體化學品和氣體的純度以及半導體製造流程、半導體生態系統和其他高科技產業中使用的晶圓和其他基材的清潔度，提高客戶的產量、設備可靠性和成本。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比爾里卡。

info.description: Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. engages in collection, storage, lending, and sending money through its commerce engine. The firm provides merchant services, payables, banking, and treasury solutions. It operates through the following segments: Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB) Payments, Business-to-Business (B2B) Payments, and Enterprise Payments. The SMB Payments segment includes provision of full-service acquiring and payment-enabled solutions for business-to-consumer transactions. The B2B Payments segment relates to accounts for payable automation solutions to corporations, software partners, and financial institutions. The Enterprise Payments segment refers to provision of embedded finance and banking as a service (BaaS) solution to customers to modernize legacy platforms and accelerate software partners' strategies to monetize payments. The company was founded by John V. Priore, Thomas Charles Priore, and Sean Kiewiet in August 2005 and is headquartered in Alpharetta, GA.

Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600. The index, as designed, has two components: (i) a Nasdaq-100 component and (ii) a dividend component consisting of long positions in annual futures contracts that provide exposure to ordinary dividends paid on the common stocks of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Advisor attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF 旨在追蹤 Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600 的總回報表現（未扣除費用和開支）。按照設計，該指數有兩個組成部分：(i) Nasdaq-100 成分和 (ii) 股息成分，由年度期貨合約的多頭頭寸組成，這些合約提供對包括以下公司的普通股支付的普通股股息的敞口被納入納斯達克 100 指數。顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Argent Large Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in the equity securities of large-capitalization companies that Argent Capital Management LLC, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), believes are high quality, enduring businesses. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Argent Large Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資大型公司的股權證券來實現其投資目標，該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）Argent Capital Management LLC 認為這些公司是高品質、持久的企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TCW Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of businesses that the Adviser has identified, through annual reports, press releases and other public statements by an issuer, as well as the Adviser's due diligence process, as using, or as having demonstrated an intent to use, predictive or generative AI in a way that is or has the potential to deliver a material improvement in the company's financial condition. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TCW人工智慧ETF尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於顧問透過發行人的年度報告、新聞稿和其他公開聲明以及顧問的盡職調查流程確定的企業證券，這些企業使用或已表明有意使用預測性或生成性人工智慧，以實現或有可能對公司的財務狀況帶來實質改善。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sanmina Corp. engages in the provision of integrated manufacturing solutions, components, products and repair, logistics and after-market services. It operates through the following segments: Integrated Manufacturing Solutions (IMS) and Components, Products and Services (CPS). The IMS segment consists of printed circuit board assembly and test, final system assembly and test and direct-order-fulfillment. The CPS segment includes interconnect systems and mechanical systems. The company was founded by Jure Sola in 1980 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

Johnson Controls International Plc engages in the provision of building products, energy solutions, integrated infrastructure and next generation transportation systems. Its products and solutions include fire detection and suppression, security, HVAC equipment, building automation and controls, digital, industrial refrigeration, residential and smart home, retail, distributed energy storage, and batteries. The company was established in 1885 and is headquartered in Cork, Ireland.
info.description_zh: 江森自控國際有限公司致力於提供建築產品、能源解決方案、綜合基礎設施和下一代交通系統。其產品和解決方案包括火災偵測和滅火、安全、暖通空調設備、樓宇自動化和控制、數位、工業冷凍、住宅和智慧家居、零售、分散式能源儲存和電池。該公司成立於1885年，總部位於愛爾蘭科克。

info.description: Velos Acquisition I Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on March 12, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Silicom Ltd. engages in the provision of networking and data infrastructure solutions. Its products include server adapters, smart cards, bypass switches, and intelligent bypass switches. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: USA, North America, Israel, Europe, and Asia Pacific. The company was founded by Avi Eizenman, Yehuda Zisapel, and Zohar Zisapel in 1987 and is headquartered in Kfar Sava, Israel.

Level Four Large Cap Growth Active ETF seeks maximum total return and above peer average risk-adjusted return. The fund invests primarily in equity securities of carefully selected, high-quality U.S. companies. The fund invests primarily in the domestic equity securities of companies selected by Level Four Capital Management, LLC for their growth potential within various market sectors.
info.description_zh: 第四級大盤成長主動 ETF 尋求最大總回報和高於同業平均風險調整回報。本基金主要投資於精心挑選的優質美國公司的股本證券。該基金主要投資於 Level Four Capital Management, LLC 因其在各個市場領域的成長潛力而選擇的公司的國內股本證券。

info.description: Touchstone Large Company Growth ETF utilizes a high-conviction, bottom-up investment approach to identify large-capitalization companies possessing durable competitive advantages and the potential for reliable long-term earnings growth. The strategy integrates a distinct valuation discipline into its selection process, aiming to participate in capital appreciation while maintaining price sensitivity within the growth equity universe by typically maintaining a concentrated portfolio of 25 to 35 equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone大型公司成長ETF採用高信念、自下而上的投資方法來識別擁有持久競爭優勢和可靠的長期獲利成長潛力的大資本公司。該策略將獨特的估值規則融入其選擇過程中，旨在參與資本增值，同時透過通常維持由 25 至 35 種股票證券組成的集中投資組合來維持成長股票領域內的價格敏感度。

info.description: Dakota Active Equity ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing directly or indirectly through other ETFs, in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of U.S. companies or underlying ETFs that provide exposure to equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Dakota Active Equity ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過直接或透過其他 ETF 間接投資於美國股本證券投資組合來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款投資於美國公司的股本證券或提供美國公司股本證券敞口的基礎ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. engages in the development of connectivity solutions and products for the data infrastructure market. Its products include integrated circuits, active electrical cables, and SerDes chiplets. The company was founded by Chi Fung Cheng and Yat Tung Lam on 2008 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. 致力於為資料基礎設施市場開發連接解決方案和產品。其產品包括積體電路、主動電纜和 SerDes 小晶片。該公司由 Chi Fung Cheng 和 Yat Tung Lam 於 2008 年創立，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: iShares Asia 50 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P Asia 50TM composed of 50 of the largest Asian equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Asia 50 ETF 旨在追蹤由 50 隻最大的亞洲股票組成的 S&P Asia 50TM 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long IONQ Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of IonQ, Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x 多頭 IONQ 每日 ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 IonQ, Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過輸入標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned Index. The fund generally invests substantially all, but at least 80%, of its total assets in the securities comprising the index. The index is designed to exceed the minimum standards for a "Paris-Aligned Benchmark" under the EU BMR. A Paris-Aligned Benchmark is designed to align with a principal objective of the Paris Agreement to limit the increase in the global average temperature to well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.
info.description_zh: SPDR MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整 ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與 MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金通常將其總資產的大部分（但至少 80%）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在超過歐盟 BMR 下「巴黎一致基準」的最低標準。巴黎協調基準旨在與《巴黎協定》的主要目標保持一致，即將全球平均氣溫上升幅度限制在遠低於工業化前水準 2 攝氏度。

info.description: Pacer Nasdaq International Patent Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq International Patent Leaders Index. The index is a rules-based full market capitalization-weighted index that consists of companies from the Nasdaq Global Ex United States Large Mid Cap Index with the most valuable patent portfolios. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq International Patent Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克國際專利領導者指數（未計費用和開支）的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的完整市值加權指數，由納斯達克全球（美國除外）大中型股指數中擁有最有價值專利組合的公司組成。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long IONQ ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of IonQ, Inc. (NYSE: IONQ). The fund is an actively managed ETF that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance 每日目標 2 倍多頭 IONQ ETF 尋求 IonQ, Inc.（NYSE：IONQ）每日股價變動百分比兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bluestar 5G Communications Index (the index). The fund uses a passive management approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a tiered, modified market capitalization-weighted portfolio of the U.S.-listed equity securities, including depositary receipts, of companies whose products or services are predominantly tied to the development of 5G networking and communication technologies.
info.description_zh: Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF 旨在追蹤藍星 5G 通訊指數（簡稱「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用被動管理方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由在美國上市的股票證券（包括其產品或服務主要與 5G 網路和通訊技術的發展相關的公司的存託憑證）的分級、修改後的市值加權投資組合組成。

info.description: Invesco Electric Vehicle Metals Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal circumstances, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the tradeable metals widely used in the production of an electric vehicle (which include, but are not limited to, iron ore, copper, aluminum, nickel, cobalt and lithium). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順電動車金屬商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，尋求透過投資與電動車生產中廣泛使用的可交易金屬（包括但不限於鐵礦石、銅、鋁、鎳、鈷和鋰）經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AOT Growth and Innovation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (ETF) that invests in U.S. listed equity securities that have high growth potential based on a low marginal cost business model. It's investment universe consists of publicly traded equity securities listed in the United States with a minimum market capitalization of $800 million. The Sub-Adviser also excludes REITs, and Business Development Companies ("BDCs").
info.description_zh: AOT 成長與創新 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（ETF），投資於基於低邊際成本商業模式的具有高成長潛力的美國上市股票證券。其投資領域包括在美國上市的公開交易股票證券，市值最低為 8 億美元。副顧問也不包括房地產投資信託基金和業務發展公司（「BDC」）。

info.description: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the technology sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Technology Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Technology Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家科技業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: HUTCHMED (China) Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of pharmaceuticals and health-oriented consumer products. It operates through the Oncology/Immunology and Other Ventures segments. The Oncology/Immunology segment includes the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted therapies and immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer and immunological diseases. The Other Ventures segment involves the other commercial businesses which include the sales, marketing, manufacture, and distribution of prescription drugs and healthcare products. The company was founded on December 18, 2000 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

UTStarcom Holdings Corp. is a telecom infrastructure company, which develops technology for cloud-based services, mobile, streaming, and other applications. It operates through the following segments: Equipment, and Services. The Equipment segment focuses on equipment sales including network infrastructure and application products, which include broadband products, wireless infrastructure technologies. The Services segment provides services and support for equipment products and also the new operational support segment. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: UT斯達康控股公司是一家電信基礎設施公司，開發基於雲端的服務、行動、串流媒體和其他應用程式的技術。它透過以下部門運作：設備部門和服務部門。設備部門專注於設備銷售，包括網路基礎設施和應用產品，其中包括寬頻產品、無線基礎設施技術。服務部門為設備產品以及新的營運支援部門提供服務和支援。公司成立於1991年，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. engages in the developing, manufacturing, and marketing of subsea products. The firm operates through the following segments: Marine Technology Business (Products), Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business (PAL), and Defense Engineering Services Business. The Marine Technology Business segment develops solutions for subsea and underwater markets. The Acoustics Sensors and Materials Business segment engages in the provision of a comprehensive range of products and solutions, with a primary focus on medical imaging and Non-Destructive Testing. The Defense Engineering Services Business segment engages in defense contractors and designs, engineers, manufactures and supplies proprietary sub-assemblies for incorporation into broader mission critical defense systems. It also operates through the Americas, Europe, Australia or Asia, and Middle East or Africa geographical segments. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Coda Octopus Group, Inc. 從事海底產品的開發、製造和行銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：海洋技術業務（產品）、聲學感測器和材料業務（PAL）以及國防工程服務業務。海洋技術業務部門為海底和水下市場開發解決方案。聲學感測器和材料業務部門提供全面的產品和解決方案，主要專注於醫學影像和無損檢測。國防工程服務業務部門與國防承包商合作，設計、工程師、製造和供應專有的子組件，以納入更廣泛的關鍵任務防禦系統。它也透過美洲、歐洲、澳洲或亞洲、中東或非洲地理區域開展業務。該公司成立於 1994 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: JPMorgan ActiveBuilders Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities and equity-related instruments that are tied economically to emerging markets. The equity securities and equity-related instruments in which it may invest include, but are not limited to, common stock, participation notes or other structured notes, and other instruments that provide economic exposure to one or more equity securities. The fund may also use exchanged-traded futures for the efficient management of cash flows.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通 ActiveBuilders 新興市場股票 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於與新興市場經濟相關的股本證券和股票相關工具。其可能投資的股本證券及股本相關工具包括但不限於普通股、參與票據或其他結構性票據，以及提供一種或多種股本證券經濟風險的其他工具。該基金還可以使用交易所交易的期貨來有效管理現金流。

info.description: Montauk Renewables, Inc. engages in the recovery and processing of biogas from landfills and other non-fossil fuel sources for beneficial use as a replacement to fossil fuels. It operates through the following segments: Renewable Natural Gas and Renewable Electricity Generation. The Renewable Natural Gas segment deals with the production of renewable natural gas. The Renewable Electricity Generation segment includes generation of electricity at biogas-to-electricity plants. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.

Baillie Gifford Emerging Markets ETF delivers an actively managed, research-driven framework targeting 60 to 100 high-conviction growth companies across emerging and frontier markets. Capitalizing on structural themes like artificial intelligence infrastructure, supply chain electrification, digital finance, and rising local consumption, the approach employs bottom-up fundamental selection to capture substantial long-term capital appreciation unconstrained by benchmark positioning relative to the MSCI Emerging Markets Index.
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford Emerging Markets ETF 提供了一個積極管理、研究驅動的框架，針對新興市場和前沿市場的 60 至 100 家高可信度成長型公司。此方法利用人工智慧基礎設施、供應鏈電氣化、數位金融和不斷增長的本地消費等結構性主題，採用自下而上的基本面選擇來捕捉長期資本增值，不受相對於 MSCI 新興市場指數的基準定位的限制。

info.description: abrdn Emerging Markets Dividend Active ETF seeks total return consisting of income and long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging market companies that pay dividend income. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks but may also invest in other types of equity securities, including, but not limited to, preferred stock and depositary receipts.
info.description_zh: abrdn 新興市場股息主動 ETF 尋求由收入和長期資本增值組成的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產價值以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於支付股息收入的新興市場公司的股本證券。該基金將主要投資於普通股，但也可能投資於其他類型的股本證券，包括但不限於優先股和存託憑證。

info.description: Nicholas Bitcoin and Treasuries AfterDark ETF is an actively managed investment strategy designed to capture bitcoin's return profile specifically during U.S. overnight hours, from market close to the following market open. The fund maintains a dual-exposure structure, holding bitcoin-related instruments during the overnight session while rotating into short-term U.S. Treasuries and cash equivalents during U.S. daytime trading hours to potentially mitigate the volatility often associated with standard market sessions.
info.description_zh: Nicholas 比特幣與國債 AfterDark ETF 是一種主動管理的投資策略，旨在捕捉比特幣的回報情況，特別是在美國隔夜時段（從市場收盤到隨後的市場開盤）。該基金維持雙重曝險結構，在隔夜交易時段持有比特幣相關工具，同時在美國日間交易時段轉向短期美國國債和現金等價物，以潛在地減輕通常與標準市場交易時段相關的波動性。

info.description: NestYield Visionary ETF seeks long-term growth; the fund's secondary investment objective is to seek current income. The fund's strategy involves two components: (1) purchasing a portfolio of equity securities either directly, or "synthetically" by using options to gain exposure to one or more equity securities; and (2) generating income through an options portfolio. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: NestYield Visionary ETF尋求長期成長；該基金的次要投資目標是尋求當前收入。本基金的策略涉及兩個組成部分：(1) 直接購買股權證券投資組合，或透過使用選擇權「綜合」購買一種或多種股權證券； (2) 透過選擇權投資組合產生收入。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lattice Semiconductor Corp. engages in the business of developing technologies that are monetized through differentiated programmable logic semiconductor products, system solutions, design services, and licenses. It also offers silicon-based and silicon-enabling products, evaluation boards, development hardware, and related intellectual property licensing, services, and sales. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Hillsboro, OR.

Energous Corp. engages in the development of wireless charging technology. It focuses on the product, WattUp, a wireless power technology consisting of proprietary semiconductor chipsets, software controls, hardware designs, and antennas, that enables radio frequency based charging for electronic devices. The company was founded by Michael Aaron Leabman in 2012 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Energous Corp.從事無線充電技術的開發。它專注於產品 WattUp，這是一種無線充電技術，由專有的半導體晶片組、軟體控制、硬體設計和天線組成，可為電子設備提供基於射頻的充電。該公司由 Michael Aaron Leabman 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Digi Power X, Inc. is an energy infrastructure company that develops cutting-edge data centers to drive the expansion of sustainable energy assets. It focuses on validation through mining, hosting solutions, and blockchain software solutions. It operates through the following segments: Cryptocurrency Mining, Sales of Energy and Electricity, and Colocation Services. The company was founded on February 18, 2017 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

Tower Semiconductor Ltd. engages in providing semiconductor solutions. It also offers technology and manufacturing platforms for integrated circuits (ICs) in growing markets such as consumer, industrial, automotive, mobile, infrastructure, medical, and aerospace and defense. It focuses on creating positive and sustainable impact on the world through long term partnerships and its advanced and innovative analog technology offering, comprised of a broad range of customizable process platforms such as SiGe, BiCMOS, mixed-signal/CMOS, RF CMOS, CMOS image sensor, non-imaging sensors, integrated power management (BCD and 700V), and MEMS. Its designs enable a quick and accurate design cycle as well as process transfer services including development, transfer, and optimization, to IDMs and fabless companies. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Migdal Haemek, Israel.

Outdoor Holding Co. engages in the design and manufacture of products for law enforcement, military, sport shooting, and self-defense. It operates through the following segments: Ammunition, Martketplace, and Corporate and Other. The Ammunition segment consists of the manufacturing business. The Marketplace segment includes GunBroker.com. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Outdoor Holding Co. 從事執法、軍事、運動射擊和自衛產品的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：彈藥部門、市場部門、企業及其他部門。彈藥部門由製造業務組成。市場部分包括 GunBroker.com。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Direxion Daily MRVL Bull 2X ETF is an aggressively managed single-stock leveraged exchange-traded fund that seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily price performance of the common shares of Marvell Technology, Inc. The fund is designed as a tactical tool for sophisticated investors to amplify short-term bullish views on a leading designer of infrastructure semiconductor solutions through the use of financial derivative instruments, requiring active daily monitoring due to the effects of compounding and leverage.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily MRVL Bull 2X ETF 是一款積極管理的單股槓桿交易所交易基金，尋求 Marvell Technology, Inc. 普通股每日價格表現 200% 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金被設計為成熟投資者的戰術工具，透過使用金融衍生工具來放大對基礎設施半導體解決方案領先設計商的短期看漲觀點，由於複利和槓桿的影響，需要進行主動日常監控。

info.description: Innodata, Inc. is a data engineering company, which engages in providing artificial intelligence software platforms and management of its services. It operates through the following business segments: Digital Data Solutions (DDS), Synodex, and Agility. The DDS segment combines deep neural networks and human expertise in multiple domains to make unstructured information useable. The Synodex segment enables clients in the insurance and healthcare sectors to transform medical records into useable digital data and to apply technologies to the digital data to augment decision support. The Agility segment provides tools and related professional services that enable public relations and communications professionals to discover influencers, amplify messages, monitor coverage, and measure the impact of campaigns. The company was founded by Todd H. Solomon in 1988 and is headquartered in Ridgefield Park, NJ.

TSS, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive services for the planning, design, development and maintenance of mission-critical facilities and information infrastructure as well as integration services. It operates through the Facilities and Systems Integration Services business segments. The Facilities segment consists of the design, project management, and maintenance of data center and mission-critical business operations. The Systems Integration segment integrates information technology equipment for original equipment manufacturer vendors and customers to be used inside data center environments, including modular data centers. The company was founded by Gerard J. Gallagher on December 20, 2004 and is headquartered in Georgetown, TX.
info.description_zh: TSS, Inc. 致力於為關鍵任務設施和資訊基礎設施的規劃、設計、開發和維護以及整合服務提供綜合服務。它透過設施和系統整合服務業務部門運作。設施部門包括資料中心和關鍵任務業務運作的設計、專案管理和維護。系統整合部門為原始設備製造商供應商和客戶整合資訊科技設備，以便在資料中心環境（包括模組化資料中心）內使用。該公司由 Gerard J. Gallagher 於 2004 年 12 月 20 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州喬治敦。

info.description: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, acquiring, and commercializing novel products. It operates through the Rx and Consumer Health segments. The RX segment consists of various prescription pharmaceutical products sold through third parties. The Consumer Health segment includes various consumer health products sold directly to consumers. Its products include Adzenys ER, Adzenys XR-ODT, Cotempla XR-ODT, Karbinal ER, Poly-Vi-Flor, Tri-Vi-Flor, Generic Tussionex, Tuzistra XR, and ZolpiMist. The company was founded on August 9, 2002 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. 是一家專業製藥公司，致力於識別、收購和商業化新產品。它透過處方藥和消費者健康部門運作。 RX 部門由透過第三方銷售的各種處方藥品組成。消費者健康部門包括直接銷售給消費者的各種消費者健康產品。其產品包括 Adzenys ER、Adzenys XR-ODT、Cotempla XR-ODT、Karbinal ER、Poly-Vi-Flor、Tri-Vi-Flor、Generic Tussionex、Tuzistra XR 和 ZolpiMist。該公司成立於2002年8月9日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Infobird Co., Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of standard and customized customer relationship management cloud-based services. It offers software-as-a-service (SaaS) and business process outsourcing (BPO) services to clients. The company was founded on October 26, 2001 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

Pulmatrix, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the development and discovery of novel inhaled therapeutics products. The company was founded by David Alan Edwards, Mark J. Gabrielson, Alexander M. Klibanov, and Robert S. Langer, Jr. in April 2003 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Pulmatrix, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於新型吸入治療產品的開發和發現。該公司由 David Alan Edwards、Mark J. Gabrielson、Alexander M. Klibanov 和 Robert S. Langer, Jr. 於 2003 年 4 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Agora, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of real-time engagement through online platforms. It operates through the following geographical segments: People's Republic of China, United States, and Others. The company was founded by Tony Zhao and Tony Wang in November 2013 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Agora, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於透過線上平台提供即時互動。它透過以下地理區域運作：中華人民共和國、美國和其他地區。該公司由托尼·趙和托尼·王於2013年11月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Quantum Computing, Inc. engages in developing novel algorithms and solutions utilizing quantum and quantum-inspired computing to solve difficult problems in various industries. It leverages its expertise in finance, computing, security, mathematics, and physics to develop commercial applications for the financial, security, and government sectors. The company was founded on July 25, 2001 and is headquartered in Hoboken, NJ.
info.description_zh: 量子計算公司致力於利用量子和量子啟發計算開發新穎的演算法和解決方案，以解決各行業的難題。它利用其在金融、計算、安全、數學和物理方面的專業知識，為金融、安全和政府部門開發商業應用。該公司成立於2001年7月25日，總部位於新澤西州霍博肯。

info.description: Rackspace Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of end-to-end multi-cloud technology services. The firm designs, builds and operates its customers' cloud environments across technology platforms. It operates through the following segments: Public Cloud and Private Cloud. The Public Cloud segment is a services-centric, capital-light model providing value-added cloud solutions through managed services, Elastic Engineering and professional services offerings for customer environments hosted on the AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud public cloud platforms. The Private Cloud segment is a technology-forward, capital-intensive model providing managed service offerings for customer environments hosted in data centers as well as in those owned by customers or by third parties such as colocation providers. The company was founded on July 21, 2016 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
Teamshares, Inc. is a tech-enabled acquiror of SMEs, intending to be a permanent home when owners retire. The company was founded on June 28, 2019 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Teamshares, Inc. 是一家以科技為支撐的中小企業收購者，旨在成為業主退休後的永久住所。該公司成立於2019年6月28日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Direxion Daily MU Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of MU. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of MU and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to MU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

SANUWAVE Health, Inc. is a medical device company providing directed energy products into the wound care space. It engages in the development and marketing of directed energy products that utilize ultrasound technology. The company was founded on May 6, 2004 and is headquartered in Eden Prairie, MN.

Vuzix Corp. is a supplier of Smart-Glasses and Augmented Reality technologies and products for the consumer and enterprise markets. Its products include personal display and wearable computing devices that offer users a portable viewing experience, provide solutions for mobility, wearable displays and augmented reality. The firm also holds 246 patents and patents pending and numerous IP licenses in the Video Eyewear field. It has offices in Rochester, NY, Oxford, UK, and Tokyo, Japan. The company was founded by Paul J. Travers in 1997 and is headquartered in West Henrietta, NY.
info.description_zh: Vuzix Corp. 是一家為消費者和企業市場提供智慧眼鏡和擴增實境技術及產品的供應商。其產品包括個人顯示器和穿戴式運算設備，為使用者提供便攜式觀看體驗，並提供行動性、穿戴式顯示器和擴增實境解決方案。該公司還在視訊眼鏡領域擁有 246 項專利和正在申請的專利以及眾多智慧財產權許可。它在紐約羅徹斯特、英國牛津和日本東京設有辦事處。該公司由 Paul J. Travers 於 1997 年創立，總部位於紐約州西亨麗埃塔。

info.description: CaliberCos, Inc. operates as an asset management firm. It provides various support services including asset management & fund set-up services, as well as lending support, construction & development management, and real estate brokerage services. The company was founded by John Christopher Loeffler II and Jennifer Schrader in January 2009 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.

Hut 8 Corp. engages in the development and operation of data centers at scale, supporting AI, high-performance computing (HPC), ASIC compute, and other energy-intensive technology applications. It operates through the following segments: Power, Digital Infrastructure, Compute, and Others. The Power segment manages the origination, development, and management of powered land and energy infrastructure. The Digital Infrastructure refers to the development, ownership, and operation of facilities designed to support next-generation, energy-intensive technology application. The Compute segment deals with operating businesses that deploy and monetize compute assets across next-generation energy-intensive technology. The Others segment offers equipment sales and repairs. The company was founded on January 27, 2023 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

Auddia, Inc. engages in the development of audio content ecosystem technology and products. The firm operates an interactive radio platform called Auddia, which is a subscription based commercial free AM and FM software application. It also offers Vodacast, an interactive podcasting platform and application, which enables listeners to see video and other digital content in a digital feed that correlates with the podcast audio. The company was founded by Jeffrey J. Thramann in 2011 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Auddia, Inc. 從事音訊內容生態系統技術和產品的開發。該公司經營一個名為 Auddia 的互動廣播平台，這是一個基於訂閱的商業免費 AM 和 FM 軟體應用程式。它還提供 Vodacast，這是一個互動式播客平台和應用程序，使聽眾能夠在與播客音訊相關的數位來源中觀看影片和其他數位內容。該公司由 Jeffrey J. Thramann 於 2011 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. is a self-managed real estate investment trust, which invests in a diverse multi-tenant portfolio of real estate assets. It operates through the following segments: Office and Industrial Properties, Model Home Properties, and Retail Properties. The Office and Industrial Properties segment consists of office buildings and an industrial property leased to a variety of tenants ranging from small businesses to large public companies. The Model Home Properties segment consists of model home residential properties leased to homebuilders. The Retail Properties segment includes shopping centers. The company was founded by Jack Kendrick Heilbron on September 28, 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. 是一家自我管理的房地產投資信託公司，投資於多元化的多租戶房地產資產組合。它透過以下部門運作：辦公室和工業地產、樣板房地產和零售地產。辦公和工業地產部門包括辦公大樓和工業地產，租賃給從小型企業到大型上市公司等各種租戶。樣品屋物業部門包括出租給房屋建築商的樣品屋住宅物業。零售物業部門包括購物中心。該公司由 Jack Kendrick Heilbron 於 1999 年 9 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Rain Enhancement Technologies Holdco, Inc. develops, manufactures, and commercializes ionization rainfall generation technology to provide additional rainfall for industries, supranational organizations, countries, and localities. The company is headquartered in Naples, FL.
info.description_zh: Rain Improvement Technologies Holdco, Inc. 開發、製造和商業化電離降雨產生技術，為工業、跨國組織、國家和地區提供額外的降雨。該公司總部位於佛羅裡達州那不勒斯。

info.description: Jet.AI, Inc. engages in the provision of a business-to-business software platform for SaaS products and private aviation services. Its projects include Manitoba, Maritimes, and Moapa. The company was founded by Michael D. Winston on June 4, 2018 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: Jet.AI, Inc. 致力於為 SaaS 產品和私人航空服務提供企業對企業軟體平台。其項目包括曼尼托巴省、濱海省和莫阿帕省。該公司由 Michael D. Winston 於 2018 年 6 月 4 日創立，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: FTC Solar, Inc. provides solar tracker systems, technology, software, and engineering services. Solar trackers significantly increase energy production at solar power installations by dynamically optimizing solar panel orientation to the sun. The company was founded by David Springer and Ahmad R. Chatila in 2017 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: FTC Solar, Inc. 提供太陽能追蹤系統、技術、軟體和工程服務。太陽能追蹤器透過動態優化太陽能板對太陽的方向，顯著提高太陽能發電裝置的發電量。該公司由 David Springer 和 Ahmad R. Chatila 於 2017 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Keel Infrastructure Corp. engages in building artificial intelligence focused data centers and energy assets. It focuses on infrastructure and energy required to support high-performance computing and artificial intelligence workloads. The company was founded on April 1, 2026 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Surrozen, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company, which engages in the business of discovering and developing drug candidates to selectively modulate the Wnt pathway, a critical mediator of tissue repair, in a broad range of organs and tissues. The company was founded by K. Christopher Garcia and Roeland Nusse on August 12, 2015 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Surrozen, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，從事發現和開發候選藥物的業務，以選擇性地調節廣泛器官和組織中組織修復的關鍵介質 Wnt 通路。該公司由 K. Christopher Garcia 和 Roeland Nusse 於 2015 年 8 月 12 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州南舊金山。

info.description: Arm Holdings Plc engages in the licensing, marketing, research, and development of microprocessors, systems IP, graphics processing units, physical IP and associated systems IP, software, and tools. It operates through the following geographical segments: United Kingdom, United States, and Other Countries. The company was founded on November 12, 1990 and is headquartered in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.

Springview Holdings Ltd. engages in the design and construction of residential and commercial buildings. It involves new construction, reconstruction, alterations, and other general contracting services. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Springview Holdings Ltd. 從事住宅和商業建築的設計和建造。涉及新建、改建、改建及其他總承包服務。該公司成立於2002年，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: PomDoctor Ltd. operates as an online medical services platform, which specializes in chronic disease management and pharmaceutical services. It operates through two segments: Internet hospital and pharmaceutical supply chain. The Internet hospital segment include online consultation and prescription renewal and CDM service. The pharmaceutical supply chain provides other pharmaceutical platforms with supply chain management and platform operation services. The company was founded by Zhenyang Shi and Li Xu on February 01, 2021 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

Spero Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on identifying, developing, and commercializing treatments involving bacterial infections, including multi-drug resistant bacterial infections, and rare diseases Its pipeline product candidates include Tebipenem HBr, SPR720, and SPR206. The company was founded by Ankit A. Mahadevia and Laurence Rahme in April 2013 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Spero Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於識別、開發和商業化涉及細菌感染（包括多重抗藥性細菌感染）和罕見疾病的治療方法，其管道候選產品包括Tebipenem HBr、SPR720和SPR206。該公司由 Ankit A. Mahadevia 和 Laurence Rahme 於 2013 年 4 月創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: RUM Group, Inc. engages in operating an online neutral video platform. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Canada, and Other. The company was founded in October 2013 by Chris Pavlovski and is headquartered in Longboat Key, FL.
info.description_zh: RUM Group, Inc. 從事營運線上中立視訊平台。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、加拿大和其他地區。該公司由 Chris Pavlovski 於 2013 年 10 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州朗博特島。

info.description: Dreamland Ltd. is an event management service provider specializing in the organization, planning, promotion, and management of themed experience events. It handles a wide variety of public and private events, including trade shows, conferences, concerts, exhibitions, charity galas, brand promotions, and internal corporate events. The company was founded by Seto Wai Yue in 2016 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

iTonic Holdings Ltd. operates as a holding company with interests in providing healthcare solutions. The firm through its subsidiaries engages in the development and commercialization of brachytherapy TPS specifically used for radioactive particle implantation, a type of radiotherapy used in treating cancer patients by placing radioactive sources inside the patient that kill cancer cells and shrink tumors. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: iTonic Holdings Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，致力於提供醫療保健解決方案。該公司透過其子公司從事專門用於放射性粒子植入的近距離放射治療 TPS 的開發和商業化，這是一種透過將放射源放置在患者體內殺死癌細胞並縮小腫瘤來治療癌症患者的放射療法。公司成立於1998年，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Hang Feng Technology Innovation Co., Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of corporate management consulting and asset management services. It provides the following services through its subsidiaries: Management Consulting, Regulatory Compliance and Governance Consulting. The company was founded on October 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

EZGO Technologies Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in selling e-bicycle and battery cells. It operates through the following segments: Battery Cells and Packs, Sales of Electronic Control System, and Others. The Others segment refers to second-hand machineries. The company was founded on January 24, 2019 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
info.description_zh: EZGO Technologies Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事銷售電動自行車和電池。它透過以下部門運作：電池和電池組、電子控制系統銷售等。其他部分指二手機械。公司成立於2019年1月24日，總部位於中國常州。

info.description: Zhongchao, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of healthcare information, education, and training services. It operates under the Services and Drugs segments. It offers online and onsite health information services, healthcare education programs, and healthcare training products, consisting primarily of clinical practice training, open classes of medical topics, interactive case studies, academic conference and workshops, continuing education courses, articles, and short videos with educational healthcare content to healthcare professionals as well as the public. The company was founded by Wei Guang Yang on August 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

Korsana Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovering and developing novel therapies to reduce the burden of neurodegenerative diseases. Its portfolio includes the KRSA-028 pipeline. The company was founded in 2024 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.

LOBO Technologies Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles. The company designs and develops e-bicycles, e-mopeds, e-tricycles, and electric off-highway four-wheeled shuttles. It operates through the Electric Vehicles and Accessories Sales and Software Royalties and Development, and Design Services segments. The Electric Vehicles and Accessories Sales segment engages in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles and accessories. The Software Royalties and Development, and Design Services segment provides software solutions development for automotive electronics. The company was founded on October 25, 2021 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
info.description_zh: LOBO Technologies Ltd.從事電動車的製造和銷售。該公司設計和開發電動自行車、電動輕便摩托車、電動三輪車和電動非公路四班車。它透過電動車及配件銷售、軟體版稅和開發以及設計服務部門運作。電動車及配件銷售分部從事電動車及配件的製造及銷售。軟體版稅和開發以及設計服務部門提供汽車電子軟體解決方案開發。公司成立於2021年10月25日，總部位於中國無錫。

Epsium Enterprise Ltd. operates as a holding company, which engages in import trading and distribution of wines and spirits. It offers a range of products, including Chinese liquor, French cognac, Scottish whisky, fine wines, champagne, and other miscellaneous alcoholic beverages. Its brands include Moutai, Xijiu, Wuliangye, Remy Martin Cognac, Macallan, Cointreau, Piper Heidsieck Champagne, French Fine Wines, Red and White Wines. The company was founded by Son I Tam on March 24, 2020 and is headquartered in Macau.
info.industry_zh: 飲料 - 釀酒廠和釀酒廠
info.description_zh: Epsium Enterprise Ltd. 作為一家控股公司運營，從事葡萄酒和烈酒的進口貿易和分銷。它提供一系列產品，包括中國白酒、法國干邑白蘭地、蘇格蘭威士忌、精品葡萄酒、香檳和其他各種酒精飲料。旗下品牌包括茅台、習酒、五糧液、人頭馬干邑、麥卡倫、君度、海德雪香檳、法國精品葡萄酒、紅白葡萄酒等。該公司由Son I Tam於2020年3月24日創立，總部位於澳門。

info.description: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of novel drugs and diagnostics. It focuses on developing product candidates intended for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, including PTI-125 and PTI-125Dx. The company was founded by Remi Barbier in May 1998 and is headquartered in Austin, TX.
info.description_zh: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. 從事新藥和診斷方法的開發。它專注於開髮用於治療阿茲海默症的候選產品，包括 PTI-125 和 PTI-125Dx。該公司由 Remi Barbier 於 1998 年 5 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀。

info.description: Vistagen Therapeutics, Inc. is a late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in developing and commercializing medication and treatment for anxiety, depression, and other central nervous system disorders. Its product portfolio includes Fasedienol (PH94B) nasal spray for social anxiety disorder, Itruvone (PH10) nasal spray for depression disorders, AV-101 oral NMDR glycine site antagonist for depression and neurological disorders, PH15 acute treatment for improvement of cognition, PH80 acute management of vasomotor symptoms due to menopause, and PH284 acute management of Wasting syndrome (Cachexia). The company was founded by H. Ralph Snodgrass and Gordon Keller on May 26, 1998 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.

Viking Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of therapies for metabolic and endocrine disorders. The company was founded by Brian Lian and Michael A. Dinerman on September 24, 2012 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.

Twin Vee PowerCats Co. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of recreational and commercial power catamaran boats. The firm is focused on designing and developing its products under the ELECTRA Power Sports brand. It operates through the Twin Vee PowerCats and Wizz Banger, Inc. Segments. The Twin Vee PowerCats segment designs, manufactures, and sells recreational and commercial powerboats. The Wizz Banger, Inc. segment refers to a development-stage subsidiary with plans to develop an innovative online marketplace leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to transform how customers search for and purchase recreational marine assets. The company was founded by Roger Dunshee in 1996 and is headquartered in Fort Pierce, FL.

Maison Solutions, Inc. operates as a holding company with interests in food retailing. It offers traditional Asian food and merchandise to U.S. consumers, in particular to members of Asian-American communities. The firm's products include meats, seafood, and Asian vegetables and fruits such as Chinese broccoli, bitter melon, winter gourd, Shanghai baby bokchoy, longan and lychee. The company was founded in July 2019 and is headquartered in Monterey Park, CA.
info.description_zh: Maison Solutions, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，涉足食品零售業務。它向美國消費者，特別是亞裔美國人社區的成員提供傳統的亞洲食品和商品。該公司的產品包括肉類、海鮮以及亞洲蔬菜和水果，如綠花椰菜、苦瓜、冬瓜、上海小白菜、龍眼和荔枝。該公司成立於 2019 年 7 月，總部位於加州蒙特利公園。

info.description: Powell Max Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial communications services. It provides financial printing, corporate reporting, communications, and language support services. The company was founded by Leung Po Man on January 8, 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.

Leverage Shares 2X Long ARM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of ARM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of ARM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

Leverage Shares 2X Long HUT Daily ETF is an actively managed fund that provides twice the daily performance, before fees and expenses, of the common stock of Hut 8 Corp. (HUT). The strategy is designed as a short-term tactical tool for professional investors to amplify the daily returns of the underlying company through the use of financial derivatives and direct equity exposure.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2X Long HUT Daily ETF 是一款主動式管理基金，其每日表現（扣除費用和開支前）是 Hut 8 Corp. (HUT) 普通股的兩倍。該策略旨在作為專業投資者的短期戰術工具，透過使用金融衍生性商品和直接股權投資來放大標的公司的每日回報。

info.description: XCF Global, Inc. is a pioneering sustainable aviation fuel company dedicated to accelerating the aviation industry's transition to net-zero emissions. The firm is developing and operating state-of-the-art clean fuel SAF production facilities engineered to the highest levels of compliance, reliability, and quality. The company is headquartered in Houston, TX.

Leverage Shares 2X Long GLXY Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of GLXY. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GLXY, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Zeo Energy Corp. operates as a vertically integrated provider of residential solar energy systems, other energy efficient equipment, and related services. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in New Port Richey, FL.

info.description: VisionSys AI, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of IT-focused supplementary science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) education services. It operates an education platform that has live distance instruction, classroom-based learning, and online learning modules. The company was founded by Shao Yun Han in September 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: VisionSys AI, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於提供以 IT 為重點的補充科學、技術、工程和數學 (STEM) 教育服務。它經營一個教育平台，具有遠距教學、課堂學習和線上學習模組。該公司由邵雲韓於2002年9月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Decoy Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a preclinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in leveraging machine learning and AI tools alongside high-speed synthesis techniques to rapidly design, engineer and manufacture peptide conjugate drug candidates that target serious unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Frederick E. Pierce, Barbara Hibner, Peter Marschel, Michael Lipp, and Jodi Cooper in 2020 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.

Artelo Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the development of therapeutics that target lipid-signaling pathways, including the endocannabinoid system. Its product candidate pipeline includes ART27.13-Synthetic Cannabinoid Agonist, ART26.12-FABP5 inhibitor, and ART12.11-Synthetic CBD Cocrystal. The company was founded on May 2, 2011 and is headquartered in Solana Beach, CA.
info.description_zh: Artelo Biosciences, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於開發脂質訊號路徑（包括內源性大麻素系統）的療法。其候選產品管道包括 ART27.13-合成大麻素激動劑、ART26.12-FABP5 抑制劑和 ART12.11-合成 CBD Cocrystal。該公司成立於2011年5月2日，總部位於加州索拉納海灘。

info.description: Black Titan Corp. was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger between Titan Pharmaceuticals Inc. and TalenTec Sdn Bhd. It intends to explore and identify viable business opportunities. The company was founded on July 11, 2024 and is headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.

Beneficient is a financial services company, which engages in providing alternative assets, financial and investment services. It offers services to individual investors, wealth advisors, general partners, and institutional investors. It operates through the following segments: Ben Liquidity, Ben Custody, Customer ExAlt Trusts, and Corporate and Other. The Ben Liquidity segment offers liquidity products and services. The Ben Custody segment provides trust and custody administration services. The Customer ExAlt Trusts segment includes investments in alternative assets. The Corporate and Other segment relates to its overhead and administrative costs. The company was founded by Brad K. Heppner on June 6, 2023 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.

Silexion Therapeutics Corp. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in the discovery and development of treatments for KRAS-driven cancers. The company was founded on November 30, 2008 and is headquartered in in Modiin, Israel.

Masonglory Ltd. is an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of wet trades and other related ancillary works. It offers plastering on floors, ceilings and walls, tile laying on internal and external walls and floors, brick laying, floor screeding, and marble works. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Masonglory Ltd.是一家投資控股公司，從事提供濕貨貿易及其他相關配套工程業務。它提供地板、天花板和牆壁的抹灰、內外牆和地板的瓷磚鋪設、磚砌、地板找平和大理石工程。公司成立於2018年，總部位於香港。

info.description: Jaguar Health, Inc. is a commercial stage pharmaceuticals company, which engages in the development of gastrointestinal products. It operates through the following segments: Animal Health and Human Health. The Animal Health segment is focused on development and commercialization of prescription and non-prescription products for companion and production animals. The Human Health segment is involved in manufacturing human products and the ongoing advertising of Mytesi, which is used for the symptomatic relief of non-infectious diarrhea in adults with HIV/AIDS on antiretroviral therapy. The company was founded by Lisa A. Conte on June 6, 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

RenX Enterprises Corp. provides real estate development services. It focuses on the development of sites using purpose built, prefabricated modules built from both wood & steel, sourced from one of Safe & Green Holdings factories and operated by SG Echo. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

Quanterix Corp. engages in the development of ultra-sensitive digital immunoassay platform that advances precision health for life sciences research and diagnostics. Its products and services include Simoa Assay Kits, HD-X analyzer, SR-X Biomarker Detection System, SP-X Imaging and Analysis System, 2470 Arrayer, Simoa Accelerator Laboratory, Uman NF-Light, and Homebrew -Custom Assay Development. The company was founded by Nicholas J. Naclerio and David R. Walt in April 2007 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.

TON Strategy Co. operates as a digital asset treasury company. It focuses on the Toncoin ecosystem. The company was founded by Rory J. Cutaia on November 27, 2012 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.

Leverage Shares 2X Long TSM Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of TSM. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of TSM, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Robotics and 3D Printing Index (the "Index"). The index is a rules-based index that consists of globally-listed stocks and depositary receipts of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from Robotics and 3D Printing Companies, as determined by the index provider. The fund adviser will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF 旨在追蹤 BlueStar 機器人和 3D 列印指數（「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的指數，由指數提供者確定的至少 50% 收入來自機器人和 3D 列印公司的全球上市股票和存託憑證組成。基金顧問通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Silvercrest Asset Management Group, Inc. operates as a wealth management firm. The firm provides traditional and alternative investment advisory and family office services to wealthy families and select institutional investors. It also offers portfolio, equity, and fixed income management and outsourced investment services. The company was founded in April 2002 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The initial Index universe is typically derived from the component companies of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The initial universe of companies is typically screened based on their average projected free cash flows and earnings (if available) over each of the next two fiscal years. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of the fund's total assets in growth securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer Nasdaq 100 Top 50 Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。最初的指數範圍通常源自於納斯達克 100 指數的成分公司。公司的初始範圍通常是根據未來兩個財政年度的平均預期自由現金流和收益（如果有）進行篩選的。一般情況下，基金會尋求將基金總資產的至少80%投資於成長型證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SC II Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 30, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: SC II Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月30日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Biotech ETF is designed to maximize weekly income by executing an options strategy focused primarily on selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track the 3x daily performance of the biotechnology sector. The fund targets three times the income stream compared to standard options writing on its underlying industry exposure while providing capped secondary capital appreciation and implementing a discretionary downside protection layer.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 生物技術 ETF 旨在透過執行選擇策略來最大化每週收入，該策略主要側重於出售槓桿交易所交易基金的短期看跌期權，該基金追蹤生物技術行業 3 倍的每日表現。該基金的目標是其基礎產業曝險的收入流是標準選擇權的三倍，同時提供有上限的二次資本增值並實施酌情下行保護層。

info.description: Defiance Retail Kings ETF is an actively managed fund that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in U.S.-listed companies demonstrating high retail investor sentiment and digital engagement. The fund utilizes a proprietary model to identify "Retail Kings"-companies that are favorites or trending leaders in online investor communities-while further vetting them for fundamental resilience and competitive moats.
info.description_zh: Defiance Retail Kings ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過投資表現出高散戶投資者情緒和數位參與度的美國上市公司來實現長期資本增值。該基金利用專有模型來識別「零售之王」——線上投資者社群中最受歡迎或趨勢領先的公司——同時進一步審查它們的基本彈性和競爭護城河。

info.description: Crown Reserve Acquisition Corp. I operates as a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on April 29, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Crown Reserve Acquisition Corp. I 以空白支票公司經營。它的創建目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年4月29日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: American Dynamism Acquisition Co. operates as a blank check company. It engages in the effect of a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Washington, DC.

Art Technology Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA.
info.description_zh: Art Technology Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月22日，總部位於賓州費城。

info.description: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It focuses on identifying and merging with technology companies, particularly in blockchain-enabled AI, digital trade identity, and robotics. The company was founded on November 3, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它專注於識別和合併科技公司，特別是在區塊鏈支援的人工智慧、數位貿易身分和機器人技術領域。該公司成立於2025年11月3日，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF seeks to track the performance of a rules-based index designed to provide targeted, passive exposure to global public companies representing the full upstream and downstream value chain enabling Nvidia Corporation to manufacture, assemble, deploy, and operate high-performance computer systems. The fund employs a thematic supply-chain selection methodology using FactSet relationship data and a 50% revenue contribution threshold across six designated functional pillars to capture the physical infrastructure behind artificial intelligence deployment, while explicitly avoiding direct equity investments in shares of Nvidia Corporation.
info.description_zh: PurePlay Nvidia Ecosystem Picks & Shovels Index ETF 旨在追蹤基於規則的指數的表現，該指數旨在為代表整個上游和下游價值鏈的全球上市公司提供有針對性的被動投資，使 Nvidia Corporation 能夠製造、組裝、部署和運營高性能電腦系統。該基金採用主題供應鏈選擇方法，利用 FactSet 關係數據和跨六個指定功能支柱的 50% 收入貢獻門檻來捕獲人工智慧部署背後的實體基礎設施，同時明確避免對 Nvidia 公司股票的直接股權投資。

info.description: Oxley Bridge Acquisition Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more business. The company was founded on August 6, 2024 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

WD-40 Co. is a global marketing organization, which engages in the development and sale of products for workshops, factories, and homes. Its brands include WD-40 Multi-Use Product, WD-40 Specialist, 3-IN-ONE, GT85, X-14, 2000 Flushes, Carpet Fresh, no vac, Spot Shot, 1001, Lava and Solvol. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), and Asia-Pacific. The company was founded by Norman Bernard Larsen, Sam Crivello, Gordon Dawson, and John B. Gregory on September 23, 1953 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: WD-40 Co.是一家全球行銷組織，從事車間、工廠和家庭產品的開發和銷售。其品牌包括 WD-40 Multi-Use Product、WD-40 Specialist、3-IN-ONE、GT85、X-14、2000 Flushes、Carpet Fresh、no vac、Spot Shot、1001、Lava 和 Solvol。該公司在以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲 (EMEA) 以及亞太地區。該公司由 Norman Bernard Larsen、Sam Crivello、Gordon Dawson 和 John B. Gregory 於 1953 年 9 月 23 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Nathan's Famous, Inc. engages in the operation of franchised fast-food units. The firm is involved in the licensing, wholesaling, and retailing of products marketed under the Nathan's Famous brand. It operates through the following segments: Branded Product Program, Product Licensing, Restaurant Operations, and Corporate. The Branded Product Program segment markets and sells hot dog products. The Product Licensing segment consists of royalties from licensing a variety of Nathan's Famous products such as hotdogs, sausage and corned beef products, frozen French fries, and additional products through retail grocery channels and club stores. The Restaurant Operations segment deals with the sale of products at company-owned restaurants and fees and royalties from franchised restaurants. The Corporate segment includes administrative expenses such as executive management, finance, information technology, legal, insurance, corporate office costs, corporate incentive compensation, and compliance costs. The company was founded by Nathan Handwerker in 1916 and is headquartered in Jericho, NY.

Azenta, Inc. is a global provider of life sciences solutions, enabling organizations worldwide to bring impactful breakthroughs and therapies to market faster. The company offers a suite of reliable cold-chain sample management solutions and multiomics services supporting drug development, clinical research, and advanced cell therapies for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic, and healthcare institutions globally. It operates through the following segments: Sample Management Solutions and Multiomics. The Sample Management Solutions segment provides end-to-end sample management products and services, including Sample Repository Services (SRS). Its core products include automated stores, cryogenic systems, automated sample tubes, consumables and instruments, and controlled-rate thawing devices. The Multiomics segment delivers genomic and other sample analysis services, including gene sequencing, gene synthesis, and related services. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Burlington, MA.
info.description_zh: Azenta, Inc. 是生命科學解決方案的全球供應商，幫助世界各地的組織更快地將有影響力的突破和療法推向市場。該公司提供一套可靠的冷鏈樣本管理解決方案和多組學服務，為全球製藥、生物技術、學術和醫療機構提供藥物開發、臨床研究和先進細胞療法的支援。它透過以下部門運作：樣本管理解決方案和多組學。樣品管理解決方案部門提供端到端樣品管理產品和服務，包括樣品儲存庫服務（SRS）。其核心產品包括自動化商店、低溫系統、自動化樣品管、耗材和儀器以及控速解凍設備。多組學部門提供基因組和其他樣本分析服務，包括基因定序、基因合成和相關服務。該公司成立於 1978 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州伯靈頓。

info.description: Defiance NASDAQ 100 Lightningspread Income ETF seeks to seek current income; capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income and, secondarily, capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objectives by employing a "LightningSpread" strategy, which is designed to generate daily income that the fund manager intends to distribute twice weekly. The fund's strategy also seeks to provide long exposure to the price return of the Nasdaq 100 index (the "index"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance NASDAQ 100 Lightningspread Income ETF 尋求當前收益；資本增值。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求當前收入，其次是資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用「LightningSpread」策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在產生每日收入，基金經理打算每週分配兩次。該基金的策略還尋求提供納斯達克 100 指數（「指數」）價格回報的長期曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Lazard Equity Megatrends ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The portfolio will seek to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in an actively managed portfolio of established, well managed companies located around the world, including emerging markets. Under normal circumstances, the portfolio invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity and equity-related securities (including common and preferred stock, warrants and rights, American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), and Global Depositary Receipts). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Lazard Equity Megatrends ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該投資組合將透過主要投資於由位於世界各地（包括新興市場）的成熟、管理良好的公司組成的積極管理的投資組合來尋求實現其投資目標。正常情況下，投資組合至少80%的淨資產投資於股票和股票相關證券（包括普通股和優先股、認股權證和權利、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Origin Investment Corp. I is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 25, 2024 and is headquartered in Singapore.
info.description_zh: Origin Investment Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年9月25日，總部位於新加坡。

info.description: iShares Exponential Technologies ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar Exponential Technologies IndexSM composed of stocks of developed and emerging market companies that create or use exponential technologies. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a subset of the Morningstar Global Markets Index (the "Parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares Exponential Technologies ETF 旨在追蹤 Morningstar Exponential Technologies IndexSM 的投資結果，該指數由創建或使用指數技術的已開發和新興市場公司的股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數是晨星全球市場指數（「母指數」）的子集。

info.description: Garmin Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of navigation, communications and information devices, most of which are enabled by Global Positioning System (GPS) technology. It operates through the following segments: Marine, Outdoor, Fitness, Auto OEM, Consumer Auto, and Aviation. The Marine segment manufactures and offers recreational marine electronics such as cartography, Sounders, Radar, Autopilot Systems and Sailing. The Outdoor segment offers products designed for use in outdoor activities such as Outdoor Handhelds, Adventure Watches, Golf Devices, Dog Tracking & Training Device, Garmin Connect & Garmin Connect Mobile, and Connect IQ. The Fitness segment refers to the products designed for use in fitness and activity tracking such as Running & Multi-Sport Watches, Cycling Computers, Power Meters, Safety & Awareness, and Activity Tracking Devices. The Auto OEM and Consumer Auto segments offer products designed for use in the auto market such as Personal Navigation Devices, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Solutions, and Cameras. The Aviation segment provides solutions to aircraft manufacturers, existing aircraft owners and operators, as well as government/defense customers. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.

Westin Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on June 3, 2025 and is headquartered in Singapore.
