info.description: Defiance Nasdaq 100 Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index subject to a limit on potential investment gains is the secondary consideration. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the value of the index, subject to a limit on potential gains from increases in the value of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Nasdaq 100 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；納斯達克 100 指數的表現受到潛在投資收益限制是次要考慮因素。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求當前收入，同時維持間接接觸指數價值的機會，但受到指數價值上漲潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Thornburg Focus Growth Fund is an actively managed U.S. equity strategy that targets long-term capital appreciation by investing in a concentrated yet diversified portfolio of 40-60 high-quality businesses identified through rigorous bottom-up fundamental research. The fund utilizes a unique three-basket portfolio construction to balance exposures across the growth spectrum, primarily targeting mid-to-large-capitalization U.S. companies that possess sustainable competitive advantages and trade below their estimated long-term intrinsic value.
info.description_zh: Thornburg Focus Growth Fund 是一項積極管理的美國股票策略，透過投資於透過嚴格的自下而上的基礎研究確定的 40-60 家優質企業的集中而多元化的投資組合，以實現長期資本增值。該基金利用獨特的三籃子投資組合結構來平衡整個成長範圍的風險敞口，主要針對擁有可持續競爭優勢且交易價格低於其估計長期內在價值的大中型美國公司。

info.description: GlacierShares Nasdaq Iceland ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the MarketVector Iceland Global Index. The index, which is sub-index of the MarketVector Total Global Equity Index, tracks the performance of common stocks (or corresponding ADRs or GDRs of "local" Icelandic companies and"non-local"companies related to the Icelandic economy. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in Icelandic equity securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GlacierShares 納斯達克冰島 ETF 旨在追蹤 MarketVector 冰島全球指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數是MarketVector全球總股票指數的子指數，追蹤與冰島經濟相關的「本地」冰島公司和「非本地」公司的普通股（或相應的ADR或GDR）的表現。正常情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上用於投資目的的借款，將投資於冰島股票證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MKAM ETF seeks to capture the majority of equity market returns, while exposing investors to less volatility and downside risk than other equity investments. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in U.S. equity securities that generally mimic the performance of the S&P 500 Index while attempting to reduce volatility and mitigate drawdowns. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: MKAM ETF 旨在獲取大部分股票市場回報，同時使投資者面臨比其他股票投資更少的波動性和下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資通常模仿標準普爾 500 指數表現的美國股票證券來實現其投資目標，同時試圖減少波動性和減少回撤。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Nasdaq Autocallable Income ETF seeks to generate high monthly income while providing reduced downside risk through exposure to the MerQube Nasdaq-100 Vol Advantage Autocallable Index. The fund is a non-diversified, actively managed ETF that, under normal market conditions, seeks to invest at least 80% of its total assets in U.S. Treasuries, cash, cash equivalents, "box spreads" and unfunded total return swaps that provide exposure to the index. The fund will not attempt to replicate or track the index but will instead use financial instruments such as total return swaps to gain exposure to the level of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Calamos Nasdaq Autocallable Income ETF 尋求產生高月收入，同時透過投資 MerQube Nasdaq-100 Vol Advantage Autocallable Index 來降低下行風險。該基金是一種非多元化、主動管理的 ETF，在正常市場條件下，尋求將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於美國國債、現金、現金等價物、「箱式利差」和提供指數敞口的無融資總回報掉期。該基金不會嘗試複製或追蹤該指數，而是會使用總回報掉期等金融工具來獲得指數水準的曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is the equal-weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes 100 of the largest U.S. and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100 等加權指數基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ-100 等加權 TM 指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克上市的 100 家最大的美國和國際非金融公司。

info.description: Parametric Equity Plus ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). The investment objective of the fund is to seek to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities.
info.description_zh: 參數股票加ETF旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的投資目標是尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。

info.description: Horizon NASDAQ-100 Defined Risk ETF seeks capital appreciation and capital preservation. Horizon Investments, LLC ("Horizon" or the "Adviser") seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing primarily in Flexible Exchange Options ("FLEX Options") that provide exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index and implementing an options-based strategy that seeks to generate income, manage volatility and reduce downside risk.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n NASDAQ-100 定義風險 ETF 尋求資本增值和資本保值。 Horizo​​n Investments, LLC（「Horizo​​n」或「顧問」）尋求透過主要投資於提供納斯達克 100 指數曝險的靈活交易選擇權（「FLEX 選擇權」）並實施旨在產生收入、管理波動性和降低下行風險的基於選擇權的策略來實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: Exchange-traded fund advised by BlackRock Fund Advisors that seeks to track the investment results of an index composed of the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market by market capitalization (the Nasdaq-100).

Guru Favorite Stocks ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund's investment strategy is to seek to grow the capital by investing in high quality companies that are favored by prominent long-term investors ("Gurus") and at reasonable prices. The fund's investment sub-adviser, GuruFocus Investments, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") tracks the equity portfolio holdings of approximately twenty Gurus. To be considered a Guru, the investor must have a long-term, publicly available, track record of at least ten years. In addition, the Guru must follow an investment strategy of investing in companies that the Guru considers to be high-quality.

Qualivian Focus Fund ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks long-term compounding of capital by investing in a high-conviction, non-diversified portfolio of approximately 20 to 25 large- and mid-capitalization quality companies. The sub-adviser uses a proprietary quantitative and qualitative bottom-up process to identify companies with sustainable competitive moats, owner-oriented management teams, and strong free cash flows trading at discounts to intrinsic value.

Goldman Sachs S&P 500 Core Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity investments of companies that are included in the fund's benchmark. The fund will generally seek to maintain style, capitalization and industry characteristics similar to its benchmark. The fund is non-diversified.

Fidelity Disruptors ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests its assets in a combination of five Fidelity funds, each of which normally invests in equity securities of companies that represent a disruptive theme. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time.
info.description_zh: Fidelity Disruptors ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將其資產投資於五個富達基金的組合，每個基金通常投資於代表顛覆性主題的公司的股本證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。

info.description: Yoke Core ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a dynamic, tactical asset allocation portfolio across domestic and international equity markets. It invests in domestic and international equity securities (including common stock, other ETFs, real estate investment trusts ("REITs"), American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs")).
info.description_zh: Yoke Core ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資於國內和國際股票市場的動態、戰術性資產配置組合來實現其投資目標。它投資於國內和國際股票證券（包括普通股、其他ETF、房地產投資信託（「REIT」）、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」））。

info.description: Global X Conscious Companies ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Concinnity Conscious Companies Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to companies listed in the U.S. that operate their businesses in a sustainable and responsible manner, as measured by their ability to achieve positive outcomes that are consistent with a multi-stakeholder operating system ("MsOS"), as defined by the provider of the underlying index.
info.description_zh: Global X Conscious Companies ETF 尋求提供與 Concinnity Conscious Companies Index 的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數旨在為以可持續和負責任的方式運營業務的美國上市公司提供投資機會，衡量標準是其實現與多利益相關者操作系統（“MsOS”）一致的積極成果的能力，由基礎指數提供商定義。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Focus Five Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide targeted exposure to the five First Trust sector-based ETFs that the index provider believes offer the greatest potential to outperform the other ETFs in the selection universe and that satisfy certain trading volume and liquidity requirements.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Focus 5 ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Focus Five 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。該指數旨在提供對 First Trust 五個基於行業的 ETF 的有針對性的投資，指數提供者認為這些 ETF 具有超越精選範圍內其他 ETF 的最大潛力，並且滿足一定的交易量和流動性要求。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Baba ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the ADR of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying BABA ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Baba ETF 尋求當前收入；接觸一隻或多只交易所交易基金的業績，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為阿里巴巴集團控股有限公司（紐約證券交易所股票代碼：BABA）每日美國存託憑證百分比的兩倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於以基礎BABA ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Avantis U.S. Quality ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in a diverse group of U.S. companies across market sectors and industry groups. The fund focuses on growth companies, which the portfolio managers generally define as companies that have relatively higher price-to-book ratios or that are included in the MSCI USA Growth IMI Index. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Avantis 美國優質 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於不同市場領域和行業群體的美國公司。該基金專注於成長型公司，投資組合經理人通常將其定義為市淨率相對較高或納入 MSCI 美國成長 IMI 指數的公司。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少80%的資產投資於美國公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Berto Acquisition Corp. II is a blank check company, formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.

People, Inc. engages in the media and Internet business. It operates through the following segments: Dotdash Meredith, Angi Inc, Search, and Emerging and Other. The Dotdash Meredith segment provides digital and print publishing services from mobile to magazines. The ANGI Homeservices segment offers repairing, remodeling, cleaning, and landscaping through category-transforming products under HomeAdvisor, Angie's List, Handy, and Fixd Repair brands. The Search segment consists of Ask Media Group, which provides general search services and information. The Emerging and Other segment includes platforms Care.com, Bluecrew, NurseFly Mosaic Group, Vivian Health, The Daily Beast, IAC Films, and Newco. The company was founded on August 24, 1995, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: People, Inc. 從事媒體和網路業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：Dotdash Meredith、Angi Inc、Search、Emerging and Other。 Dotdash Meredith 部門提供從手機到雜誌的數位和印刷出版服務。 ANGI Homeservices 部門透過 HomeAdvisor、Angie's List、Handy 和 Fixd Repair 品牌下的類別轉型產品提供維修、改造、清潔和景觀美化服務。搜尋部門由 Ask Media Group 組成，該集團提供一般搜尋服務和資訊。新興和其他部門包括 Care.com、Bluecrew、NurseFly Mosaic Group、Vivian Health、The Daily Beast、IAC Films 和 Newco 等平台。該公司成立於1995年8月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Blackrock U.S. Industry Rotation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S.-listed equity securities and derivatives that have similar economic characteristics to such securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德美國產業輪動ETF尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產加上用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於在美國上市的股本證券以及與此類證券具有類似經濟特徵的衍生品。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The Sub-Adviser defines U.S. companies as companies whose securities are traded principally in the United States or that have their principal place of business in the United States. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect US Equity 2 ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於美國公司的股本證券。副顧問將美國公司定義為證券主要在美國交易或主要營業地點在美國的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Choice ESG Screened Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Choice ESG 篩選指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（“ESG”）評級的大中型美國公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Alphadroid Defensive Sector Rotation ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-RO Defensive Sector Rotation Index ("Defensive Sector Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid 防禦性產業輪動 ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-RO 防禦性產業輪動指數（「防禦性產業指數」或「指數」）在扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect US Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in a diverse group of U.S. companies across market sectors, styles (e.g., value or growth), and industry groups or ETFs that provide similar exposure to U.S. companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金主要投資於不同市場領域、風格（例如價值或成長）的美國公司，以及為美國公司提供類似曝險的產業集團或 ETF。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於美國公司的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the total return performance of Hartford US Quality Growth Index that tracks the performance of exchange traded U.S. large cap equity securities and is designed to consist of U.S. equities with favorable growth characteristics while maintaining what is considered to be enhanced exposure to quality while also providing reasonable exposure to value and momentum. The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in securities of the Index and in depositary receipts representing securities of the index.
info.description_zh: Hartford US Quality Growth ETF 力求提供與 Hartford US Quality Growth Index 的總回報表現相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支），該指數跟踪交易所交易的美國大盤股證券的表現，旨在由具有良好增長特徵的美國股票組成，同時保持被認為增強的質量敞口，同時提供合理的價值和動量。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於指數證券和代表指數證券的存託憑證。

info.description: Motley Fool Innovative Growth Factor ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Motley Fool Innovative Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the Innovative Growth Fund's total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The fund will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it generally will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Motley Fool Innovative Growth Factor ETF 尋求與 Motley Fool Innovative Growth Index 的總回報表現大致相符的投資結果。一般情況下，創新成長基金總資產的至少80%會投資於該指數的成分證券。該基金通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它通常會投資於該指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index (the "underlying index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes (if any), in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index, as presently constituted, is designed to track the performance of U.S. equity securities included in the S&P 500 Index that maintain alignment with a broad understanding of the moral and biblical teachings of Christians. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X S&P 500 Christian Values ETF 尋求整體上與 S&P 500 Christian Values Screened Index（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於相關指數的證券。目前構成的基礎指數旨在追蹤標準普爾 500 指數中包含的美國股票證券的表現，該指數與對基督徒道德和聖經教義的廣泛理解保持一致。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index composed of U.S. large- and mid-capitalization companies based on their positioning, relative to their sector peers, with respect to the transition to a low-carbon economy, as determined by the index provider, based primarily on current emissions intensity, emissions reduction targets, green business revenue, and/or climate risk management. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares Climate Conscious & Transition MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤由美國大中型企業組成的 MSCI USA Extended Climate Action Index 的投資結果，該指數由指數提供商根據當前排放強度、減排目標、綠色業務收入和/或氣候風險管理確定的相對於行業同行的定位，確定向低碳經濟轉型。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TappAlpha SPY Growth & Daily Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation and to seek exposure to the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust ("SPY"), subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund's manager seeks to achieve its investment objectives through the use of a call option strategy that combines a long position in SPY, an exchange-traded fund designed to track the performance of the S&P 500 Index, with short positions in certain call options. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: TappAlpha SPY 成長和每日收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時保持資本增值前景，並尋求接觸 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 信託（「SPY」）的業績，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金經理人尋求透過使用看漲期權策略來實現其投資目標，該策略結合了SPY（一種旨在追蹤標準普爾500指數表現的交易所交易基金）的多頭頭寸和某些看漲期權的空頭頭寸。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ETF class shares of Dimensional's U.S. Large Company Portfolio, which seeks to approximate the total investment return of the S&P 500 Index with a 0.06% net expense ratio.

Alexis Practical Tactical ETF seeks total return primarily through long-term capital appreciation, with income and capital preservation as secondary objectives. In seeking to achieve its investment objective, the fund has the flexibility to allocate its assets among different markets around the world and various asset classes (e.g., equity, fixed income, commodities (including precious metals), and real estate (including real estate investment trusts ("REITs"))) and strategies, including alternative strategies (e.g., merger arbitrage, convertible bond and options-based strategies).
info.description_zh: Alexis Practical Tactical ETF 主要透過長期資本增值來尋求總回報，收入和資本保值是次要目標。為了實現其投資目標，該基金可以靈活地在全球不同市場和各種資產類別（例如股票、固定收益、大宗商品（包括貴金屬）和房地產（包括房地產投資信託基金（「REITs」）））和策略（包括另類策略（例如合併套利、可轉換債券和基於選擇權的策略））之間配置其資產。

info.description: AB Moderate Buffer ETF seeks a moderate level of capital appreciation while providing the potential for some downside protection against market declines. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal conditions, substantially all of its assets in a combination of exchange-traded options contracts on an underlying ETF. The underlying ETF (initially expected to be the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust) is an ETF that seeks to track the investment results of the S&P 500 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AB 適度緩衝 ETF 尋求適度的資本增值，同時提供一些針對市場下跌的下行保護的潛力。該基金尋求透過在正常情況下將其大部分資產投資於標的 ETF 的交易所交易選擇權合約組合來實現其投資目標。標的 ETF（最初預計為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust）是一款旨在追蹤 S&P 500 指數投資結果的 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NewHold Investment Corp. IV is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on October 6, 2025, and is headquartered in New York, NY.

iShares Enhanced Large Cap Core Active ETF seeks to outperform the Russell 1000 Index (the "Russell 1000 Index"). The fund is actively managed and seeks to pursue its investment objective while seeking to maintain a low tracking error to the Russell 1000 Index. The fund invests in a portfolio of large cap equity securities in a disciplined manner, using proprietary return forecast models that incorporate quantitative analysis. While the fund primarily invests in securities included in the Russell 1000 Index, the fund may also hold securities that are not included in the Russell 1000 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 增強型大盤核心主動 ETF 力求跑贏 Russell 1000 指數（「Russell 1000 指數」）。該基金採用積極管理方式，力求實現其投資目標，同時力求維持對羅素 1000 指數的低追蹤誤差。本基金採用結合定量分析的專有報酬預測模型，以嚴格的方式投資於大盤股證券投資組合。雖然該基金主要投資於羅素 1000 指數中包含的證券，但該基金也可能持有未包含在羅素 1000 指數中的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Dimensional Global Ex US Core Fixed Income ETF seeks to maximize total returns. The fund seeks its investment objective by investing primarily in a universe of foreign fixed income securities. The fund may invest in obligations issued or guaranteed by foreign governments, their agencies and instrumentalities, corporate debt obligations, bank obligations, commercial paper, repurchase agreements, money market funds, and obligations of supranational organizations.
info.description_zh: Dimensional Global Ex US 核心固定收益 ETF 力求最大化總回報。該基金透過主要投資於一系列外國固定收益證券來尋求其投資目標。該基金可投資於外國政府及其機構和工具發行或擔保的債券、公司債務、銀行債券、商業票據、回購協議、貨幣市場基金以及超國家組織的債券。

info.description: FT Vest Growth Strength & Target Income ETF seeks to provide investors with current income with a secondary objective of providing capital appreciation. Under normal market conditions, the fund will pursue its investment objectives by investing primarily in U.S. exchange-traded equity securities intended to track index and by utilizing an "option strategy" consisting of writing (selling) U.S. exchange-traded call options on the S&P 500 Index, or exchange-traded funds that track the S&P 500 Index (the "Underlying ETFs"). It is non-diversified.

RACWI US ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the RACWI U.S. Index. The fund uses a "passive management" approach to seek to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index is comprised of U.S. listed companies selected based on a proprietary methodology developed and maintained by RAFI Indices, LLC. The index was created to provide exposure to U.S. listed companies based on a fundamental value factor instead of market capitalization alone. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: RACWI US ETF 旨在追蹤 RACWI 美國指數（未計費用和開支）的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由根據 RAFI Indices, LLC 開發和維護的專有方法選擇的美國上市公司組成。該指數的創建是為了根據基本價值因素而不是僅根據市值來提供對美國上市公司的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Touchstone Sands Capital US Select Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in common stocks of U.S. companies that have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth. The manager emphasizes investments in large and mid capitalization growth companies. The fund will invest, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in common stocks of U.S. companies that Sands Capital believes have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth.
info.description_zh: Touchstone Sands Capital US Select Growth ETF 寻求长期资本增值。该基金主要投资于收入或盈利增长潜力高于平均水平的美国公司的普通股。该经理强调对大中型资本成长型公司的投资。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於金沙資本認為具有高於平均水平的收入或獲利成長潛力的美國公司的普通股。

info.description: ProShares Ultra QQQ Equal Weight seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Equal Weighted Index. The fund offers magnified exposure to equal-weighted Nasdaq-100 constituents, reducing mega-cap technology concentration while providing 2x leveraged daily index participation.

Index ETF that seeks to track the total return performance of the iSTOXX Ang Research Enhanced U.S. Large Cap Index, a research-enhanced large-cap U.S. equity index. Advised by SEI Investments Management Corporation.

Invesco QQQ Equal Weight ETF is a non-diversified, index-based strategy that provides exposure to the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market using an equal-weighted methodology. The fund offers a balanced path to the Nasdaq-100 universe by assigning an initial 1% weight to each constituent, effectively mitigating the single-stock and mega-cap concentration risk inherent in market-capitalization-weighted strategies
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 等權重 ETF 是一種非多元化、基於指數的策略，採用等權重方法提供對納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大非金融公司的投資。該基金為每個成分股分配初始 1% 的權重，為進入納斯達克 100 指數提供了一條平衡的路徑，有效降低了市值加權策略中固有的單股和大型股集中風險

info.description: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF seeks calendar quarter investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar quarter performance of the Invesco QQQ Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long Triple Q Quarterly ETF 尋求日曆季度投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 Invesco QQQ Trust 日曆季度業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為景順 QQQ 信託的日曆季度業績提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Warren Street Global Equity ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in equity securities selected by Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser") that provide exposure to companies of all sizes located around the world. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Warren Street 全球股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資 Warren Street Wealth Advisors, LLC（「副顧問」）選擇的股票證券來實現其投資目標，這些股票向世界各地各種規模的公司提供投資。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）將投資於股本證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 Index. The index measures the performance of approximately 70 securities of domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization, as determined by Nasdaq, Inc. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 指數的投資結果。該指數根據納斯達克公司確定的市值衡量在納斯達克上市的約 70 種國內和國際非金融公司證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其基礎指數的組成證券。

info.description: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of U.S. companies and the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust. The fund invests in equity securities of U.S. companies through exchange-traded futures contracts, equity securities of U.S. companies and ETFs that primarily invest in the equity securities of U.S. companies. The fund invests up to 15% of its total assets in the Grayscale Bitcoin Trust.
info.description_zh: Simplify U.S. Equity PLUS GBTC ETF 尋求長期資本增值。正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於美國公司的股本證券和灰階比特幣信託基金。該基金透過交易所交易的期貨合約、美國公司股本證券以及主要投資於美國公司股本證券的ETF投資於美國公司股本證券。該基金將其總資產的 15% 投資於灰階比特幣信託基金。

info.description: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Switzerland Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Switzerland Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Switzerland AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 瑞士指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，從納斯達克瑞士指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth by investing in a diversified portfolio of companies identified as global leaders in disruptive innovation. The strategy integrates a top-down evaluation of secular growth trends with a fundamental bottom-up analysis to select 150 to 250 high-quality companies distinguished by advanced technologies, superior business models, and significant research and development expenditures.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price Innovation Leaders ETF (TNXT) 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於被認定為全球顛覆性創新領導者的公司的多元化投資組合，實現長期資本成長。該策略將長期成長趨勢自上而下的評估與自下而上的基本分析相結合，選出150至250家以先進技術、卓越商業模式和大量研發支出為特色的優質公司。

info.description: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which refer to throughout this prospectus as initial business combination. The company was founded on June 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。其成立的目的是与一个或多个企业进行合并、合并、股份交换、资产收购、股份购买、重组或类似的业务合并，在本招股说明书中将其称为初始业务合并。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 9 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Bitcoin 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Bitcoin futures contracts so that the total value of the Bitcoin to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和比特幣 75/25 策略 ETF 旨在複製 S&P 500 和 S&P CME 比特幣期貨指數 75/25 混合指數的總回報（扣除費用和開支）。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數佔 75% 的權重，標普 CME 比特幣期貨指數佔 25% 的權重。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於比特幣期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險的比特幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Artificial Intelligence and Robotics ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Nasdaq CTA Artificial Intelligence and Robotics IndexSM (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies engaged in the artificial intelligence ("AI") and robotics segments of the technology, industrial and other economic sectors.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克人工智慧和機器人 ETF 尋求與名為納斯達克 CTA 人工智慧和機器人指數 SM（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在追蹤技術、工業和其他經濟領域的人工智慧（「AI」）和機器人領域公司的表現。

info.description: Baillie Gifford U.S. Equity Growth ETF is an actively managed concentrated portfolio seeking long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in U.S. common stocks and equity securities. The fund uses a fundamental, bottom-up research process to build a non-diversified portfolio of 30 to 50 exceptional growth companies with market capitalizations over $1.5 billion, holding investments for long multi-year horizons relative to the Russell 1000 Growth Index.

Applied Finance IVS International SMID ETF is an actively managed fund that targets small- and mid-capitalization companies in developed markets outside of North America using a proprietary valuation-driven approach. The strategy utilizes the Intrinsic Value Stewardship (IVS) analytical model to identify securities with superior return potential by evaluating firm-level profitability, competition, growth rates, and capital costs to determine intrinsic value relative to market price.

Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF seeks to provide capital growth over the medium to long term. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity and equity-related securities of emerging market issuers. Equity and equity-related securities include exchange-traded and over-the-counter common and preferred stocks, warrants, options, rights, convertible securities, sponsored and unsponsored depositary receipts, trust certificates, partnership interests and shares of other investment companies (including other exchange-traded funds ("ETFs")). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Emerging Markets Alternative ETF 尋求在中長期內提供資本增長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於新興市場發行人的股票和股票相關證券。股票和股票相關證券包括交易所交易和場外交易的普通股和優先股、認股權證、選擇權、權利、可轉換證券、保薦和非保薦存託憑證、信託證書、合夥權益以及其他投資公司的股份（包括其他交易所交易基金（「ETF」））。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Paris-Aligned Climate MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Climate Paris Aligned Benchmark Extended Select Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index is composed of U.S. large- and mid-capitalization stocks that are selected and weighted so that, in the aggregate, the portfolio is compatible with the objectives of the Paris Agreement by following a decarbonization trajectory. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 巴黎協調氣候 MSCI 美國 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 美國氣候巴黎協調基準擴展精選指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。基礎指數由美國大中型股票組成，這些股票經過精心挑選和加權，總體而言，該投資組合遵循脫碳軌跡，與《巴黎協定》的目標一致。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the information technology sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index 的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的信息技術領域美國小型公司的證券表現。

info.description: Themes Cloud Computing ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Cloud Computing Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the field of cloud computing based in developed market countries. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.

Tradr 2X Long SPY Quarterly ETF seeks calendar quarter investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (200%) the calendar quarter performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar quarter performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Tradr 2X Long SPY 季度 ETF 尋求日曆季度投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 信託日曆季度業績的兩倍 (200%)。在正常市場情況下，該基金將維持至少 80% 的金融工具敞口，這些金融工具為 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 信託的日曆季度業績提供兩倍的槓桿敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ProShares UltraPro QQQ seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to three times (3x) the daily performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index includes 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares UltraPro QQQ 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支），相當於 NASDAQ-100 指數每日表現的三倍 (3x)。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。該指數包括納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司（按市值計算）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Communications ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive communications companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性通訊 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性通訊公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks income and capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in emerging market dividend-paying common stocks with growth characteristics. The adviser, using a disciplined model-based process focused on a long-term approach to investing, seeks to identify dividend-paying companies with strong corporate profitability and sustainable growth characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree新興市場優質股息成長基金尋求收入和資本增值。該基金尋求透過主要投資於具有成長特徵的新興市場派息普通股來實現其投資目標。該顧問採用基於模型的嚴格流程，專注於長期投資方法，力求識別具有強勁企業盈利能力和可持續增長特徵的派息公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Alternative Nasdaq & Bond ETF seeks attractive risk-adjusted total return through capital appreciation and current income. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80%, but up to 100%, of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes, if any) in a portfolio of equity instruments (including options and equity ETFs) and fixed income instruments (including bonds and fixed income ETFs) intended to deliver convertible security-like exposure to companies in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Calamos 另類納斯達克和債券 ETF 透過資本增值和當前收入尋求具有吸引力的風險調整總回報。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80%、但最多 100% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款，如果有）投資於權益工具（包括期權和股票 ETF）和固定收益工具（包括債券和固定收益 ETF）投資組合來實現其目標，旨在向納斯達克 100 指數中的公司提供類似可轉換證券的風險敞口。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% Issuer Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of emerging market companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG MSCI EM Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI EM Extended ESG Leaders 5% 發行人上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵的新興市場公司的股票表現。

info.description: Actively managed equity ETF, launched under the EA Series Trust, that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in growth-oriented U.S. equities selected by The Investment House.

WisdomTree Space Economy Fund invests primarily in equity securities of global companies involved in activities that form the space economy value chain, including launch vehicles, orbital infrastructure, satellite broadband, Earth observation intelligence, and defense space systems. The fund seeks to capture structural growth opportunities tied to the commercial space economy, geospatial intelligence, and defense modernization.

Matthews China Discovery Active ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy enhanced by the use of artificial intelligence. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Matthews China Discovery Active ETF 尋求資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過利用人工智慧增強的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市大型資本公司的證券。

info.description: Grab Holdings Ltd. engages in the provision of millions of people each day to access its driver- and merchant-partners to order food or groceries, send packages, hail a ride or taxi, pay for online purchases or access services such as lending, insurance, wealth management and telemedicine, all through a single "everyday everything" app. The firm operates in food deliveries and mobility and by TPV in the e-wallets segment of financial services in Southeast Asia. It operates through the following segments: Deliveries, Mobility, Financial Services, and Others. The Deliveries segment connects driver-partner and merchant-partners with consumers to create a localized logistics platform, facilitating, and performing on-demand and scheduled delivery of a wide variety of daily necessities, including ready-to-eat meals and groceries, as well as point-to-point parcel delivery. The Mobility segment offers consumers rides provided by driver-partners across a wide variety of multi-modal mobility options. The Financial Services segments include digital payments, lending, receivables factoring, and digital banking services in certain markets. The Others segment deals with mapping services, autonomous vehicle services, and last-mile delivery infrastructure. The company was founded by Anthony Tan Ping Yeow and Tan Hooi Ling in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.

EverCommerce, Inc. engages in providing integrated, vertically-tailored software-as-a-service solutions for service-based small and medium sized businesses. It operates through the United States and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Eric Remer in September 2016 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.

Themes Robotics & Automation ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Industrial Robotics & Automation Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies whose products and services are focused on robotics and automation solutions in an industrial context. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Robotics & Automation ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive 工業機器人與自動化指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在為那些產品和服務專注於工業環境中的機器人和自動化解決方案的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dow Jones International Internet ETF seeks the results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Dow Jones International Internet Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is developed, maintained and sponsored by S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. The index is designed to measure the performance of securities of non-U.S. issuers whose primary business focus is Internet-related. The fund is non-diversified.

Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. develops drugs for clinical treatment. Its unique precision medicine platform is Acrivon Predictive Precision Proteomics (AP3). AP3 is used to generate proprietary OncoSignature companion diagnostics to identify patients who will benefit from the medicine. The company was founded by Peter Blume-Jensen and Kristina Masson in 2018 and is headquartered in Watertown, MA.
info.description_zh: Acrivon Therapeutics, Inc. 開發用於臨床治療的藥物。其獨特的精準醫學平台為 Acrivon Predictive Precision Proteomics (AP3)。 AP3 用於產生專有的 OncoSignature 伴隨診斷，以識別將從該藥物中受益的患者。該公司由 Peter Blume-Jensen 和 Kristina Masson 於 2018 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃特敦。

info.description: Macquarie Focused Emerging Markets Equity ETF seeks to long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of emerging markets issuers. The fund invests primarily in a broad range of equity securities of companies located in emerging market countries and may invest in companies of any size. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description_zh: 麥格理專注於新興市場股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於新興市場發行人的股本證券。該基金主要投資於新興市場國家公司的各種股本證券，並可投資於任何規模的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Financials ETF seeks to deliver an enhanced, frequent income stream by executing an options-based strategy focused primarily on selling short-term put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds that track three times the daily performance of its underlying sector index. The fund targets three times the income premium generated from standard option writing on the sector benchmark while maintaining capped exposure to the underlying assets' upside performance alongside a discretionary downside protection mechanism.

WisdomTree China ex-State-Owned Enterprises Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree China ex-State-Owned Enterprises Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) will be invested in component securities of the index and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of such component securities. The index is a modified float-adjusted market cap weighted index that consists of common stocks in China, excluding common stocks of "state-owned enterprises." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree中國前國營企業基金旨在追蹤WisdomTree中國前國營企業指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，基金總資產（不包括證券借貸抵押品）的至少80%將投資於該指數的組成證券以及與該組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的投資。該指數是修正後的流通市值加權指數，由中國普通股組成，不包括「國營企業」的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NICE Ltd. engages in the provision of enterprise software solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: Customer Engagement, and Financial Crime and Compliance Solutions. The Customer Engagement segment provides suites such as compliance and risk, workforce optimization, operational efficiency, customer experience, and sales and retention. The Financial Crime and Compliance Solutions segment includes embedded-AI solutions that identify risks and help prevent money laundering and fraud, as well as help ensure financial markets compliance in real-time. The company was founded on September 28, 1986 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.

OBOOK Holdings, Inc. is a blockchain-based financial infrastructure and software company, which engages in providing integrated payment solutions. It offers its solutions under its platforms, OwlPay, OwlPay Payment, OwlPay Cash, OwlPay Wallet Pro, OwlPay Harbor, OwlNest, OwlJourney, OwlTing Experiences, OwlStay, and OwlTing Market. The firm operates through the following segments: Payment, Hospitality, and E-commerce. The Payment segment provides solutions to customers, including payment gateway services and payout services. The Hospitality segment consists of software services and under-platform services, supporting property management, distribution, and booking. The E-commerce segment sells products online. The company was founded by Chun-Kai Wang and Chung-Han Hsieh in 2010 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

IDX Alternative FIAT ETF provides exposure to precious metals (gold, silver) and major digital assets (Bitcoin, Ethereum) via futures, crypto ETPs and metal ETPs with a stated risk-managed, inflation/currency-hedge objective and judicious use of leverage up to 1.25x.
info.description_zh: IDX 另類法定 ETF 透過期貨、加密貨幣 ETP 和金屬 ETP 提供貴金屬（黃金、白銀）和主要數位資產（比特幣、以太幣）的投資，並具有明確的風險管理、通膨/貨幣對沖目標，並明智地使用高達 1.25 倍的槓桿。

info.description: Rayliant-ChinaAMC Transformative China Tech ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Solactive ChinaAMC Transformative China Tech Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index, as well as participatory notes that represent securities in the index. The underlying index will then select the top 300 eligible constituents based on their total market capitalization ranked in descending order. The fund is non-diversified.

ProShares Ultra Cloud Computing seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the ISE CTA Cloud Computing Index. The index is comprised of companies classified as "cloud computing" companies by the CTA. The Advisor expects that its cash balances maintained in connection with the use of financial instruments will typically be held in money market instruments. It invests in common stock issued by public companies. The fund invests in derivatives, which are financial instruments whose value is derived from the value of an underlying asset or assets. It is non-diversified.

Invivyd, Inc. engages in the discovery, development and commercialization of antibody-based solutions for infectious diseases with pandemic potential. The firm develops antibodies that can neutralize SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV-1, and additional emergent coronaviruses. It offers ADG20, a monoclonal antibody, targeting the spike protein of SARS-CoV-2 and related coronaviruses. The company was founded by Tillman U. Gerngross, Ren Russo and Laura Walker on June 3, 2020 and is headquartered in New Haven, CT.
info.description_zh: Invivyd, Inc. 致力於針對具有大流行潛力的傳染病的基於抗體的解決方案的發現、開發和商業化。該公司開發的抗體可以中和 SARS-CoV-2、SARS-CoV-1 和其他新出現的冠狀病毒。它提供 ADG20，一種單株抗體，針對 SARS-CoV-2 和相關冠狀病毒的刺突蛋白。該公司由 Tillman U. Gerngross、Ren Russo 和 Laura Walker 於 2020 年 6 月 3 日創立，總部位於康乃狄克州紐黑文。

info.description: Surgery Partners, Inc. is healthcare services holding company, which engages in the provision of solutions for surgical and related ancillary care in support of its patients and physicians. It operates through the Surgical Facility segment. The Surgical Facility segment includes the operation of ambulatory surgery centers, surgical hospitals, anesthesia services, urgent care facilities and multi-specialty physician practices. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Brentwood, TN.

Leverage Shares 2X Long GRAB Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of GRAB. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GRAB, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 GRAB 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 GRAB ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些工具結合起來提供 GRAB 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Akamai Technologies, Inc. is the cybersecurity and cloud computing company that powers and protects business online. The market security solutions, superior threat intelligence, and global operations team provide defense in depth to safeguard enterprise data and applications everywhere. The firm full-stack cloud computing solutions deliver performance and affordability on the world's most distributed platform. The global enterprises trust Akamai to provide the industry reliability, scale, and expertise they need to grow their business with confidence. The company was founded by Frank T. Leighton, Jonathan Seelig, Randall S. Kaplan, and Daniel M. Lewin on August 20, 1998 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.

Rapid7, Inc. engages in the provision of cyber security analytics and automation services. Its products include Metasploit, Nexpose, AppSpider, tCell by Rapid7, as well as insight platforms such as InsightDR, InsightIVM, InsightAppSec, InsightConnect, and InsightOps. The firm also offers security and product consulting services. The company was founded by Alan P. Matthews, Tas Giakouminakis, and Chad Loder in July 2000 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Rapid7, Inc. 從事提供網路安全分析和自動化服務。其產品包括Metasploit、Nexpose、AppSpider、Rapid7的tCell，以及InsightDR、InsightIVM、InsightAppSec、InsightConnect和InsightOps等洞察平台。該公司還提供安全和產品諮詢服務。該公司由 Alan P. Matthews、Tas Giakouminakis 和 Chad Loder 於 2000 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Jayud Global Logistics Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of cross-border supply chain solutions. It offers freight forwarding services, supply chain management, and other value-added services. The company operated through People's Republic of China & Hong Kong, and United States of America segments. Jayud Global Logistics was founded by Xiao Gang Geng in September 2009 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.

Leverage Shares 2X Long BMNR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of BMNR. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BMNR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. It is non-diversified.

Groupon, Inc. engages in the global scaled two-sided marketplace that connects consumers to merchants. It operates through the North America and International geographical segments. The company was founded by Andrew D. Mason, Eric Paul Lefkofsky, and Bradley A. Keywell in October 2008 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.

21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of DOGE. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of the fund's assets in, or provide exposure equal to, financial instruments that the Adviser and Sub-Adviser believe, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective of seeking daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times (2x) the daily price performance of DOGE. The fund does not invest directly in DOGE. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 21Shares 2x 多吉幣 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支），相當於 DOGE 每日價格表現的兩倍 (2x)。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的基金資產投資於顧問和副顧問認為組合起來應產生與基金的投資目標一致的每日回報（不包括費用和開支）的金融工具，或提供相當於 DOGE 每日價格表現兩倍 (2x) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金不直接投資於 DOGE。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: KraneShares 2x Long BABA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the ADR of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE: BABA). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the underlying stock and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide investment exposure to 2 times (200%) the performance of the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.

MongoDB, Inc. engages in the development and provision of a general-purpose database platform. The firm's products include MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, MongoDB Atlas, and Community Server. It also offers professional services including consulting and training. The company was founded by Eliot Horowitz, Dwight A. Merriman, Kevin P. Ryan, and Geir Magnusson Jr. in 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
